岗位职责
The role will help the department navigate a highly complex portfolio spanning global investment, post-investment management, strategic partnerships and commercial collaboration. The successful candidate should be able to see the full picture, identify the issues that truly matter, and translate complexity into clear insights that senior management can act on and teams can execute against.
This is not a traditional PMO or reporting role. We are looking for someone with strong business judgment, exceptional structuring capabilities and a low-ego, high-ownership mindset—someone who proactively identifies gaps, steps in where needed and drives critical work through to completion.
The candidate must also be both an active gamer and a hands-on AI practitioner, with genuine passion for games and AI.1. Strategic Framing and Decision SupportDevelop and continuously refine the strategic framework for Tencent Games’ global investment, post-investment management, strategic partnerships and commercial collaboration.
Work closely with the Head of Global BD, the leadership team and key stakeholders to identify strategic priorities, define key initiatives and translate strategic direction into actionable business plans.
Synthesize complex and fragmented business information into clear, structured and decision-ready insights that senior management can quickly understand and act on.
Identify emerging opportunities, critical issues and key trade-offs early, and provide clear recommendations rather than simply reporting information.
Connect external market developments with Tencent Games’ internal priorities to support better strategic judgment.
2. Department Business Management and Operating System
Build and operate the department’s annual and quarterly planning, business review and priority-management mechanisms.
Maintain a comprehensive view across investments, partnerships, regions, Cells and strategic initiatives, ensuring that the most important matters receive appropriate management attention.
Work with Cell owners, regional teams and cross-functional partners to set, break down and review business objectives and performance metrics.
Establish clear ownership, milestones, decision points and escalation mechanisms for key initiatives.
Reduce reliance on manual tracking and individual information bottlenecks by building scalable and reusable operating mechanisms.
3. Business Performance Review and Analysis
Conduct monthly and quarterly reviews of business performance, strategic initiatives and organizational priorities.
Identify key progress, risks, gaps and dependencies, and translate them into clear management implications and recommended actions.
Develop dashboards, trackers and review materials that help management understand not only what happened, but also why it matters and what decisions are required.
Ensure important decisions, actions and lessons are captured and followed through.
4. Critical Initiative Ownership
Own and drive selected strategic initiatives from initial framing through execution.
Proactively identify execution gaps and step into uncovered areas to keep critical work moving.
Bring together the necessary business, investment, finance, legal, HR and other functional perspectives to turn strategic intent into concrete outcomes.
Build repeatable frameworks and processes instead of managing issues case by case.
Support the department in handling complex, high-priority or time-sensitive topics that require cross-business judgment and strong execution.
5. Executive Communication and Organizational Translation
Prepare decision papers, strategic reviews and executive presentations for the Head of Global BD and senior management.
Translate complex business discussions into language that is:
clear enough for senior executives to make decisions;
practical enough for teams to understand and execute.
Ensure strategic priorities, management decisions and key messages are communicated consistently across an international organization.
Serve as a trusted sparring partner who can challenge assumptions constructively while maintaining strong relationships with senior executives and stakeholders.
6. Industry Insight and Organizational Intelligence
Stay current on global games industry trends, investment activity, competitive dynamics, emerging business models and technology developments.
Develop a strong understanding of Tencent Games’ internal businesses, key stakeholders, decision-making processes and organizational context.
Build broad knowledge across investment, post-investment management, strategic partnerships, commercial collaboration and regional BD.
Apply sound interpersonal judgment and organizational sensitivity when handling complex stakeholder topics.
7. AI-Enabled Business Operations
Actively explore and apply AI tools to improve research, analysis, knowledge management, workflow automation, document creation and decision support.
Identify opportunities to redesign existing business-management workflows with AI, rather than simply using AI to accelerate isolated tasks.
Turn recurring management work, effective prompts, workflows and institutional knowledge into reusable team capabilities.
Contribute to the development of the department’s AI Infra, knowledge base and organizational memory.
Share effective AI practices and help raise AI fluency across the broader BD team.

岗位要求
Professional Experience3+ years of relevant professional experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy and operations, Chief of Staff roles, investment banking, investment, or business management within gaming or technology companies.
Experience in the games industry, global business development, investment, post-investment management or strategic partnerships is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience working with senior executives and driving cross-functional strategic initiatives.
Experience operating in a complex, international and multicultural organization is preferred.
Business and Strategic Capabilities
Exceptional structuring and synthesis skills, with the ability to understand complex businesses, identify the key issue and translate complexity into clear frameworks and decisions.
Strong strategic judgment, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.
Able to balance attention to detail with a clear view of overall business priorities.
Strong understanding of—or demonstrated ability to quickly learn—investment, commercial partnerships, business operations and organizational management.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Chinese and English.
Gaming Passion，must be a passionate and active gamer.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of player experiences, major game genres, leading products, game companies and global industry dynamics.
Able to translate product experience and player insight into independent business and strategic judgment.
Candidates should be prepared to discuss the games they actively play, their understanding of different genres and business models, and their views on major industry trends.
AI Passion and Hands-On Experience,must have a genuine passion for AI and be an active, hands-on user of AI tools in daily work.
Demonstrate real experience using AI for research, analysis, knowledge management, workflow automation, content creation or decision support.
Able to provide concrete examples of how AI has improved the quality, speed or scope of their work.
Curious about emerging AI products and willing to continuously learn, experiment and share reusable practices.
Coding, agent-building or workflow-automation experience is a plus, but not required.
Leadership and Working Style
Low ego and high ownership—focused on outcomes rather than visibility or personal credit.
Highly proactive and self-driven; identifies gaps and takes action before being asked.
Comfortable stepping into ambiguous or uncovered areas and taking work through to completion.
Strong interpersonal judgment and organizational sensitivity, with the ability to work effectively across different functions, seniority levels and cultural backgrounds.
Able to operate effectively behind the scenes while having the confidence to challenge and influence senior stakeholders.
Entrepreneurial, resilient and results-oriented, with a demonstrated track record of driving meaningful outcomes

jobs.description:

2.深入掌握Windows内核原理与驱动开发技术，熟悉WDM、KMDF驱动模型，精通IRP处理流程、PnP机制及存储/文件系统底层原理；

5.具备丰富的多硬件环境适配经验，能够针对不同网卡、显卡、主板等设备驱动进行调试和优化；
6.具备优秀的逻辑思维能力和问题解决能力，能够独立承担复杂模块的设计与开发任务。

岗位职责：

3.设计并实现高性能磁盘I/O服务体系，涵盖并发读写控制、多级缓存策略、智能回写机制、任务调度算法及网络传输优化；

岗位职责
1、负责团队旗下游戏产品的全球商务拓展与IP合作，开拓并维护与全球优质IP方、渠道、平台及生态伙伴的战略合作关系。

6、对全球游戏市场、商业模式及行业趋势有深刻理解，具备较强的商业敏感度和市场洞察力。

9、有海外工作背景、熟悉主流游戏市场（如欧美、日韩、东南亚等）本地化合作生态者优先。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

jobs.requirementText:

岗位职责：
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1. 制定3A驾驶游戏产品全球上市前后的整体品牌营销策略、定位及核心信息框架，确保品牌理念在全球各区域的一致性传达。
2. 主导产品从测试期到上线后全生命周期的品牌创意工作，包括全球首曝、测试节点推广、线上线下整合营销活动、发布活动等核心市场节点的创意方案策划与执行。
3. 深入理解主机/PC 核心玩家生态及全球驾驶文化社区，制定社区增长与活跃策略，维护核心玩家关系，激发内容生态。
4. 持续跟踪驾驶品类及开放世界赛道市场趋势、竞品动态与玩家反馈，为市场决策和产品优化提供数据驱动的依据。
5. 协同运营、UA、区域市场团队及平台合作伙伴关系等多个跨职能团队，整合游戏内资源与全球多区域资源，推动最终方案的质量落地。
6. 深度参与重点区域的市场策略制定与执行协调，确保全球统一品牌框架下的本地化表达与精准本地化手段落地。

岗位要求
1. 必备经验：
- 5 年及以上游戏行业市场或品牌工作经验。
- 有成功主导AAA 级主机/PC 游戏品牌项目经验，优先考虑有开放世界、驾驶/竞速品类或RPG 品类项目经验者。
- 具备全球市场GTM营销经验，熟悉至少 2 个以上区域市场（北美/欧洲/亚洲）的玩家生态。
2. 核心能力
- 深谙驾驶文化与玩家心理：理解汽车文化与驾驶体验的吸引力，能精准把握驾驶游戏玩家群体的圈层语言、情感诉求与社区行为模式。

岗位职责
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.
As a Strategic Investment Director you will: 
1.Work directly with senior management across global and domestic games markets.
2.Lead projects related to our business development independently.
3.Evaluate global gaming investment and BD opportunities.
4.More importantly, drive development of new opportunities and incubate new businesses.
5.Work in a team with high-calibre executives previously from top-tier consultancy firms and investment banks.

7.Provide game changing strategy and inspire out-of-the-box thinking to senior leader.
8.Plan and manage business incubation, drive product innovation and new partnerships, develop and execute go-to-market plan.
9.Make key investment decisions.
10.Monitor domestic and global game market. Identify emerging industry/technology trends.

4.Must be a self-starter, comfortable with uncertainty, and ability to drive to answers through disciplined work, while also collaborating with cross-functional teams.

岗位职责：
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
负责Honor of Kings的营销推广工作，版本推广方向，基于Honor of Kings的产品新版本、新玩法、新节点、新皮肤动向，制定营销策略、策划重点推广campaign，并进行落地执行。
能够有效分析当前版本内容，结合产品游戏文化、全球流行趋势及市场环节提炼用户沟通点，整合多项营销手段，输出市场营销方案。
牵头负责海外品牌事件，洞察目标市场，找准营销机会点，灵活调动资源，有效管理项目进度，交付玩家社群喜爱的活动、内容。
基于推广方案，协同运营、电竞、UA、及各区域团队，整合游戏内及海外多区域资源，实现最终推广落地，并持续探索新的营销能力。
结合营销推广、产品转化与用研数据，复盘宣传效果，优化后续推广工作。

岗位要求
在市场营销\推广策划方面有5年及以上经验，具备方案策划、落地执行、效果评估等营销推广币经验，了解创意设计、网红推广、玩家活动、公关传播、媒介投放、线下活动等营销手段的基本逻辑及效果验收方法。
英文流利，能用于工作语言。
具备较强业务增长导向，具备良好的数据与用研意识，能够将各类传播效果与产品数据增长相关联，注重以营销提升产品数据表现 。
有海外游戏发行经验，了解海外重点社媒平台的内容和爆款逻辑，对海外流行趋势及热梗有敏锐触觉，能将热点内容转化为创意，乐于探索新鲜事物。
热爱游戏，是游戏玩家，能从玩家角度拆解产品乐趣点，具备MOBA品类的深度体验经验优先 。
学习与执行能力强，能以开放、包容的心态应对跨文化沟通，团队协作意识强，承压能力强。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
Work Location: China-Shenzhen

岗位要求详情请见上方岗位职责内说明

岗位职责：
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1. 全球市场战略规划 (GTM)： 负责制定该UE5二次元开放世界大作的全球发行与市场营销战略（涵盖欧美、日韩、东南亚及中国大陆等核心区域）。主导产品从曝光、测试、预热到公测及长线运营的全生命周期市场节奏，特别是跨端（移动端/PC/主机）的协同宣发策略。2. IP与品牌建设： 深度挖掘游戏世界观与角色内核，确立产品在全球市场的品牌定位。制定高规格的内容营销计划，统筹CG、PV、视觉海报、核心向宣发物料的创意方向与制作把控。
3. 品效协同与增长策略： 统筹全球UA、品牌曝光、公关（PR）、社群（Community）及KOL/内容创作者生态建设。实现“品效合一”，对全球新增用户量、获客成本（CPA）及整体市场ROI负责。
4. 区域化发行与团队管理： 管理跨国/跨时区的全球市场团队。针对不同国家和地区的二次元文化属性与主机/PC单机受众习惯，制定因地制宜的本地化营销策略。
5. 跨部门深度协同： 作为市场与研发的桥梁，与研发团队（制作人、策划、美术）深度绑定，及时反馈全球玩家诉求，推动产品调优；并与运营、商务等团队紧密配合，确保发行目标的达成。

岗位要求
1. 核心特质：极致热爱与自驱力。 对游戏行业及市场营销抱有极高的热情与敬畏心。具备强烈的自驱力、创业精神与抗压能力。2. 真正的“深度游戏玩家”。 阅游无数的硬核玩家，拥有海量的主机/PC大作及二次元游戏体验时长。对开放世界架构、RPG沉浸感、动作系统以及二次元叙事有极深的个人见解，能与核心玩家同频共振。
3. 行业经验： 8年以上游戏行业市场/发行经验，其中至少 3年以上全球市场团队管理或跨国发行负责人经验。
4. 成功背书与跨端优势： 操盘过至少一款S级（或全球知名）二次元/开放世界/RPG类游戏的全球化或多区域成功发行。具备PC、主机（PlayStation/Xbox等）跨平台大作的全球宣发与GTM经验者将作为极大加分项。
5. 统筹与决策： 具备极强的大盘操盘能力、数据分析能力与过亿美金级别的市场预算管理经验。能够清晰地拆解目标并指导各业务线落地。
6. 语言与跨文化沟通： 优秀的跨文化管理与沟通能力。中文及英语流利（可作为工作语言），若同时精通日语或韩语更佳。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

3、深度熟悉 TikTok 及其它东南亚主流社群平台的生态、运营机制及增长玩法。
4、热爱游戏，对游戏行业有广泛涉猎，并能深度洞察东南亚玩家的心理特征与行为习惯。
5、具备良好的跨团队与跨文化沟通能力。能在快节奏环境下高效处理多项优先级任务。心态成熟、抗压性强，具备优秀的危机公关处理经验。

About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are hiring a research intern to train LLM agents that play in-game characters. The agent has to stay in persona across multi-turn dialogue, use memory and game context, and keep relationship, tone, and world rules intact. The work sits on a live role-play NPC model: supervised fine-tuning today, with preference optimization and verifiable-reward reinforcement learning as the next training stages.1. Train role-play agents with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then post-train them with direct preference optimization (DPO) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Iterate on persona consistency, multi-turn coherence, and instruction following.
2. Build and curate SFT, preference, and verifiable-reward data for character dialogue, covering memory injection, relationship stage, language switching, emotion, and out-of-character resistance.
3. Design checks that can be verified automatically, such as format, language, persona boundaries, and safety refusals, and use them both as RLVR rewards and as offline regression tests.
4. Work with game designers and engineers to bring the agent into a live game, and keep latency, cost, and player experience within production constraints.

Who We Look For
1. Currently enrolled in a Master's or PhD program in Computer Science, NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, or recently graduated. Available at least three days per week, with supervisor and university approval where required.
2. Fluent English (written and spoken) and strong communication skills are required. You will work closely with game designers, engineers, and researchers across regions, and must be able to explain experiment results and trade-offs clearly.
3. Hands-on experience with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of LLMs, and with post-training methods including DPO and RLVR (or a closely related verifiable-reward RL method). You should be able to run the loop from data and training config through evaluation and the next iteration.
4. Experience training or evaluating role-play or character-dialogue models, including persona consistency, multi-turn dialogue, and staying in character.
5. Proficient in Python and PyTorch, and comfortable with the Hugging Face / Transformers training stack.
6. Preferred: experience with LLM agents (memory, planning, or tool use), LLM applications in games, or a publication at a major NLP/ML venue (ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML).

What the Role Entails
About the Team
The AI Compute Centre sits within Tencent's Overseas IT department, acting as the bridge between internal AI infrastructure demand and the external resources that fulfil it. We play key roles in the full lifecycle of AI infrastructure clusters — from requirement gathering and capacity planning, through architectural design and development, to delivery, operations, and DevOps — across regions worldwide.
About the Role
You will lead the cloud/edge cloud infrastructure projects you are responsible for delivering. Your focus is to turn business and technical requirements into deliverable plans, hold suppliers accountable, coordinate data centre readiness, and ensure that new capacity is accepted and handed over to operations with clear ownership.
This is a cross-functional role. You will work with specialist engineers on compute, networking, storage, facilities, and security decisions; you are not expected to personally configure every system or run every benchmark. You should, however, be able to challenge assumptions, identify gaps between vendor commitments and delivered outcomes, and drive issues to resolution.
What You Will Do
● Translate demand into infrastructure requirements. Work with AI business and platform teams to define compute capacity, network bandwidth and latency, connectivity, data access, scalability, availability, and operational needs. Convert these into supplier requirements, evaluation criteria, delivery milestones, and acceptance criteria.
● Lead network design and delivery reviews. Review data centre fabric, inter-data-centre and WAN connectivity, routing, IP planning, network segmentation, resilience, and expansion plans with internal architects and suppliers. Ensure designs address both AI workload requirements and day-to-day operability.
● Manage network providers and delivery dependencies. Coordinate network equipment vendors, carriers, colocation partners, and system integrators on circuits, cross-connects, cabling, configuration handoffs, implementation windows, and fault escalation. Track responsibilities and resolve gaps between suppliers.
● Drive data centre readiness. Coordinate rack space, power, cooling, physical access, cabling, carrier connectivity, and installation prerequisites. Identify site or network dependencies that could delay cluster deployment.
● Own integration and acceptance governance. Coordinate compute, network, storage, and platform teams through installation, integration, testing, remediation, and sign-off. Require evidence for connectivity, bandwidth, latency, failover, and agreed cluster-level outcomes—not just confirmation that equipment has been installed.
● Manage delivery and service accountability. Maintain integrated plans, risks, decision logs, and supplier action trackers. Define handover documentation, monitoring expectations, incident escalation, change procedures, support boundaries, and service review cadence.
● Communicate technical risks clearly. Explain design trade-offs, unresolved defects, capacity constraints, and schedule impacts to both engineering teams and business stakeholders.

Who We Look For
Must-haves
● Substantial experience in infrastructure architecture, network engineering, technical delivery, or service management, typically 10+ years in relevant roles.
● Strong data centre or enterprise networking experience, with the ability to review network topology, routing, connectivity, redundancy, and capacity plans—not only manage project schedules.
● Working knowledge of TCP/IP, L2/L3 networking, VLANs, routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF, and common data centre network design principles.
● Experience delivering or operating networks across data centres, cloud environments, or multiple sites, including coordination with carriers, colocation providers, and network equipment vendors.
● Ability to review network test plans and evidence, identify gaps in connectivity or failover, and work with engineers and suppliers to resolve issues.
● Experience with a data centre migration, site deployment, colocation delivery, or comparable infrastructure transition involving multiple technical teams and external providers.
● Demonstrated experience managing suppliers through design review, delivery milestones, acceptance, escalation, and production handover.
● Ability to assess infrastructure proposals across compute, network, storage, availability, and operational support, while engaging specialists for detailed validation.
● Strong documentation and stakeholder communication skills. 
Nice to Have
● Experience evaluating or sourcing AI server capacity, AI infrastructure services, or large-scale compute platforms.
● Deeper experience with Spine-Leaf/Clos fabrics, EVPN-VXLAN, ECMP, MLAG, or inter-data-centre connectivity.
● Familiarity with InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, AI server cluster network design, high-performance storage, or cluster-level performance testing such as NCCL.
● Experience with high-density data centre deployments, including power and cooling constraints.
● Exposure to supplier SLAs, commercial evaluation, cost optimisation, disaster recovery, or service governance.
● Relevant networking, cloud, AI infrastructure, project management, or IT service management certifications.

2.チャネル：NTT DATA、CTC、TISなどの大手システムインテグレーター（SI）を含む中核パートナーを中心に、戦略方向性および売上目標をすり合わせ、チャネル成長計画を策定。パートナーの育成（イネブルメント）、研修・認定、インセンティブ政策、商談転換の着地を推進する。
3.ダイレクトセールス：日本市場の大手顧客（大手企業、インターネット企業、官公庁・企業顧客を含む）の開拓・深耕を単独で担当。顧客の特定、ニーズ把握、提案設計から商談交渉、契約着地まで、セールス全工程をリードする。
4.キーチャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客との長期的な協力関係を構築・維持し、安定した顧客コミュニケーションおよび運営振返りの仕組みを構築。継続的に顧客価値を深耕し、増枠購入およびクロスセルの推進を図る。
5.日本地域の戦略を策定し、体系的に新規パートナーおよびダイレクトセールス目標顧客を拡大。完全なセールスパイプラインを管理し、新規商談の発掘と転換を継続的に推進する。
6.社内リソース（製品、ソリューション、プリセールス、デリバリー等）を統合し、チャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客がセールス転換において直面する肝要課題の解決を推進し、セールスプロセスおよび顧客体験を継続的に最適化する。
7.日本クラウドコンピューティング市場の動向および競合戦略を追跡し、市場インサイトをアウトプット。ビジネス意思決定および製品のローカライゼーションに現場のインプットを提供する。

3、对云计算产品、解决方案及行业应用有深入理解，具备完整的端到端销售闭环经验（渠道及直销均可），有千万级以上 deal 签约的成功案例；

5、具备优秀的商务谈判能力、跨团队协调能力及执行力，能够在多方协同环境中主导复杂销售项目落地；

Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position OverviewTencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across APAC. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud's AI portfolio, including TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, leading third-party Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem, you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Sales teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will act as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, bringing customer feedback into product evolution while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides unified access to Tencent Hy and leading third-party LLMs through a single API, together with enterprise-grade inference, monitoring, deployment, and model management capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
ResponsibilitiesPartner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, Tencent Hy foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI services.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing solution performance in production environments.
Design scalable AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, influence product roadmap decisions, and continuously improve developer experience through real-world customer feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate AI adoption across enterprise customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Job RequirementsBachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of AI model deployment, inference services, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.
#LI-LS1

About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
A.	About Tencent
       Tencent is a leading global technology and entertainment company focused on connecting people and developing innovative products and services. Founded in 1998 and publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2004, Tencent’s communication and social services, entertainment (video games, music, sports, and film/TV), fintech, cloud, and enterprise solutions are used by hundreds of millions of people around the world.
       Tencent has been recognized as one of the “World’s Best Employers” (Forbes), including as one of the “Best Workplaces for New Graduates” (2026); one of the “World’s Most Admired Companies” (Fortune); and one of the “World’s Best Companies” (Time). In addition to its headquarters in Shenzhen, Tencent maintains offices across Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America, including Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Palo Alto, Los Angeles, New York, and Washington, D.C. To learn more about the company, visit www.Tencent.com (About Us). 
       B.	About the Role
       Tencent is seeking a highly motivated Associate, Global AI Policy to join its Global Public Affairs team in Palo Alto. This early-career position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, public policy, technology, and international affairs.
       The Associate will support Tencent's global AI policy efforts by researching emerging policy developments, monitoring legislative and regulatory activity, analyzing technology trends, and helping develop insights for Tencent businesses. The role will work closely with colleagues across public affairs, legal, compliance, and AI and Cloud product teams, while also engaging with external stakeholders including policymakers, think tanks, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society organizations.
       While the position will be based in Palo Alto, the successful candidate will contribute to Tencent's assessment and understanding of broader AI trends globally, including the US but also Europe, Asia-Pacific, etc.Policy Research & Analysis
Monitor and analyze developments related to artificial intelligence, including machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, semiconductors, and other emerging technologies.
Track and assess industry initiatives and policy developments in the United States and other key international markets.
Prepare concise policy briefings, research memoranda, presentations, and executive summaries for internal stakeholders.
Support analysis of AI policy trends and their potential implications for Tencent's business and technology strategy.
Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and policy developments relevant to Tencent's AI and cloud businesses.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with internal teams across public affairs, legal, compliance, product, engineering, and research functions.
Assist with the development of policy positions, consultation responses, and external-facing materials.
Support preparation for meetings, conferences, speaking engagements, and policy discussions.
Stakeholder Engagement
Assist in managing relationships with think tanks, academic institutions, trade associations, and policy organizations.
Support Tencent's participation in AI policy forums, conferences, workshops, and industry events.
Help coordinate internal and external meetings and maintain stakeholder engagement databases and tracking tools.

Who We Look For
We are looking for an intellectually curious individual who enjoys learning about complex issues and translating them into clear insights for business and policy teams. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, a disciplined researcher, and someone who is genuinely excited by the policy questions surrounding artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Successful candidates may come from leading universities, graduate programs, consulting firms, think tanks, policy research organizations, or technology companies. Most importantly, they should possess strong analytical instincts, sound judgment, and a desire to help shape the future of AI policy in a rapidly changing global environment.
Specific qualifications include:
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Relevant fields include Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Law, or related disciplines.
Strong interest in artificial intelligence, technology policy, innovation, and emerging technologies.
Exceptional research, writing, and analytical skills are required.
Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and multi-cultural environment.
Familiarity with AI governance, technology regulation, or digital/cloud policy preferred.
Mandarin with international teams preferred but not required 
Experience conducting quantitative or qualitative policy research.
Location State(s)
US-California-Palo Alto

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。
柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。
LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1.3Dモデリング
ゲーム内のキャラクター、環境、オブジェクトなどの3Dモデルを制作します。ゲームのテーマやストーリーに沿ったデザインを行います。
 2.テクスチャリングとシェーディング
モデルにリアルな質感を与えるためのテクスチャリングとシェーディング作業を行います。
3.リギングとアニメーションの準備
キャラクターやオブジェクトが自然に動くためのリギングを行い、アニメーターが使用するための準備をします。
4.アートスタイルの維持
ゲーム全体のアートスタイルに一貫性を持たせるため、他のアーティストと連携しながら作業を進めます。
5.ビジュアルコンセプトの実現
ゲームのビジュアルコンセプトに基づいて、アイデアを具体化し、魅力的なビジュアルを創り出します。
6.ドキュメント作成
作業手順や技術的なドキュメントを整備し、チーム内での情報共有を促進します。
Job Description
1. 3D Modeling
- Create 3D models of characters, environments, and objects for in-game use, ensuring designs align with the game's theme and story.
2. Texturing and Shading
- Perform texturing and shading tasks to give models realistic surface qualities.
3. Rigging and Animation Preparation
- Set up rigging for characters and objects to ensure natural movement and prepare them for use by animators.
4. Maintaining Art Style
- Work collaboratively with other artists to maintain consistency in the overall art style of the game.
5. Visual Concept Realization
- Bring ideas to life based on the game’s visual concept, creating appealing visuals.
6. Documentation
- Prepare work procedures and technical documents to facilitate information sharing within the team.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募資格
1.3Dアート制作の経験（AAAまたはAAプロジェクトが望ましい）
2.3Dモデリングツールの使用スキル（Maya、3ds Max、Blenderなど）
3.テクスチャリングおよびシェーディングに関する知識
4.3Aアクションゲームの開発経験（優遇）
5.優れた描写能力と創造力
6.チームでの協力とコミュニケーション能力
7.フォトリアルでの3Dモデル製作の経験(優遇)
Qualifications
- Experience in 3D art production (preferably in AAA or AA projects)
- Proficiency in using 3D modeling tools (such as Maya, 3ds Max, Blender)
- Knowledge of texturing and shading
- Experience in developing AAA action games(preferred)
- Strong drawing skills and creativity
- Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team
- Experience in creating photorealistic 3D models (preferred)

jobs.description:
Business Unit

jobs.requirementText:
岗位要求详情请见上方岗位职责内说明

岗位职责：
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced hire, we empower you to acquire and maintain professional qualifications, enhancing your credibility and competence in the finance domain while keeping you competitive in the ever-changing industry.

What the Role Entails
Join our dynamic Tencent Finance team as Financial Accounting and Analysis Intern where you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in real-world accounting and financial practices. You will be having the exposure to the end-to-end accounting and finance processes, focusing either on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Finance Operations, offering you tailored hands-on experience in the complex commercial and business environment. This role is designed to provide you with a deep understanding of financial processes, contributing directly to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial reporting and operations.
Responsibilities
Maintain and reconcile the General Ledger (GL), ensuring accurate and timely financial entries.
Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities, including account reconciliations, financial statement preparation, and variance analysis.
Verify, process, and manage Accounts Payable (AP) transactions, ensuring timely vendor payments and handling any discrepancies.
Support Accounts Receivable (AR) activities by assisting in customer invoicing, tracking payments, and managing overdue receivables.
Collaborate with teams to streamline Finance Operations, helping to enhance process efficiency and support financial audits by preparing relevant documentation.
Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards, contributing to continuous improvements across finance functions.

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accountancy or a related discipline.
Able to commit to a full-time internship for 4-6 months from November 2026/January 2027 onwards.
Demonstrated ability to apply accounting knowledge in practical scenarios, particularly in identifying and resolving issues.
Strong analytical and presentation skills.
Excellent written and spoken English required. Working proficiency in Mandarin required, as approximately 80% of the role involves coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and regional teams.

#LI-HC1

We are dedicated to delivering eng
jobs.requirementText:
岗位要求详情请见上方岗位职责内说明

岗位职责：
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
1. Develop the overall brand marketing strategy, positioning, and core messaging framework for the AAA driving game product before and after its global launch, ensuring consistent communication of the brand concept across regions worldwide.
2. Lead brand creative work throughout the product's full lifecycle from testing through post-launch, including creative planning and execution for key marketing milestones such as the global first reveal, test-phase promotions, integrated online and offline marketing campaigns, and launch events.
3. Develop a deep understanding of the core console/PC player ecosystem and global driving culture communities, formulate community growth and engagement strategies, maintain relationships with core players, and stimulate the content ecosystem.
4. Continuously track market trends in the driving and open-world racing categories, competitor developments, and player feedback, providing data-driven insights for marketing decisions and product optimization.
5. Collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams, including operations, UA, regional marketing teams, and platform partnership teams, integrate in-game resources with global and regional resources, and drive the quality execution of final solutions.
6. Deeply participate in the development and execution coordination of market strategies in key regions, ensuring localized messaging and precise localization are implemented within a globally consistent brand framework.

Who We Look For
1. Required Experience:
- 5+ years of experience in game industry marketing or brand roles.
- Proven experience successfully leading AAA console/PC game brand projects; candidates with experience in open-world, driving/racing, or RPG projects are preferred.
- Global market GTM marketing experience, with familiarity with player ecosystems in at least 2 regional markets (North America/Europe/Asia).
2. Core Competencies
- Deep understanding of driving culture and player psychology: Understands the appeal of automotive culture and the driving experience, and can accurately grasp the community language, emotional needs, and behavioral patterns of driving game players.
- Fluent English: Near-native written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to independently write English brand copy and creative briefs, understand the vision of overseas studios, and communicate seamlessly with international teams and overseas partners.
- Passion for games: Hardcore gamer with a deep understanding of the console/PC gaming ecosystem and familiarity with the full lifecycle of AAA game launch marketing. Hands-on experience with driving/racing games is preferred.
- Strategy and creativity: Possesses both systematic brand strategy thinking and sharp creative judgment, with the ability to lead end-to-end marketing output.
3. Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

Work Location: United Kingdom-London

jobs.requirementText:

岗位职责：
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
Responsibilities
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

岗位职责：
部署紹介/Business Unit
全世界で12億人以上のユーザーを誇る WeChat は、中国と世界中の人々、サービス、企業をつなぎ、モバイルの未来を大きく変革しています。海外市場で WeChat Pay として知られる Weixin Pay は、2013年にWeixinによって導入されたモバイル決済ソリューションです。銀行口座と Weixin Pay アカウントを連携させることで、ユーザーは迅速かつ便利で、安全な決済や取引をスムーズに完了できます。
中国国内では、Weixin Pay は日常生活のあらゆる場面に溶け込み、オンラインまたはオフラインを問わず、小売、飲食、交通、ヘルスケア、レジャーといったさまざまな分野で、効率的かつスマートな決済サービスを提供しています。日本においては、WeChat Pay チームが日本市場全体でのサービス拡大に尽力しています。
With over 1.2 billion users worldwide, WeChat is changing the mobile landscape by connecting people, services, and businesses in China and around-the world. Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner.
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
- ビジネスオペレーション（Business Operations）：Business Development（BD）チームと連携し、顧客関係の強化およびビジネス機会の開拓を推進。
- Key Account（KA）加盟店・機関と連携し、導入、販促物、キャンペーン施策等の推進を行う。
- 市場調査（Market Research）：以下を含むが、これらに限定されない。A. 店舗巡回（Store Inspection）：オフライン店舗を訪問し、販促物の設置状況を確認。B. 市場動向調査（Market Dynamics）：オンライン調査、業界レポート、現地訪問を通じて重要な市場情報を定期的に収集し、決済エコシステムの健全性を評価・比較。C. ユーザー調査（User Research）：現地訪問やオンラインアンケートを通じて、ユーザー浸透率およびユーザー体験に関するデータを収集。
- 販促物展開（Material Deployment）：機関側ではカバーが難しいエリアやシーンに対して、現地での販促物設置を実施。
- 協業開拓（Collaboration Exploration）：大学サークルや主要商業エリア等との連携を推進し、ユーザーコミュニティ向けマーケティング浸透を実施。現地で消費行動を観察し、調査・データ分析を行いながら、WeChatエコシステム内での協業機会を探索。

応募資格/Who We Look For
- 優れたコミュニケーション能力を持ち、積極的かつ熱意のある性格。中国語・日本語ともに流暢で、本社メンバーや海外ステークホルダーとの円滑な連携が可能
- 高いプロジェクトマネジメントおよび実行力を有し、質の高いサマリー・分析レポートを作成可能
- 高い主体性とセルフマネジメント能力を持ち、自律的かつ積極的に業務を推進・完遂できる
- WeChatおよびWeChat Payのプロダクトエコシステムへの理解がある

Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
1. Holistic Product Ownership: Lead the overall direction and vision for the corresponding casual game product. Develop clear product roadmaps and upgrade strategies to ensure creative implementation from 0 to 1 and sustained iterative growth from 1 to N, achieving generational leaps for the product.
2. R&D Coordination & Management: Establish and optimize the game R&D pipeline. Define development milestones and schedules, coordinating efficient collaboration among functional teams including design, art, and engineering. Establish cross-team communication mechanisms and processes to ensure smooth information flow and efficient decision-making, delivering development goals on time with high quality.

Proactively identify and resolve project risks and bottlenecks to ensure on-time launches and meet expected user satisfaction and business goals.

Ensure cross-cultural teams collaborate towards common goals and deliver high-quality content (if opportunities arise for co-development with internationally renowned game companies, proactive coordination and communication are required to ensure smooth cooperation).

1. Industry Experience: 10+ years of experience in game development, with 3+ years in a core Producer/Product Lead role, deeply involved in the mobile casual games domain.
2. Full-Cycle Ownership & Management: Excellent project management and coordination skills. Capable of leading product development from 0 to 1 through to version evolution from 1 to N and LiveOps, taking full responsibility for product quality and schedule throughout. Familiar with agile development processes, able to define clear milestones and drive the team to achieve them.
3. Strategic Mindset: Deeply understand user acquisition channels and product growth mechanisms in the overseas mobile game market. Familiar with UA buying, marketing, and monetization strategies. Possess a data-driven mindset, skilled at guiding product iteration through A/B testing and user data to improve key metrics (retention, LTV, etc.).
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and coordination skills, capable of bridging different departments such as product, R&D, and operations. Collaborate closely with functional teams like UA, Publishing, Marketing, and Monetization to ensure alignment between product development and market strategies.
5. Candidates with experiences in casual e-sports or casual runner games experiences will be preferred.

jobs.description:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap a
jobs.requirementText:
岗位要求详情请见上方岗位职责内说明

岗位职责：
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a senior game development expert with deep AAA production experience to strengthen co-development and technical partnership between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios.
The successful candidate will bring a strong technical art and animation background, with a particular focus on asset production and animation workflows. Instead of covering the full breadth of art disciplines, this role concentrates on AI-enabled asset creation, asset performance optimisation, asset visual fidelity and on the animation side skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.Participate in co-development projects between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios, providing senior expertise in AI-enabled asset production, asset performance optimisation, asset visual quality, skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.
Make AI-driven asset and animation improvement a central pillar of technical collaboration. Identify concrete opportunities across the full asset lifecycle (modelling, texturing, materials, LODs, performance profiling) and animation disciplines (skeleton generation, skinning, control rigs, cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics and ragdoll setups).
Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept projects that integrate AI tools with existing asset authoring tools, animation rigging environments, physics engines, and Unreal Engine or equivalent game engines.
Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.
Drive the transition of successful AI experiments into daily production workflows. Collect user feedback, refine asset and animation pipelines, and document repeatable implementation approaches for asset generation, optimisation, rigging automation and physics setup.
Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.
Document reusable AI use cases, asset pipeline standards, rigging and physics best practices, performance guidelines and evaluation methods. Share knowledge through workshops, technical reviews and project retrospectives.
Monitor trends in generative AI, neural rendering, procedural content generation, machine learning for deformation and physics, digital humans and real-time graphics, assessing their practical value for AAA asset and animation production.

Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Graphics, Digital Media, Game Development, Art and Design, Animation, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
At least 8 years of professional experience in technical art, animation technology or a closely related discipline, with significant exposure to AAA asset and animation pipelines.
Experience operating as a Senior Technical Artist, Lead Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, Animation Pipeline Lead, Rigging Lead or equivalent senior role with a clear focus on assets and/or animation.
Proven development experience on a recognised AAA game project, including at least one shipped AAA title where you were directly responsible for asset optimisation, rigging, or physics-animation workflows.
Strong understanding of the complete AAA asset and animation lifecycle, from initial modelling and rigging, through version control and validation, to engine integration, performance profiling and runtime optimisation.
Strong interest in generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, especially as applied to asset generation, asset optimisation, auto-rigging, motion synthesis, deformation prediction and physics simulation.
Ability to identify high-value AI opportunities rooted in real asset and animation production challenges and progress them through proof-of-concept, workflow design, tool integration and production adoption.
Strong experience with Unreal Engine or another major game engine, including real-time rendering, asset management, animation blueprints, physics assets and cross-platform performance constraints.
Proficiency in Blender or Maya; working knowledge of Houdini is a plus.
Experience with tools development or workflow automation using Python, C++, Blueprint or equivalent, particularly for asset processing, rigging automation or physics pipeline tools.
Strong problem-solving, solution design and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance asset quality, animation expressiveness, engineering feasibility and production efficiency.
Excellent English communication skills, able to lead technical discussions, conduct solution reviews, prepare documentation and collaborate effectively in an international environment.
Willingness to work across regions and time zones and to travel to partner studios in Europe or other locations when required.

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:
​​(1) AAA asset production pipelines (characters, environments, props) with a strong emphasis on performance optimisation, memory budgets, LOD strategies and visual consistency.
(2) Asset visual quality and efficiency: material authoring, texture optimisation, shading models, draw call management and cross-platform asset validation.
(3) Skeleton design and character/creature rigging: hierarchical structures, joint placement, modular rig systems, and auto-rigging methods.
(4) Skinning and deformation: linear blend skinning, dual quaternion skinning, corrective blendshapes, muscle systems and deformation quality control.
(5) Physics-based animation: cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics, ragdoll setups, secondary motion, and real-time physics constraints in engine.

岗位职责：

Level Infinite は、テンセントのグローバルゲームブランドとして、世界中のゲーム、開発チーム、スタジオにワンストップなサービスネットワークを提供するグローバルなゲームパブリッシャーです。私たちは、いつでもどこでも、誰もが楽しめる魅力的で独創的なゲーム体験を提供すると同時に、包容力があり、すべてのプレイヤーを繋ぐコミュニティの育成に尽力しています。また、Level Infiniteは、世界中の開発者やパートナースタジオに対し、幅広いサービスとリソースを提供することで、ゲームに秘められたポテンシャルを最大限に引き出すサポートも行っています。
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world. We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
パブリッシング プロデューサーは、担当スタジオと連携し、高品質なグローバルパブリッシング戦略を推進することが役割です。本ポジションは、データ分析を踏まえたGTM（Go-To-Market）戦略、インサイト、オペレーション構築・リソース管理、クロスファンクショナル連携、そしてキャンペーン運営の卓越性を組み合わせたものです。
この役割では、スタジオのリーダーシップと直接連携し、パブリッシングロードマップの策定、Tencent のグローバル基準との整合性の確保、パブリッシングの優先順位の設定、そしてマーケティング、コンテンツ、商業戦略、リサーチ、プラットフォームなど広範な領域で遂行の支援を行います。
理想的な候補者は、戦略的思考、分析力、構造的なアプローチ、高い協働力を兼ね備え、複数市場でのゲームパブリッシング、複雑なクロスリージョン環境、そしてパブリッシングプロセスの実務経験を有する方です。スタジオパートナーシップ
明確で具体的な価値を継続的に提供することで、スタジオとの強い信頼関係を構築する。
スタジオリーダーの戦略的パートナーとして実務的な助言を行い、透明性のあるコミュニケーションを提供し、Tencent のリソースにつなぐ役割を担う。
パブリッシング戦略
スタジオと共にグローバルパブリッシング戦略とワークフローを共同リードする。
パブリッシングの準備状況、GTM 方向性、マーケティングアプローチを体系的に評価する。
Tencent のグローバル機能をスタジオのパイプラインに統合する。
長期的なパブリッシング計画を明確な責任範囲と意思決定プロセスとともに整合させる。
GTM & キャンペーンリード
ポジショニング、セグメンテーション、コンテンツロードマップ、KPI、キャンペーン構造などGTM 立案をリードする。
インサイトチームと連携し、リサーチ、競合分析、プレイテスト、データに基づく提案を GTM の基盤として取り入れる。
クリエイティブアセットや拡散戦略のレビューと検証を行う。
スタジオのパブリッシング計画を広げるためのビジネス機会やパートナーシップを特定する。
キャンペーンの KPI を追跡し、ライフサイクル全体を通じて最適化案を提示する。
オペレーション & クロスファンクショナル調整
スタジオ内および Tencent リソース間のマーケティング、コンテンツ、コミュニティ、PR、商業、プラットフォームなどのチームとの整合を推進する。
効率的なパブリッシングワークフローとレポーティング体制をスタジオと共に確立する。
ROI とマイルストーンに基づいた予算運用の効率性を評価する。
Tencent チームとスタジオリーダーシップの間で、パブリッシング関連の明確なコミュニケーションを促進する。
市場 & パフォーマンス評価
グローバルパブリッシングに関連する市場動向、プラットフォームの変化、競合の動きを監視し、スタジオを知見で支援する。
プロダクト品質、ゲームプレイの完成度、ユーザーの反応を評価し、改善提案につなげる。
リーダーシップ & メンタリング
スタジオ、外部パートナー、Tencent チームと強く協働的な関係を構築する。
パブリッシング担当者を指導し、スタジオおよび Tencent のパブリッシング水準の向上に貢献する。

応募資格/Who We Look For
経験・専門性： 
ゲームパブリッシング、GTM、またはスタジオ支援業務における 12 年以上の経験。 パブリッシング戦略、インサイト、クリエイティブ／コンテンツ、商業、プラットフォームなどグローバルパブリッシングフレームワークの深い理解。

人物像：
 協働的で柔軟、プロアクティブかつ戦略と実務のバランスを持った方。

jobs.requirementText:

岗位职责：
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
Job Responsibilities●Research and develop advanced speech synthesis and generation algorithms (e.g., TTS, voice conversion, sound/music generation) based on LLMs, multimodal/omnimodal LLMs.
●Develop and optimize speech and audio synthesis systems for online applications, improving effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability.
●Explore and advance full-duplex/streaming multimodal LLM capabilities in speech understanding, generation, and real-time spoken interaction.
●Collaborate cross-functionally with research and engineering teams from prototyping to production.

岗位职责
● 基于大语言模型（LLM）及多模态/全模态大模型，研究和开发前沿语音合成与生成算法（如 TTS、语音转换、声音/音乐生成等）。
● 开发和优化面向线上应用的语音及音频合成系统，提升效果、效率和可扩展性。
● 探索并推进全双工/流式多模态大模型在语音理解、语音生成及实时语音交互方面的能力。
● 与研究和工程团队跨职能协作，推动项目从原型验证到生产落地。

Who We Look For
Requirements
●Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or a closely related field.
●Strong foundation in speech/audio processing and modern generative models (e.g., diffusion, flow matching, autoregressive, codec-based approaches).
●Hands-on experience extending LLMs to speech/audio modalities (e.g., speech tokenizers, multimodal adapters, speech-text joint training). Experience with full-duplex or streaming spoken dialogue systems and real-time interaction modeling is a plus.
●Proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch); experience with distributed training is a plus.
●Track record of publications at top-tier venues (e.g., ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, ICASSP, Interspeech).
●Mandarin Chinese / Business-level Japanese or English
任职要求

What the Role Entails
1. Migration Architecture Design & Hands-on Implementation:
Design architecture migration solutions for public cloud customers. Focus on deep technical implementation for migrating overseas mainstream stacks (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) to Tencent Cloud WeData + DLC/EMR (storage-compute separation architecture). Deploy migration environments, execute data synchronization, and perform business cutovers on the front line.
2. End-to-End Project Management & Delivery: Take ownership of the overall project schedule, risk control, and technical solution governance. Coordinate internal and external resources to overcome organizational and technical barriers, ensuring the successful final delivery of the migration project.
3. Process Assurance & Technical Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting and resolving complex issues during migration. Ensure a fast and smooth transition to the cloud by managing data consistency, business continuity, and providing comprehensive technical guidance.
4. Deep Technical Optimization: Provide full-stack technical support, including but not limited to SQL syntax automated conversion/rewriting, Spark/Flink operator tuning, and post-migration performance benchmarking. Ensure that business performance on Tencent Cloud meets or exceeds expectations.
5. Product-Research Collaboration & Best Practices: Work closely with Solution Architects (SA) to professionally summarize and feed back real-world customer requirements, pain points, and tool defects. Assist SAs in refining migration roadmaps and co-authoring "Best Practice Manuals" for migrating from overseas cloud platforms to Tencent Cloud.

Who We Look For
1. Hardcore Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or related fields; 5+ years of experience in Big Data. Proficient in at least one programming language (Java, Scala, or Python) with strong coding skills and logic conversion capabilities.
2. Overseas Stack Expertise: Familiar with the architecture and use cases of at least one major product: BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake. Understand the differences between these and open-source ecosystems (Spark, Hive); cross-cloud migration experience is a plus.
3. System Analysis & Large-scale Management: Strong capability in system problem analysis and resolving complex architectural issues. Proven experience in cluster performance tuning, troubleshooting, source code optimization, and version upgrades; experience managing large-scale clusters (1000+ nodes) is preferred.
4. Migration Delivery Experience: Extensive experience in Big Data migration implementation and management. Master common migration workflows and methodologies for big data components. Familiar with mainstream vendor platforms and a proven track record of delivering large-scale cloud migration projects (PB-level).
5. Core Component Principles: Deep understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, with source-code level or deep tuning experience in HDFS, Yarn, Spark, Hive, Flink, Doris, Iceberg/Hudi, etc. Capable of handling underlying compatibility issues in heterogeneous environments.
6. Soft Skills & Professionalism: Excellent customer service awareness, communication, and resource coordination skills. Proactive, self-driven, and highly responsible. Able to thrive under pressure in cross-cloud and overseas migration scenarios.

About Tencent
Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen, China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.
We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. We offer a range of services such as cloud computing, advertising, FinTech, and other enterprise services to support our clients' digital transformation and business growth.
We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward.

Job Overview
Tencent is seeking a seasoned communications specialist to drive the global communications strategy primarily for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, and secondarily support Tencent's corporate communications across Northeast Asiaa market.

This is a strategic, high-impact role for a communications professional who can blend cultural fluency, strategic rigor, and creative instinct to shape how Tencent Games in global market. You will be the in-market communications partner for our portfolio of world-class studios and titles, the steward of regional media relationships, and a key advisor to global and regional leadership on reputation, narrative, and market dynamics.

The role is based in Tokyo or Seoul. You will report on a solid line to the Head of Tencent Games Global Communications, and on a dotted line to the Head of Tencent APAC Corporate Communications, working at the intersection of Tencent Games' global
comms function and Tencent's broader corporate reputation agenda in the region.● Define and own the communications strategy for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, translating global priorities into locally resonant strategy and narratives that build relevance, trust, and player affinity.
● Drive communications for Tencent Games' portfolio — including published titles and partner studios — across the full product lifecycle in in Northeast Asia market.
● Partner across studios, publishing, marketing, legal, compliance, public affairs, and global comms peers to deliver integrated, well-aligned communications strategy.
● Manage PR agency partners and coordinate with internal stakeholders to drive quality execution, effective resource allocation and measurable communications outcomes.
● With a primary focus on coordinating and executing media communications plans for Tencent's game business in Japan and Korea, including the planning and execution of media events such as press briefings, exhibitions, open days, media tours and executive engagements.
● Support communications needs across Tencent's business groups, namely social communications, digital content, payment, enterprise solutions, in Northeast Asia.
● Build and maintain relationships with the media and relevant external partners to support Tencent's game business and and other business groups, corporate reputation effort in Japan and Korea.
● Lead local content planning and contribution for Tencent's owned channels in Japan and Korea, including social media platforms, websites, newsletters and other corporate communications materials, as well as gather and localize content from internal teams to ensure locally relevant messaging across channels.
● Monitor local media landscape, industry trends and public sentiment, and support issues management and crisis communications in Japan and Korea, working closely with Game Global Comms team/APAC Corporate Communications, business teams, legal and policy teams where needed.

Who We Look For
● 5+ years of experience in PR, corporate communications, or media relations, ideally with meaningful experience at a global company or top-tier international communications agency.
● Solid, hands-on craft across the core PR disciplines — strategy and messaging development, executive and editorial writing, media pitching and event execution, issues and crisis management, spokesperson preparation, and reputation management.

● a video gamer.

Multiplayer online games

Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Strategic Sales Manager to be based in Amsterdam. The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and managing Tencent Cloud’s most important strategic accounts in the Netherlands. This role requires a strategic mindset to define sales priorities, develop and execute action plans, exceed cloud sales targets, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders in target accounts. The individual will play a critical role in driving cloud revenue growth, securing new large strategic clients—especially in Retail, telecom, eCommerce, Gaming —and leading the negotiation and management of high-value contracts.
Key Responsibilities
Own the full sales cycle: from prospecting and lead generation to closing contracts and driving account expansion.
Build and manage executive-level (C-level) relationships to become a trusted advisor.
Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve and exceed sales quotas.
Act as a product expert on Tencent Cloud's digital native offerings, crafting solution-based proposals.
Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Legal, and Finance to deliver value and close complex deals.

Experience: 10+ years of B2B sales experience in technology/cloud/digital sectors, with a proven track record of selling complex solutions to C-level executives.

・ナラティブやシステムとの整合性の確保
ストーリー展開やゲームシステムと整合性を持たせながら、シームレスに進行するレベル体験を設計します。
・プレイテストとレベルチューニング

・Design and Construction of In-Game Level Layouts Plan and create gameplay spaces that include stage structures, enemy placement, gimmicks, player routes, and exploration elements, crafting engaging experiences for players.

・Ensuring Narrative and System Consistency Design seamless level experiences that align with story progression and game systems.
・Playtesting and Level Tuning Conduct user tests and in-development play sessions to verify the fun factor, clarity of routes, and pacing of levels, making continuous improvements based on feedback.
・Map Creation and Implementation Using Tools Use in-engine tools and level editors to create maps, place objects, and handle implementation in accordance with specifications.

４、负责规划游戏产品的自动化和持续集成建设，提升测试和项目工程效率。负责行业优秀自动化测试工具平台的引入及搭建，提升整体交付质量；
5、负责构建有效的评估模型和评估方法，结合业务特点进行量化分析。

About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Marketing Manager to join our team working on a range of exciting AAA multiplayer shooter games. 
You'll be responsible for developing and executing fully integrated campaigns using data driven insights and internal resources to deliver measurable results in a fast-paced, competitive and dynamic market.
With an innate passion for all-things gaming, you're experience will help build and steer our campaigns to success, from launch and beyond.
Responsibilities
Develop and activate comprehensive marketing plans that align with company objectives, including market research, target audience identification, and channel selection.
Collaborate with cross functional teams including insights, UA/paid media, regional marketing teams, 1st parties and external agencies to fully leverage resources to ensure delivery of the plan. Working closely with development studios while building and maintaining relationships will be key to the role.
Keep a close eye on market trends, sharing insights that can steer campaign strategy and provide constructive and effective suggestions for the team to maintain engagement and drive innovation throughout.

Who We Look For
To be perfectly qualified, we expect you to be -
5+ years’ working in the video game industry with AAA global game publishing experience.
In depth knowledge of the European/ North American video games industry and broad understanding of channels within (social media, regulatory factors, commercial models, and format nuances across console & PC).
Skilled at project management to proactively bring initiatives and deliverables to completion and escalate obstacles throughout the projects life-cycle.
Exemplify a passion for data and consumer insight driven decision making with an ability to analyze and utilize data to create strategic frameworks that lead to successful GTM execution and operational excellence.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.
Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions and regions in multicultural organization.
Passion for gaming and a deep understanding of player motivations, preferences, and behaviors, particularly within the "Shooter" genre.
English fluency is mandatory as the working language; Mandarin proficiency will be regarded as a strong plus.

Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner.
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more.
