仕事内容/What the Role Entails
About Tencent
Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.
We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a startup with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.
About WeChat Pay
With over 1.2 billion users worldwide, WeChat is changing the mobile landscape by connecting people, services, and businesses in China and around-the world. Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner. 
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.
【仕事内容】
1.主な目標は、日本のWeChat決済加盟店の効果的なカバレッジと市場シェアを改善することです。
2.日本のビジネス形態、加盟店、開拓チャネルの完全な理解に基づいて、市場機会を発見し、WeChatとTencentのリソースを統合し、地域拡販計画を策定し、エグゼキューションを効果的に実施します。
3.日本におけるWeChat Payの健全な発展を達成するために、地域のサービスプロバイダーおよびパートナーの管理および事業開発を実施します。

ゲームの根幹となるルールや進行フロー、各種システム（成長、装備、スキル、経済など）を設計し、プレイヤー体験の中核を担います。
・システム間の連携設計
戦闘、育成、収集、経済など各種システムが相互に連携し、統一感あるゲーム体験となるように設計します。
・UX観点でのシステム設計
ユーザー視点での操作性・理解性を意識し、分かりやすく直感的なUI/UXを実現するための仕様設計を行います。
・バランス調整およびデータ設計
成長カーブ、報酬設計、リソースのインフレ管理など、数値やデータの設計・調整を行い、ゲームの長期的な面白さと持続性を支えます。
・仕様書の作成とチーム連携
仕様や意図を明確にしたドキュメントを作成し、プログラマー、アーティスト、QAなど他職種との円滑な連携を図ります。
Job Description
・Design and Development of Core Game Systems Plan and build the fundamental rules, progression flow, and key systems (growth, equipment, skills, economy, etc.) that form the backbone of the player experience.
・Inter-System Integration Design Ensure combat, progression, collection, economy, and other systems interact cohesively to deliver a unified and engaging gameplay experience.
・System Design from a UX Perspective Design specifications that prioritize intuitive, easy-to-understand UI/UX, ensuring smooth operation and player comprehension.
・Balancing and Data Design Plan and adjust parameters such as growth curves, reward systems, and resource inflation control to maintain long-term engagement and game sustainability.
・Specification Documentation and Cross-Team Collaboration Create clear and detailed documentation of system specifications and intentions, facilitating smooth collaboration with programmers, artists, QA, and other disciplines.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件 
・アクションゲームやオンラインゲームにおけるゲームシステム設計の実務経験
・パラメータ設計、報酬設計、インフレ調整など、数値バランス設計のスキル

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容 
１、ゲーム内のサウンドシステム開発 リアルタイムオーディオシステム、音声再生制御、環境音処理、7.1.4 Dolby Atmos対応3Dサウンド機能など、ゲーム体験を強化する音響システムをディレクターや実機の要件を元に設計・実装します。
２、ミドルウェア（Wwise/ADX2等）のUE5への組み込みと独自カスタマイズ オーディオミドルウェアを活用し、UE5との連携・拡張機能の開発・実装を担当します。
３、サウンドデザイナーとの連携とツール開発 サウンドデザイナーが効率よく実装・調整できるように、オーディオエディタやデバッグツールの開発・保守を行います。
４、サウンドデータの最適化 ハードウェアリソースやパフォーマンスを考慮し、メモリ管理、音声データ・ストリーミング処理の設計および最適化を行います。 ５、オーディオイベントの制御実装 ゲームプレイに連動したサウンドイベントの制御や、キャラクター・UI・環境音など多岐にわたるオーディオ制御ロジックを設計、実装します。
６、プロシージャルオーディオの研究開発 社内技研との協力のもと、AI等駆使しつつUE5でのプロシージャルオーディオエンジンの設計・実装
７、ペリフェラルの振動設計および実装
Job Description
・In-game sound system development Design and implement audio systems that enhance the game experience—such as real-time audio systems, sound playback control, environmental sound processing, and 7.1.4 Dolby Atmos–compatible 3D sound—based on director instructions and hardware requirements.
・Middleware (Wwise / ADX2, etc.) integration into UE5 with custom extensions Utilize audio middleware to handle UE5 integration, develop extended features, and perform custom implementations.
・Collaboration with sound designers and tool development Develop and maintain audio editors and debugging tools to help sound designers efficiently implement and fine-tune audio assets.
・Sound data optimization Optimize memory usage, design streaming and audio data processing, and improve performance with hardware resource constraints in mind.
・Audio event control implementation Design and implement control logic for sound events tied to gameplay, including character sounds, UI audio, environmental sounds, and other diverse audio categories.
・Procedural audio research and development In collaboration with the company’s R&D division, design and implement procedural audio engines for UE5, leveraging AI and other advanced techniques.
・Peripheral vibration design and implementation

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件
・サウンドプログラマーまたはゲームプログラマーとしての実務経験
・C++やC#などのプログラミングスキル ・オーディオミドルウェア（Wwise、ADX2等）を使用した開発経験
・サウンドデザイナーとの協業経験、またはそれに準ずる理解
・コンソールまたはPCにてAA以上のタイトル開発経験
・UE5実装知識 歓迎スキル
・マルチプラットフォーム（家庭用ゲーム機・PC・モバイル）向けのサウンド開発経験
・リアルタイムサウンド処理、DSPや音響プラグイン制作の専門知識
・DAWやオーディオツールに関する技術的理解およびスクリプト制作
・波形解析知識
Qualifications
・Professional experience as a sound programmer or game programmer
・Programming skills in C++ and/or C#
・Experience developing with audio middleware (Wwise, ADX2, etc.)
・Experience collaborating with sound designers, or equivalent understanding
・Development experience on console or PC titles at AA scale or above
・Working knowledge of UE5 implementation Preferred Skills
・Experience in audio development for multiple platforms (consoles, PC, mobile)
・Expertise in real-time audio processing, DSP, and audio plugin development
・Technical understanding of DAWs and audio tools, including script creation
・Knowledge of waveform analysis

チームのリギング関連の責任者として、アニメーターをサポートし、外部ベンダーと連携しながら高品質なリギングの制作を担当します。
具体的な業務内容は以下の通りです：
①既存のリグ案を検証し、プロジェクトにおける最終的なリグ仕様・方針を策定する
②外部ベンダーによるリグ作業の品質を管理し、プロジェクトの要件を満たすようにする
③リグ関連のツールを開発・保守する
④MocapからMaya、最終的にUnreal Engineへの実装フローにおける課題をツール開発によって解決する（※オプション）
⑤既存のツールをベースに、LiveLinkのツールフローを構築・保守する（※オプション）

As the Rigging Lead, you will support animators and collaborate with external vendors to produce high-quality rigs. Your main responsibilities include:
1. Reviewing existing rig proposals and establishing the final rig specifications and direction for the project.
2. Managing the quality of rigging work provided by external vendors to ensure it meets project requirements.
3. Developing and maintaining rigging-related tools.
4. (Optional) Solving issues in the pipeline from motion capture to Maya to Unreal Engine through tool development.
5. (Optional) Building and maintaining the LiveLink tool workflow based on existing tools.

必須スキル：
・Mayaにおけるリギング関連ツールの開発経験

・Perforce等のバージョン管理ツールの使用経験
歓迎スキル（オプション）：
・Unreal Engine用プラグインの開発経験
・モーションキャプチャシステムの使用経験
・補助骨、Blendshape、Pose Driver等のMayaおよびUEへの実装経験

Application Requirements
Required Skills:
Experience developing rigging-related tools in Maya
At least 3 years of hands-on rigging experience using Maya
Experience using version control tools such as Perforce

Preferred Skills (Optional):
Experience developing plugins for Unreal Engine
Experience using motion capture systems
Experience implementing helper bones, blendshapes, and pose drivers in both Maya and Unreal Engine

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1.戦闘システムの設計
攻撃、回避、防御、スキルの使用といった基本的な戦闘メカニクスをデザインし、プレイヤーにとって心地よい操作性とバランスを実現します。
2.敵キャラクターおよびボスのデザイン
敵の動きや攻撃パターン、特性を設定し、プレイヤーにとっての挑戦と達成感を考慮したバトル体験を提供します。ボス戦における戦略的な要素やエキサイティングな演出も企画します。
3.バトルバランスの調整
プレイヤーのスキルや装備に応じて適切なバランスを維持し、ゲームの難易度が適度に保たれるよう、数値や敵の配置を調整します。
4.プレイテストとフィードバック分析
戦闘の快適さ、爽快感、戦略性が維持されているかをテストし、プレイヤーのフィードバックを基にバトルの改善・調整を行います。
5.仕様書やデザイン資料の作成
戦闘システムの仕様書やデザインに関するドキュメントを作成し、他部門が理解できるように情報を整理して伝えます
Job Description
1. Designing Combat Systems
- Design fundamental combat mechanics such as attacks, dodges, defense, and skill usage to ensure smooth gameplay and balance for the player.
2. Designing Enemy Characters and Bosses
- Create enemy movements, attack patterns, and characteristics to provide a challenging and rewarding battle experience for players. Plan strategic elements and exciting features for boss battles.
3. Adjusting Battle Balance
- Maintain appropriate balance according to the player’s skills and equipment, ensuring the game’s difficulty remains fair by adjusting numbers and enemy placement.
4. Playtesting and Feedback Analysis
- Test the comfort, excitement, and strategic nature of combat and make improvements and adjustments based on player feedback.
5. Creating Specifications and Design Documents
- Prepare documents detailing the specifications of combat systems and related designs, organizing and communicating information clearly to other departments.

アクションゲームやAAAタイトルにおけるコンバットデザインの経験（優遇）

プレイテストや数値調整を通じてバトルバランスを取る能力
戦闘システムや敵デザインに関する詳細な資料や仕様書を作成する能力
プログラムおよびアニメーションの基礎知識がある方（尚可）
明確で詳細なドキュメントを作成する能力
Qualifications
- Experience in combat design for action games or AAA titles (preferred)
- Knowledge of enemy movements and attack patterns, along with AI design skills
- Ability to balance battles through playtesting and numerical adjustments
- Ability to create detailed documentation and specifications related to combat systems and enemy design
- Basic knowledge of programming and animation (preferred)
- Ability to create clear and detailed documentation

仕事内容
モーションTAとして、アニメーターをサポートし、アニメーション品質の向上を目指します。
具体的な業務内容は以下の通りです：
①Control Rig、Animation Blueprint、Motion Matching、Ragdollなどの技術を活用し、ゲーム内のキャラクターアニメーションの品質を向上させます。
プレイヤーが操作時に感じる即時的なレスポンスを実現しつつ、動作が自然かつリアルに見えるようにします。
②さまざまなフェイシャル技術を検証し、最適なソリューションを選定することで、カットシーンにおける表情表現の品質を次世代AAAレベルまで引き上げます。
③モーションキャプチャに関連する技術的な課題に対してサポートを提供します。

Job Description
As a Motion Technical Artist (Motion TA), you will support animators and aim to improve the quality of animations. Your specific responsibilities will include:
1. Enhancing in-game character animation quality by utilizing technologies such as Control Rig, Animation Blueprint, Motion Matching, and Ragdoll.
You will ensure that player-controlled animations respond instantly while maintaining natural and realistic movement.
2. Evaluating various facial animation technologies and selecting the optimal solution to elevate facial expression quality in cutscenes to next-generation AAA standards.
3. Providing technical support for motion capture-related challenges.

歓迎スキル
・Motion Matchingに関する経験
・Mayaでのリギング・スキニングの経験
・RBF（Radial Basis Function）技術の知識
・ML Deformerに関する経験

Job Requirements
Required Skills
Understanding and hands-on experience with retargeting
Experience implementing motion assets in Unreal Engine
Experience using Control Rig
Experience using Animation Blueprint
Experience with State Machines, Blend Spaces, and Transitions
Experience with version control tools such as Perforce
Experience using motion capture systems

Preferred Skills
Experience with Motion Matching
Rigging and skinning experience in Maya
Knowledge of RBF (Radial Basis Function) technology
Experience with ML Deformer

岗位职责：
チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。
柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。
LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1. 物語およびキャラクター設定の構築
ゲームのストーリー全体やキャラクターの背景、個性を設計し、物語のテーマやメッセージを明確にします。
2. シーンやイベントのデザイン
ゲーム内のカットシーンやイベントシーンの演出を企画し、物語の展開を支えるシーンを細かくデザインします。プレイヤーが物語に没入できるよう、感動的なシナリオを描きます。
3. 台詞およびテキストの執筆
キャラクターの台詞やナレーション、プレイヤーが出会うテキストの執筆を担当し、キャラクターの個性や物語の進行を効果的に表現します。
4. 分岐ストーリーおよびインタラクションの設計
プレイヤーの選択や行動がストーリーに影響を与える分岐や選択肢を設計し、プレイヤーの没入感を高めます。
5. 他部門との連携
アート、アニメーション、サウンドなどの他部門と協力し、ナラティブ要素が視覚的、聴覚的に伝わるよう調整します。シーンの演出やカットシーンに合わせたストーリー構成を実現します。
Job Description
1. Story and Character Development
- Design the overall game story, character backgrounds, and personalities, clarifying the themes and messages of the narrative.
2. Scene and Event Design
- Plan and design the direction of in-game cutscenes and event scenes, supporting story progression with detailed and impactful scenes to enhance player immersion and create emotional scenarios.
3. Dialogue and Text Writing
- Responsible for writing character dialogues, narration, and in-game text that players encounter, effectively conveying character traits and advancing the story. 4. Design of Branching Stories and Interactions
- Create branching storylines and choices that are influenced by player decisions and actions, increasing player engagement and immersion.
5. Collaboration with Other Departments
- Work closely with departments such as art, animation, and sound to ensure that narrative elements are conveyed visually and audibly, aligning the story structure with scene direction and cutscenes.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募資格
ゲームまたはエンターテインメント業界でのナラティブデザイン経験（優遇）
ストーリーテリング、キャラクター作成、台詞執筆のスキル
プレイヤーの感情を引き出すストーリーテリング能力
プレイヤーの行動に基づいたインタラクティブなストーリー設計ができる方
他部門と連携しながら物語を形作るためのコミュニケーションスキル
Qualifications
- Experience in narrative design within the gaming or entertainment industry (preferred)
- Skills in storytelling, character creation, and dialogue writing
- Ability to craft storytelling that evokes player emotions
- Capability to design interactive stories that respond to player actions
- Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with other departments to shape the narrative

一緒に働く魅力/Why Join Us?
勤務地
大阪（JR大阪駅JP TOWER OSAKA）、東京（虎ノ門ヒルズビジネスタワー）※希望に添います
賃金
年収額：応相談（昇給/賞与あり）
※経験・スキル等を考慮し、当社規定により優遇します。

健康保険 、雇用保険、 労災保険、 厚生年金保険、 総合福祉団体定期保険（GTL）
業務災害安心総合保険（GPA）、団体長期障害所得補償保険（GLTD）

通勤手当(上限5万円/月) 、通信手当（上限1万円/月）、 自己啓発手当（上限2万円/月）、 平日に出社した場合食事補助1800円/日、定期健診手当（上限7万5千円/年1回）

LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1. テンセントLighSpeedスタジオの次世代コンソールゲームプロジェクトにおいて、製品特性に適した音声デザインおよび実施プランを策定する。
2.音声デザインの計画に基づき、要件の調整、リソースの制作および統合、テスト検証と最適化を行い、ゲームの最終的なサウンド品質を管理する。
Job Description
1. Formulate sound design and implementation plans suitable for product features for Tencent LightSpeed Studio's next-generation console game projects.
2. Based on the sound design plan, coordinate requirements, create and integrate resources, conduct testing and optimization, and manage the final sound quality of the game.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募資格
1.5年以上のゲーム音声制作経験があり、AAAクオリティの高品質ゲーム音声デザインにフルタイムで参加経験があること。ゲーム音声制作の全体フローに精通。
2.高いサウンドデザイン能力を持ち、音声録音、処理、ミキシングを効率よく行える。DAWソフト（Digital Audio Workstation）を1つ以上使いこなすことができ、エフェクターやシンセサイザーなどの音響設計ツールの実用的なスキルを有する。
3.サウンドデザインとパイプライン構築能力に優れ、Wwiseなどの音声ミドルウェアを使いこなせる。UnityやUEなどのゲームエンジンの基本操作に精通している。
4.日本語必須、英語か中国語でコミュニケーションできる方大歓迎。
5.プロジェクト管理スキルがあり、チーム内外で調整してニーズを期限内に確実に実行できる。
6.熱心なゲーマーで、ゲームとゲーム音声に対する情熱を持ち、ゲームプレイと音声デザインの関係について独自の理解がある。
7.独立してプロジェクトを進める能力と、チームで協力して仕事を進める能力の両方があり、学習能力とチームワークを重視する。
Requirements
1. Over 5 years of experience in game sound production, with full-time participation in high-quality, AAA-standard game sound design, and a comprehensive understanding of the entire game sound production process.
2. Strong sound design skills, including efficient audio recording, processing, and mixing capabilities. Proficiency in using at least one DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) software and practical skills in sound design tools such as effects processors and synthesizers.
3. Excellent abilities in sound design and pipeline construction, with proficiency in audio middleware such as Wwise. Familiarity with basic operations of game engines such as Unity and Unreal Engine (UE).
4. Japanese fluency is required; candidates who can communicate in English or Chinese are highly welcomed.
5. Project management skills with the ability to coordinate within and outside the team to meet needs on time.
6. A passionate gamer with a deep interest in game sound and a unique understanding of the relationship between gameplay and sound design.
7. The ability to independently lead projects and work collaboratively as part of a team, with a focus on learning and teamwork.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

1. 製品の要件やアーキテクチャを分析し、テスト方法およびテストケースの設計を担当します。
2. 製品の機能、システム性能、プラットフォームの互換性、APIインターフェースのテストなどのテスト業務を担当し、製品運用中に品質問題を発見、収集、明確化し、それらの解決を推進および追跡します。
3. 同種製品の分析、安定性分析、システム信頼性などの特定テスト業務を担当し、具体的なテスト活動の計画と実施を行います。
4. ゲーム製品における自動化および継続的インテグレーション（CI）の構築を企画・推進し、テストおよびプロジェクト全体の開発効率を向上させる。 業界で優れた自動化テストツール・プラットフォームの導入・構築を担当し、全体のデリバリー品質を高める。
5. 有効な評価モデルおよび評価方法を構築し、業務の特徴に基づいて定量的な分析を実施します。
1、负责分析产品需求、架构，设计测试方法和测试用例；
2、负责产品功能、系统性能、平台兼容性、API接口测试等测试工作，在产品运营过程中发现、收集、暴露质量问题并推动和跟踪问题的解决；
3、负责同类产品分析、稳定性分析、系统可靠性等专项测试工作，对具体的测试活动进行规划实施；
４、负责规划游戏产品的自动化和持续集成建设，提升测试和项目工程效率。负责行业优秀自动化测试工具平台的引入及搭建，提升整体交付质量；
5、负责构建有效的评估模型和评估方法，结合业务特点进行量化分析。

応募資格/Who We Look For
1. コンピュータソフトウェア関連の学士号以上を有していること
2. 論理的思考力に優れ、良好なコミュニケーション・調整力、推進力を備えていること
3. ソフトウェア工学の基礎知識を有し、ソフトウェアテストに関する理論や手法に精通していること
4. コンピュータに関する理論的基礎がしっかりしており、オペレーティングシステムやネットワークの基本原理を熟知していること
5. 卓越を追求し、細部まで注意を払えること。ユーザー視点に立って物事を考える姿勢を持ち、原則を守り、優れた学習能力と独立した思考習慣を備えていること
【歓迎条件】
1. 1種類以上のプログラミング言語に精通している方
2. コーディング能力に優れ、各種デバッグツールの使用経験がある方
1、计算机软件相关专业本科或及以上学历；
2、逻辑思维能力强，具备较好的沟通协调能力和推动力；
3、掌握软件工程基础知识，熟悉软件测试理论和方法；
4、有扎实的计算机理论基础，熟练掌握操作系统及网络的基本原理
5、追求卓越、工作细致、能站在用户的角度思考，坚持原则，具备良好的学习能力和独立思考习惯
better to have:
掌握1门以上编程语言； 具备扎实的代码编写能力，熟悉各类常用debug类工具

Our Platform Engineering team sits at the core of ByteDance’s global traffic infrastructure. We build and operate the edge cloud product system and resource operation framework that powers TikTok’s worldwide services.
We constantly iterate our product models and workflows, apply modern engineering best practices, and keep our entire infrastructure stable, efficient, and cost-effective — ultimately delivering a better experience for both internal teams and external users.
- Edge cloud product development : We build foundational edge computing products, including bare-metal and virtual machine services. We keep refining user experience, optimizing resource delivery, and improving inventory efficiency to better support business growth.
- Global resource operation platform : We’ve built a unified three-tier architecture based on resource data warehouses, cost & billing systems, and resource management platforms. Our team optimizes global resource pool scheduling, improves resource utilization, and drives continuous cost reduction and business scalability.

Job Summary
Join ByteDance’s Global Traffic Infrastructure (GTI) team to build and scale the edge cloud and global traffic platform that powers TikTok’s worldwide service delivery. You will focus on edge resource orchestration, traffic scheduling, cloud resource governance, and platform automation, ensuring high scalability, cost efficiency, and global service stability for billions of users.

Responsibilities:
1. Own the end-to-end design and iteration of core edge cloud products, including container, bare-metal, and network capabilities. You’ll optimize key modules such as user management, billing, inventory, and resource scheduling, polish domain models and workflows, and build stable, secure, and scalable systems for internal and external business scenarios.
2. Build a full-lifecycle resource operation platform that covers resource planning, provisioning, delivery, runtime management, and billing. You’ll analyze global resource data, output actionable insights, and continuously improve resource delivery efficiency.
3. Develop a unified resource pool management platform that integrates self-hosted and third-party cloud resources. You’ll build resource data and billing systems, improve cost efficiency and resource competitiveness, and support flexible, unified management of global edge cloud resources.

We are

jobs.requirementText:
1、专业背景：计算机科学、信息安全、人工智能、网络安全或相关领域本科及以上学历，或具备同等水平的实际工作经验与技术能力；
2、大模型技术理解与AI安全知识储备：熟悉大语言模型（LLM）的基本原理与推理机制，了解主流Agent框架及其工作模式（如基于工具调用的ReAct/Function Calling范式、多步工作流编排、插件系统、RAG架构等）；了解当前主流的AI安全问题与攻防方法，包括但不限于Prompt Injection（直接注入与间接注入）、Jailbreak、数据投毒、模型逆向、对抗样本、模型滥用及越权调用第三方服务等攻击手段与防御思路；
3、安全攻防或威胁建模经验：具备一定的安全研究、渗透测试、红队演练或威胁建模经验，能够从攻击者视角系统性地分析复杂系统的安全风险面；
4、代码实现能力：具备扎实的编程能力（Python为主，其他语言加分），能独立构建概念验证（POC）、安全测试脚本、自动化评估工具或对抗性测试框架；
5、逻辑抽象、分析能力与风险意识：具有优秀的问题抽象能力和结构化思维，能够将模糊的、新兴的安全风险转化为清晰的威胁模型、评估指标和可执行的防护方案；对新技术、新场景保持敏锐的安全感知，能够主动识别潜在风险点，而非仅被动响应已知漏洞；
6、跨团队沟通与协作：具备良好的书面和口头表达能力，能够清晰地向非安全背景的技术和业务团队传达安全风险与建议，推动安全方案的落地执行。

加分项
1、实际LLM/Agent安全经验：有大模型应用或智能体系统的安全研究、攻防测试或安全治理的实战经验，曾主导或深度参与过相关安全项目；
2、学术成果或开源贡献：在AI安全、对抗机器学习、系统安全等领域发表过高质量学术论文（如顶会S&P、USENIX Security、CCS、NeurIPS、ICML、ACL等），或在相关开源项目中有持续贡献；
3、安全竞赛成绩：在CTF、AI安全挑战赛、红队竞赛或漏洞挖掘项目中取得优异成绩，具备竞技型安全攻防实力；
4、安全工程化能力：有将安全研究成果转化为自动化工具、平台化能力或规模化服务的工程经验；
5、多领域交叉背景：同时具备传统网络安全/应用安全与AI/NLP技术背景，能够将经典安全思维与大模型场景有机结合；
6、行业影响力：在AI安全社区有一定影响力，如维护技术博客、参与行业标准制定、在安全会议上发表演讲等。

岗位描述：
1、智能体安全风险发现、建模与评估：针对大模型智能体系统（含工具调用、插件集成、多步工作流编排等场景），系统性地发现和建模安全风险，包括但不限于Prompt Injection（直接、间接注入）、指令绕过、越权调用外部工具或第三方服务、敏感数据泄露、上下文污染、模型幻觉与推理偏差引发的业务风险等；建立风险分级与影响评估框架，制定安全基线标准与准入规范；
2、防护策略与安全机制设计：结合威胁模型与业务场景，设计并迭代智能体系统的安全防护架构与策略规则体系，涵盖输入输出过滤、Prompt防护层、工具调用权限沙箱、上下文隔离、敏感操作审批、安全对齐（Alignment）策略以及基于意图识别的异常行为检测等方向；
3、安全评测体系建设与红队测试：构建覆盖大模型智能体核心攻击面的标准化安全评测基准（Benchmark），组织和执行红队测试（Red Teaming），开发自动化攻击模拟工具与对抗性测试框架，持续验证并推动防护能力的工程化与规模化；
4、前沿安全研究与情报跟踪：持续跟踪AI安全领域的最新学术研究、攻击技术演进与行业安全事件，提炼可落地的防护思路与方法论，保持团队在大模型安全攻防方面的技术前瞻性；
5、跨团队协作与安全能力落地：与产品、工程、算法及合规团队紧密协作，将安全研究成果转化为可工程化的安全组件和规范流程，推动安全能力在智能体产品全链路中的系统性集成与持续运营。

2、技术方案架构设计：作为解决方案架构师，能够精准对接国内及国际化客户业务需求，将其转换为大数据和中台技术方案，针对具体项目主导大数据信息架构顶层设计；重点为国际化客户提供专业的业务咨询、技术咨询及技术选型建议，兼顾国内客户需求；融入Data Agent、营销Agent相关技术路径，确保方案的可行性、前瞻性与落地性，助力营销转化；

jobs.title: Quality Team Lead, GenAI & Emerging Products - Trust and Safety
jobs.description: The GenAI & Emerging Products Quality team supports a diverse portfolio of global products across ByteDance, including fast-evolving GenAI and Emerging Product ecosystems. Our mission goes beyond quality auditing. We act as a strategic qual
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualification(s):
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 2+ years of people leadership experience, with a strong track record in coaching, developing, and managing team performance.
- Experience in Quality, Trust & Safety, Operations, Risk, Product Operations, or a related environment.
- Proven experience leading cross-functional projects or programs across multiple stakeholders, products, or markets.
- High attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and adapt quickly in a dynamic environment.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across countries and time zones.
- Resilience and emotional maturity, with the ability to support teams operating in content environments.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Data analysis and reporting skills; with exposure to AI, Product, Policy, or Data teams.

岗位描述：
The GenAI & Emerging Products Quality team supports a diverse portfolio of global products across ByteDance, including fast-evolving GenAI and Emerging Product ecosystems. Our mission goes beyond quality auditing. We act as a strategic quality partner to Product, Operations, Policy, Data, and other cross-functional teams, using quality signals, operational insights, and frontline expertise to identify risks, improve processes, strengthen policy implementation, and support safe and sustainable product growth. As our products and technologies continue to evolve, the Quality team plays an important role in ensuring quality and safety considerations are embedded into product decisions, operational changes, launches, and improvement initiatives.

As a Quality Team Leader for GenAI & Emerging Products, you will lead a team of IC professionals supporting multiple global products and markets. This role requires a strong combination of people leadership, quality expertise, project management, stakeholder management, and analytical thinking. You will be responsible not only for driving strong quality performance, but also for developing the team, leading cross-functional quality initiatives, managing complex projects, and ensuring Quality operates as an effective partner to Product, Policy, Operations, Data, and other stakeholders. You will work in a fast-moving environment where priorities, products, and risk landscapes evolve quickly. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, setting direction, influencing stakeholders, and turning quality insights into scalable improvements.

Responsibilities:
- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Quality team, including team members across different locations, markets and products.
- Manage team performance through regular coaching, feedback, goal setting, performance reviews, and structured development plans.
- Manage team capacity, resource allocation, and priorities across multiple products, markets, projects, and evolving business needs.
- Lead and coordinate multiple cross-functional projects and initiatives simultaneously, managing timelines, priorities, dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and deliverables.
- Act as a project lead for key Quality initiatives, driving projects from planning through execution and ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and timely delivery.
- Build strong partnerships with Product, Policy, Operations, Data, BPO, and other global stakeholders, acting as a key Quality point of contact.
- Navigate competing priorities and changing business needs, making sound decisions and ensuring the team remains focused on the highest-impact areas.
- Represent the Quality team in cross-functional and leadership discussions, communicating performance, project progress, risks, resource needs, and strategic priorities.
- Drive operational excellence and identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, processes, scalability, and overall Quality impact.

团队介绍：火山引擎是字节跳动旗下云和AI服务平台，将字节跳动快速发展过程中积累的增长方法、技术能力和应用工具开放给外部企业，通过云和AI技术，推进企业智能化转型，激发增长潜能。

1、负责企业AI办公产品渠道增长的规划与建设，统筹年度产品规划、增长策略方案设计，为企业AI能力渗透、增长目标负责，整合公司各产品线资源，搭建渠道增长能力与多元化商品体系，联动运营商、智能终端、生态等重点渠道开展深度战略合作，打造可规模化复制的2B2C渠道增长产品矩阵；
2、持续跟踪行业运营商、智能
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，5年以上互联网产品、增长产品策略等相关经验，有运营商行业背景优先；
2、具备扎实的商业化思维与战略规划能力，能独立完成全渠道商业化增长的年度产品规划与落地执行；对数据高度敏感，对行业动态及市场合作模式具备敏锐洞察，具有较强的创新意识与业务判断力；
3、具备出色跨团队沟通、资源整合及项目推动力，拥有良好团队协作意识和复杂问题解决能力，目标与结果导向强。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：火山引擎是字节跳动旗下云和AI服务平台，将字节跳动快速发展过程中积累的增长方法、技术能力和应用工具开放给外部企业，通过云和AI技术，推进企业智能化转型，激发增长潜能。

1、负责企业AI办公产品渠道增长的规划与建设，统筹年度产品规划、增长策略方案设计，为企业AI能力渗透、增长目标负责，整合公司各产品线资源，搭建渠道增长能力与多元化商品体系，联动运营商、智能终端、生态等重点渠道开展深度战略合作，打造可规模化复制的2B2C渠道增长产品矩阵；
2、持续跟踪行业运营商、智能终端等趋势、业务模式及市场动态，形成系统性市场与产品洞察，结合渠道特性与资源属性，灵活设计差异化商品方案及定价策略，多元化权益组合包、持续提升产品市场竞争力与商业转化效率；
3、统筹合作商品的全生命周期产品运营，搭建产品研发链路及商业化核心数据指标体系，基于数据分析持续推动策略迭代，推进商品高质量落地与规模化复制，沉淀标准化产品方法论与运营体系，协同产品、研发、运营、商务等跨部门资源，推动项目高效落地。

工作城市：北京

2、建立并完善适配各阶段的资源管控和提效体系，根据业务策略敏捷支持资源的分配和追加，保持独立客观，在合规框架下做好底线约束，在品类、交易渠道等维度上持续探索更优的资源使用方法，助力业务目标达成；

jobs.title: 高级用户研究分析师-中国电商
jobs.description:
1、负责电商方向商家研究工作，结合对业务现状的理解，能有效结合研究输出具有较强落地性的研究报告、推动业务落地；
2、深入理解交易业务现状，能有效利用定性/定量调研、业务客观数据分析、市场数据及创新的研究方法，能明确发现业务侧需要关注的问题以及后续发展方向的机会；
3、熟悉对接的业务领域，关注行业和业务动态，能够输出对业务有价值的洞察。
jobs.requirementText:
1、3年以上市场与用户研究经验，能独立完成定性/定量研究项目，逻辑能力强，学习能力强，能独立思考解决问题，敢于创新，具备应对复杂项目的能力，并具备良好沟通能力和推动力；
2、对行业有一定的了解或相关工作经验，有B端商家研究经验、监测类调研项目经历更佳，如NPS/BHT/满意度监测、其他持续性量化监测项目等；
3、熟悉并掌握SPSS、SQL等统计软件，具备数据分析能力；熟练掌握定性研究技能，包括但不限于主持深度访谈、焦点小组座谈会等；
4、包括但不限于心理学、统计学、社会学、市场营销等相关专业本科及以上学历。

岗位描述：
1、负责电商方向商家研究工作，结合对业务现状的理解，能有效结合研究输出具有较强落地性的研究报告、推动业务落地；
2、深入理解交易业务现状，能有效利用定性/定量调研、业务客观数据分析、市场数据及创新的研究方法，能明确发现业务侧需要关注的问题以及后续发展方向的机会；
3、熟悉对接的业务领域，关注行业和业务动态，能够输出对业务有价值的洞察。

工作城市：上海

jobs.description:
About the Team- Shaping the Future of Global E-Commerce Experience
We are the Governance & Experience Algorithm Team — a trailblazing AI force at the forefront of building a trusted, efficient e-commerce ecosystem. Established in 2020, we l
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications:
Technical Mastery:
  - Proficient in Python/C++ and machine learning frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow).
  - Deep experience with graph neural networks, time series analysis, or LLM.
Domain Expertise:
  - 3+ years in anti-fraud, prediction/forecasting, e-commerce governance, or related fields.
  - Track record of delivering AI solutions with measurable business impact.

Preferred Qualifications
Problem - Solving Mindset:
  - Passion for tackling ambiguous challenges and translating ideas into scalable solutions.
  - Strong communication skills to collaborate cross - functionally and influence stakeholders.

岗位描述：
About the Team- Shaping the Future of Global E-Commerce Experience
We are the Governance & Experience Algorithm Team — a trailblazing AI force at the forefront of building a trusted, efficient e-commerce ecosystem. Established in 2020, we leverage Graph Neural Networks, Multi-Objective Optimization, Time Series Prediction, and Large Language Models (LLM) to tackle some of the most complex challenges in e-commerce:

Quality Revolution
Combat low-quality products and fraudulent practices across millions of listings:
- Detect low-quality items, counterfeit goods, and false advertising.
- Identify "not-as-described" discrepancies between product claims and actual quality.
- Flag risky sellers through comprehensive quality assessments.

Fulfillment & Logistics Experience Reinvention
Enhance delivery reliability and operational efficiency:
- Resolve delivery delays and non-receipt issues.
- Prevent inventory shortages via predictive analytics.
- Optimize warehouse operations for faster order fulfillment.

Why Our Work Matters:
- We protect users globally, ensuring safe shopping experiences in international markets and beyond.
- Our innovations power TikTok’s mission to “Inspire Creativity, Bring Joy” by fostering trust and delight in every transaction.
- We’re not just solving problems—we’re redefining industry standards for e-commerce product, service, and logistics experiences.

What You’ll Do
1. Lead Cutting - Edge AI Projects
  - Build graph-powered risk networks to uncover similar product clusters and high-risk seller/creator groups in emerging markets, reducing false advertising incidents in global regions.
  - Develop LLM-based multi-modal systems using cross-modal fusion (text, images, behavioral data) to detect false advertising and low-quality products. Deploy AI-powered product business suggestions to improve seller compliance and user trust.
  - Lead time-series forecasting innovation for logistics performance metrics (e.g., delivery delays, cancellation rates), driving improvement in the e-commerce experience through predictive analytics.

2. Solve Complex Business Challenges
  - Develop multi-task models using MMoE and dynamic loss functions, driving measurable improvements in platform product, service, and logistics health.
  - Transform supply chains by optimizing warehouse product quality qualification strategies to cut missing recalls and reduce warehouse costs.
  - Unleash RPD/RPR growth through causal inference frameworks, identifying hidden correlations between CCR and user behavior to design personalized recommendations.

3. Redefine Industry Standards
  - Optimize LLM reasoning with DPO/GRPO to enhance fraud detection, outperforming traditional SFT methods. Enhance tabular data modeling for better explainability in e-commerce risk assessments.
  - Construct heterogeneous graphs modeling product - seller - creator - video - user relationships, enabling improvements in product lifecycle insights and detection of similar product patterns.
  - Build unified time-series forecasting models across products, sellers, creators, videos, and users, achieving SOTA performance in predicting inventory shortages and demand surges.

jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，人工智能、计算机、自动化、数学相关专业优先；
2、拥有优秀的分析问题和解决问题的能力，对解决具有挑战性问题充满激情；
3、怀有科技改变世界的远大抱负，有志于投身机器学习、人工智能、大语言模型、多模态理解和生成等技术领域；
4、扎实的机器学习、CV、AIGC、NLP、RL基础和出色的探索能力，在CVPR、ECCV、ICCV、NeurIPS、ICLR、SIGGRAPH等顶级会议上发表论文者优先；
5、优秀的代码能力、数据结构和基础算法功底，熟练C/C++或Python，ACM/ICPC、NOI/IOI、Top Coder、Kaggle等比赛获奖者优先；
6、在多模态大模型、生成领域或者RL领域，主导过大影响力的项目或论文者优先。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：中国交易与广告，基于个性化推荐、深度学习和大模型技术，依托抖音、今日头条、红果短剧、西瓜视频、番茄小说等多元产品，构建抖音电商、生活服务、广告营销等核心营收业务的算法策略和工程架构。部门运用领先的算法能力，精准连接海量用户与商家，通过推荐、广告和搜索算法精准匹配需求并促进交易达成，保障用户体验与商家权益，实现营收业务可持续增长；基于深厚的技术积累，构建高效、智能、可靠的交易与广告产品，全面提升多行业收入变现与市场占有。在这里，你将直面超大规模流量与复杂业务场景的技术挑战，深度应用业界领先的商业模型与算法技术，投身面向未来的数字营销能力建设，持续探索前沿技术。你写下的每一行代码、优化的每一个算法，都将影响数亿用户的决策，定义互联网广告的技术新标杆。

1、成为研究型人才，在你热爱的课题方向上，探索多模态大模型模型领域最具挑战的长期关键问题；
2、探索研究多模态理解、生成式、强化学习、AIGC等前沿技术；
3、探索多模态RAG、视觉COT、多模态Agent、多模态Reward model、RL等多模态进阶能力；
4、探索多模态Deep research、Computer Using Agent、Useful Image Generation、理解生成一体模型在抖音交易场景的能力。

1、负责Windows/Linux/macOS三端沙箱底层能力建设，为AI
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机或相关专业，有二进制安全、系统底层从业背景者优先；
2、熟练掌握C/C++，静态库/动态库原理、内存管理、多线程与同步原语；
3、熟悉至少一类主流操作系统（Windows/Linux/macOS）的底层原理，理解进程/线程模型、虚拟内存与堆栈管理、文件系统、权限与安全模型、异常/信号处理、IPC机制等核心概念；
4、具备较强的问题定位及逆向分析能力，熟练使用对应平台的调试工具（Windbg、GDB/LLDB、dtrace/strace等），独立分析崩溃、内存泄漏、死锁等问题；熟练使用主流逆向工具（IDA Pro、Ghidra等）完成关键函数还原与系统底层实现分析；
5、良好的逻辑思维能力和技术好奇心，对系统底层技术、安全隔离技术有浓厚兴趣，有安全产品、沙箱、虚拟化、终端管控、EDR、DLP、内核/驱动开发经验者优先；
6、各端要求（任一方向皆可）：
1）Windows方向：
（1）深入理解Windows NT架构及底层运行机制，熟悉PE文件结构、内存管理、对象管理、进程/线程管理、异常分发、调试机制等核心原理，了解Win32窗口与消息机制、COM/DCOM/RPC/ALPC等系统通信与组件模型。
（2）熟练掌握常规注入与反注入（如消息钩子、远程线程、APC、输入法、LSP/NSP等）方案与工程落地能力，掌握主流Hook技术的原理与应用。
（3）熟悉Windows网络编程与网络管控机制，了解LSP、NSP、WFP、NDIS、TDI等常用网络框架，能够实现基于进程、协议、IP、端口、域名等维度的网络访问控制、链接拦截、放行与审计能力。
（4）熟悉Windows权限与安全边界机制，包括Access Token、Integrity Level、UAC、Job Object、AppContainer、PP/PPL等，理解隔离边界与适用范围，具备权限收敛、进程约束与沙箱加固实践经验。
（5）熟悉Windows文件系统与设备访问控制机制，理解NTFS权限模型、Minifilter、对象命名空间及句柄访问控制原理，支撑文件读写审计、敏感路径隔离、设备访问限制等安全能力建设；
2）Linux方向：
（1）具备扎实的Linux系统编程基础，熟悉进程与线程模型、IPC、文件I/O、内存管理等核心机制，能够熟练使用GDB、strace、perf、valgrind等工具开展问题定位与性能分析。
（2）熟悉Linux底层安全机制，包括Seccomp、Landlock、Capabilities、Namespace、Cgroups、eBPF等，理解其设计原理、适用边界及工程化落地方式。
（3）深入理解Linux系统调用原理、glibc实现与动态链接机制，具备系统级拦截、运行时管控或沙箱研发经验。
（4）熟悉容器Runtime、安全容器、云原生安全、终端安全产品等相关技术体系，理解其核心机制，并具备相关方向研发或落地经验。
（5）了解KVM/QEMU虚拟化、云沙箱、Serverless容器、轻量级虚拟机等技术原理，有相关系统设计、能力建设或工程实践；
3）macOS方向：
（1）深入理解macOS系统架构和底层原理，熟悉XNU、BSD系统调用、进程/线程管理、内存管理、IPC、权限控制等核心机制。
（2）具备macOS API Hook或Runtime Instrumentation经验，熟悉C/C++层符号Hook、dyld、Mach-O、动态链接以及Objective-C Runtime、Method Swizzling、IMP替换、消息转发等底层机制。
（3）熟悉macOS安全与权限体系，包括TCC、SIP、Sandbox、Hardened Runtime、Entitlement、XPC等，具备相关能力设计与工程落地经验。
（4）熟悉Endpoint Security、Network Extension系统扩展框架，能够支撑终端安全、行为监控与访问控制等场景建设。

团队介绍：字节跳动基础设施存储团队，为字节跳动全系产品提供存储服务，对外打造火山引擎公有云存储产品体系，在AI时代深度支撑豆包大模型和方舟大模型平台。我们根植字节跳动最佳技术实践，以数十万台服务器规模和百EB 级数据稳定存储的企业服务经验，通过火山引擎丰富的存储产品矩阵对外赋能。我们积极探索业界顶尖的技术，从底层硬件构造到数据治理和上层应用加速，致力于构建业界领先的云存储服务，释放海量数据的无限价值。

1、负责AI存储加速系统（如KV Cache/Checkpoint/RL
jobs.requirementText:
1、对大模型推理、训练、强化学习、AI Agent等方向有浓厚兴趣，并愿意在该领域长期深耕；
2、具备扎实的计算机基础，具备良好的编程能力和编程规范，熟悉C/C++/Python/Go之一；
3、熟悉分布式一致性协议（如Raft），熟悉NVMe、RDMA、HBM等协议和硬件，了解常见存储开源系统（如Mooncake存储系统/Redis/Ceph/Rocksdb等）；
4、学习能力强，自驱、专注、善于拆解复杂问题并推动工程落地，愿意思考问题本质，具备质疑精神。

加分项
1、具备大模型推理/训练经验；
2、有高性能计算/网络/数据库/云原生背景；
3、博士学位为加分项。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：字节跳动基础设施存储团队，为字节跳动全系产品提供存储服务，对外打造火山引擎公有云存储产品体系，在AI时代深度支撑豆包大模型和方舟大模型平台。我们根植字节跳动最佳技术实践，以数十万台服务器规模和百EB 级数据稳定存储的企业服务经验，通过火山引擎丰富的存储产品矩阵对外赋能。我们积极探索业界顶尖的技术，从底层硬件构造到数据治理和上层应用加速，致力于构建业界领先的云存储服务，释放海量数据的无限价值。

1、负责AI存储加速系统（如KV Cache/Checkpoint/RL）的设计、开发与维护，持续提升系统在性能、成本、弹性、可靠性与易用性等方面的能力；
2、负责AI计算生态的前沿技术探索与工程化落地，包括推理框架（如SGLang/vLLM）、强化学习框架（如AReal/veRL）、AI Agent等，推动AI存储更高效地支撑计算生态；

jobs.title: 视频编解码与异构计算优化工程师-音视频技术
jobs.description:
1、异构计算平台技术攻坚：深度剖析主流GPU、NPU架构的计算/存储特性，精准定位视频编解码任务在目标硬件上的性能瓶颈，主导核心模块的硬件适配与深度调优，实现算力资源的最大化利用；
2、编解码算法性能极致优化：围绕主流及前沿标准，结合异构计算并行特性，对编解码器核心算法进行模块重构、并行化设计及指令级优化，达成编码效率、编解码速度与画质的最优平衡；
3、软硬协同加速方案定制落地：针对特定业务场景需求，牵头设计并实施软硬协同的编解码加速方案，深度融合算法创新、硬件特性挖掘与业务
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机科学与技术、通信工程、电子信息工程、应用数学等相关专业优先；
2、3年及以上C/C++高性能编程实战经验，具备扎实的数据结构、算法设计功底，能独立完成复杂模块的高性能代码实现与重构；
3、具备将复杂算法（如图像视频编解码核心模块）成功移植、适配并优化至GPU/NPU的完整项目经验，能显著提升算力利用率与任务吞吐量；
4、深入理解至少一种主流视频编解码标准（如H.266/H.265/AV1/AVS3）的核心原理，熟悉对应开源实现（如X265、X264）；
5、具备优异的性能瓶颈定位与分析能力，熟练使用各类Profiling工具开展计算、存储、通信全链路性能剖析与优化；
6、具备强烈的工程驱动思维与问题解决能力，以业务结果为导向，能直面复杂的高性能计算挑战，高效推进技术方案落地与迭代。

加分项：
1、参与过视频编码标准（如AVS、H.265、H.266、AV1）的制定；
2、具备基于神经网络的图像视频编码等AI+编解码融合技术的研究或工程落地经验；
3、拥有高质量开源技术项目（如GitHub星级项目），或在相关领域顶级会议/期刊发表过论文。

岗位描述：
1、异构计算平台技术攻坚：深度剖析主流GPU、NPU架构的计算/存储特性，精准定位视频编解码任务在目标硬件上的性能瓶颈，主导核心模块的硬件适配与深度调优，实现算力资源的最大化利用；
2、编解码算法性能极致优化：围绕主流及前沿标准，结合异构计算并行特性，对编解码器核心算法进行模块重构、并行化设计及指令级优化，达成编码效率、编解码速度与画质的最优平衡；
3、软硬协同加速方案定制落地：针对特定业务场景需求，牵头设计并实施软硬协同的编解码加速方案，深度融合算法创新、硬件特性挖掘与业务指标要求，推动方案从原型验证到规模化落地；
4、技术体系建设与团队赋能：沉淀异构计算优化方法论与前沿硬件技术经验，主导或参与构建标准化的性能评测体系与自动化调优工具链，提升团队整体研发效能与问题解决能力。

工作城市：上海

jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
1. BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
2. 5+ years of experience in physical verification (DRC/LVS/ERC) for ASIC/SoC designs.
3. Hands-on experience with industry-standard PV tools (e.g., Mentor Calibre, Synopsys IC Validator).
4. Experience with PV signoff flow from PDK enablement through tapeout.
5. Experience working with Foundry and EDA vendors on rule-deck bring-up and issue resolution.

Preferred Qualifications
1. Experience with 7nm/5nm/3nm/2nm or other advanced nodes.
2. Experience with early PDK bring-up and immature rule-deck validation.
3. Experience with advanced package related PV verification.
4. Experience developing PV methodology, including waiver and regression frameworks.

岗位描述：
Team Introduction
The Silicon Platform Team acts as the core R&D middleware group for chip development within the company. The team covers the full spectrum of the chip design flow, including Logic Synthesis, Design for Testability (DFT), Backend Design, Physical and STA (Static Timing Analysis) Signoff, as well as Power Integrity, IR drop, and Electromagnetic Compatibility (Power/IR/EM). The team also oversees tape-out, mass production, packaging, testing, and board-level verification. They collaborate closely with front-end chip teams across business units to drive R&D progress and mass production deployment for chip.

Responsibilities
1. Own and drive Physical Verification (PV) signoff for advanced-node ASIC/SoC designs, including DRC/LVS/ERC/ANT, fill program, ESD PERC/Reliability checks, GDS scramble, and advanced package related verification.
2. Own the complete PV flow from early PDK test/enablement through final tapeout, including PV methodology development, flow bring-up, debugging, and signoff closure.
3. Drive early PDK and rule-deck bring-up and validation. For immature or early-release PDKs/verification decks: analyze PV results, identify root cause (design/PDK/rule deck/technology file/tool), develop focused test cases, and work with Foundry and EDA vendors to drive closure.
4. Perform in-depth PV result analysis and debugging, including hierarchical/flat run monitoring, IP verification and SoC-level integration, regression analysis across rule-deck/PDK versions, and PV-PR correlation.
5. Act as the technical interface between the company and Foundry/PDK teams/EDA vendors, including issue reporting and tracking, test case preparation, rule interpretation discussion, and rule-deck fix validation.
6. Develop and maintain PV signoff methodology, including checklists, run strategies, waiver methodology, regression methodology, and signoff criteria.

工作城市：新加坡

jobs.requirementText:
1、3-5年产品或客户解决方案或FDE经验，能独立负责模块或0到1MVP并推动规模化；
2、了解大模型应用基本范式：RAG（检索增强）、工具调用、多轮对话、评测与反馈闭环；
3、数据驱动：会做指标体系、埋点分析、A/B测试或灰度验证，能对渗透与留存负责；

岗位描述：
团队介绍：TikTok是一个覆盖150个国家和地区的国际短视频平台，我们希望通过TikTok发现真实、有趣的瞬间，让生活更美好。TikTok在全球各地设有办公室，全球总部位于洛杉矶和新加坡，办公地点还包括纽约、伦敦、都柏林、巴黎、柏林、迪拜、雅加达、首尔和东京等多个城市。

TikTok直播是全球领先的直播业务，以实时互动为核心，提供多元化的商业化模式和创作工具。我们为用户提供独特的内容和消费体验；为创作者找到合适的观众，提供最好的工具和一系列盈利模式，帮助创作者创造更多机会、改变他们的生活；通过直播，平台也能从中获得健康、客观的商业化收益，持续发展。我们一直听到这样的故事 —— “LIVE changes my life” —— 他们更好，我们才会更好。

加入我们，一起探索 “不可能的事”—— 我们是行业的先行者，在一步步改变行业。我们持续让行业了解直播是一种新的内容形式，是创作者可以依赖的商业模式。

1、面向主播运营、公会运营等场景，深入业务现场，把模糊问题转化为可验证、可部署、可复用方案，并对最终业务效果负责；
2、负责AI对话式问答入口和知识库建设，确保对话在多轮澄清、引用溯源、置信度、纠错、兜底、转人工、反馈闭环上体验良好；
3、把专业运营SOP/FAQ/规则沉淀为可配置工具包（模板、策略开关、话术、提示词、知识源），支持快速复制到其他场景；
4、搭建并推动核心指标达成（覆盖、渗透、DAU、使用时长、命中率、正确率、满意度、节省工时），通过灰度与实验持续优化。

工作城市：北京

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Mom and Babies Category (Philippines E-Commerce)
jobs.description:
About the team
ByteDance E-commerce is building a new generation of digital commerce by bringing together brands, merchants, creators, content, and consumers in an integrated commerce ecosystem.

The Mom & Baby team is building a trusted an
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above, with 3+ years of experience in e-commerce, key account management, brand management, business development, sales, or commercial strategy.
- Proven experience managing relationships with brands, distributors, retailers, or strategic merchants, with a track record of delivering commercial growth.
- Strong commercial acumen and analytical skills, with the ability to identify business opportunities, develop growth strategies, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both external partners and cross-functional internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in Mom & Baby, FMCG, consumer goods, retail, baby care, nutrition, maternity, or related categories.
- Experience working with major brands, distributors, or specialist retailers within the Philippine Mom & Baby ecosystem.
- Experience in e-commerce, marketplace, digital commerce, digital marketing, content commerce, or social commerce.
- Proven experience developing Joint Business Plans, strategic partnerships, commercial proposals, or integrated growth plans.
- Strong understanding of digital commerce growth levers, including content, LIVE, creators, affiliate, campaigns, advertising, assortment, and promotions.
- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to build data-driven business cases and compelling commercial presentations.

岗位描述：
About the team
ByteDance E-commerce is building a new generation of digital commerce by bringing together brands, merchants, creators, content, and consumers in an integrated commerce ecosystem.

The Mom & Baby team is building a trusted and engaging shopping destination for parents and families in the Philippines. The category spans a wide range of products, from baby care and diapers to feeding, nutrition, maternity, baby gear, and everyday parenting essentials.

We work with leading brands, distributors, specialist retailers, and emerging businesses to build a strong product assortment and create new ways for parents to discover, evaluate, and purchase products online.

About the role
As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for building and growing partnerships with key brands and merchants within the Mom & Baby category.

You will act as a business growth partner to your portfolio, understanding each partner's commercial priorities, identifying opportunities for growth, and developing joint strategies that translate into measurable business impact.

This role goes beyond traditional account management. You will work across assortment, commercial planning, campaigns, content, creators, affiliate, LIVE, and other commerce solutions to help brands and merchants build their digital business.

You will also play an important role in shaping the category itself, identifying assortment gaps, emerging consumer needs, and new business opportunities while working with internal teams to turn these insights into scalable initiatives.

Responsibilities:
- Own Strategic Brand Partnerships: Build and maintain trusted relationships with leading Mom & Baby brands, distributors, retailers, and strategic merchants, understanding their business priorities and long-term growth ambitions.
- Drive Joint Business Planning: Develop and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with key partners, aligning their commercial priorities with category opportunities across assortment, campaigns, pricing, promotions, and consumer engagement.
- Accelerate Brand & Merchant Growth: Identify opportunities to grow partner businesses through assortment expansion, pricing and promotional strategies, content, LIVE, creators, affiliate, and other commerce solutions.
- Shape Category Growth: Analyze category performance, consumer trends, assortment gaps, and competitive dynamics to identify new growth opportunities and translate them into actionable commercial strategies.
- Lead Commercial Opportunities: Negotiate commercial plans and secure strong assortment, pricing, promotional participation, and strategic investments from key partners around major shopping moments and category priorities.
- Build the Consumer Journey: Work with brands and internal teams to develop engaging ways for parents to discover and understand products, leveraging content, creators, LIVE, and other digital commerce touchpoints.
- Drive Business Performance: Monitor portfolio performance and use data to identify gaps, evaluate initiatives, and develop recommendations that improve GMV, conversion, assortment quality, and overall category performance.
- Influence Cross-Functional Execution: Partner closely with Category, Campaign, Creator, Affiliate, Ads, Operations, and Product teams to bring strategic initiatives from planning through execution.

工作城市：塔吉格

团队介绍：秉承“让人人都能享受好故事，让好故事影响更多人”的使命与愿景，番茄国际化团队致力于为全球用户提供丰富和高质量的故事消费体验（短剧、小说、有声书、动漫等）。一方面，推出了Melolo、Fizzo等国际化短剧和小说漫画产品直接为用户提供服务；另一方面，与小说及短剧创作者紧密合作，立足于对用户需求的洞察和数据分析，激发和引导创作者提升创作水平。多年国际化多市场的深耕、丰富的本地内容发展经验和中国市场充沛的内容积累，让我们拥有可持续的业务及团队优势。
 
番茄国际化团队涵盖
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上内容运营工作经验；
2、对AI内容制作、翻译配音有较强理解，熟悉从脚本处理、翻译适配、配音生产到后期交付的关键环节；
3、熟悉或理解TTS/Voice Cloning/AIPE等相关方案，具备模型评估、能力选型、流程落地经验，持续跟踪行业趋势与新技术方向，关注语音生成、后编辑及生产流程自动化等领域的新解法；
4、具备较强的跨团队协作与项目推进能力，能够推动产品、算法、运营、供应商等多方协同，达成工作目标。

加分项
1、有内容行业、翻译配音、AI模型应用相关领域经验者优先；
2、有AI内容制作、翻译配音全流程实际项目经验者优先；
3、有TTS/Voice Cloning/AIPE等相关方案落地经验者优先。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：秉承“让人人都能享受好故事，让好故事影响更多人”的使命与愿景，番茄国际化团队致力于为全球用户提供丰富和高质量的故事消费体验（短剧、小说、有声书、动漫等）。一方面，推出了Melolo、Fizzo等国际化短剧和小说漫画产品直接为用户提供服务；另一方面，与小说及短剧创作者紧密合作，立足于对用户需求的洞察和数据分析，激发和引导创作者提升创作水平。多年国际化多市场的深耕、丰富的本地内容发展经验和中国市场充沛的内容积累，让我们拥有可持续的业务及团队优势。
 
番茄国际化团队涵盖用户产品、创作平台、用户增长、产品运营、内容运营、内容策略、商务合作、短剧制片、短剧编审、网文原创等职能，对用户和创作者提供系统地服务。
 
我们为有志于向全球各地用户带来故事享受的同学，提供一个始终创业、紧密合作、并展示自己影响力和创造力的舞台。欢迎加入我们！

1、负责搭建短剧本地化翻配的流程，围绕短剧分发到全球各语种的本地化，寻找更优的翻配新解法，对质量、效率与成本结果负责；
2、系统梳理现有翻配链路中的关键问题，包括但不限于真人配音成本高、交付周期长、AI翻配质量不稳定、不同语种/题材适配效果差等，并持续推动专项优化；
3、探索并设计多种翻配模式与生产方案，包括纯人工、AI配音、AIPE、半自动混合链路等，评估不同模式在质量、成本、时效上的适用边界，沉淀最优策略；
4、推动AI翻配能力提升，与算法、产品、供应商协作，围绕发音自然度、情绪表现、角色一致性、口型匹配、语义准确性等关键指标，推动模型和工具迭代；
5、搭建翻配评估体系与验收标准，保证质检结果的准确性，推动质量标准迭代，形成可量化、可复盘、可追踪的判断标准。

工作城市：北京

jobs.title: 数据安全蓝军-安全与风控
jobs.description:

2、以内外部视角，模拟多个身份角色，针对公司内部大模型应用、AI Agent、智能助手等产品，开展全链路攻防演练；

4、良好的沟通能力和团队协作精神，对AI安全领域有强烈兴趣和持续学习意愿，乐于挑战没有明显答案的问题，能快速跟进前沿攻击技术并转化为实战能力。

2、具备0day挖掘能力或在漏洞平台（如HackerOne、漏洞盒子等）有优秀战绩者优先；
3、有过HW或CTF比赛经验并取得较好成绩者优先。

jobs.title: Multimodal AI Algorithm Expert-EMG / Interaction Perception, Pico
jobs.description:
About the Team
The team at PICO is dedicated to leverage technologies such as computer vision, deep learning, SLAM, 3D reconstruction, and multi-sensor fusion, we continuously expand the ways humans interact with the virtual world through h
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications:
 1. Master’s degree or above in machine learning, signal processing, computer science, statistics, speech and language technology, or a related field；
2. Proficient in the fundamentals of deep learning, with substantial experience in training and deploying deep models. Experience in fine-tuning end-to-end speech recognition frameworks (e.g., Conformer, RNN-T, LAS, CTC) and familiarity with 2D/3D perception algorithms in computer vision.；
3. Familiarity with sEMG signal acquisition and processing, including signal denoising (e.g., filtering algorithms) and feature extraction (e.g., time-domain and frequency-domain features)；
4. Experience with common digital signal processing techniques, such as digital filtering, Fourier transforms, correlation analysis, and modulation.

Preferred Qualifications: 
1. Experience in analyzing and modeling high-dimensional time-series data, such as speech signals, neural signals, physiological signals, videos, or other sensor data.
2. Publications in accredited academic conferences (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) or participation in competitions like Kaggle, COCO, ImageNet, ActivityNet, and 3D-related challenges.

岗位描述：
About the Team
The team at PICO is dedicated to leverage technologies such as computer vision, deep learning, SLAM, 3D reconstruction, and multi-sensor fusion, we continuously expand the ways humans interact with the virtual world through handheld controllers, bare-hand tracking, eye-tracking, and XR interactive accessories, enhancing the overall interaction experience.

Responsibilities：
1. Research and develop innovative deep learning models with a focus on the intersection of surface electromyography (sEMG), computer vision, and IMU technologies；

2、分析数据格式、量化位宽、累加精度、截断与舍入、溢出与饱和、ADC/DAC精度等因素对模型结果的影响，软硬联合设计计算单元数据格式和精度方案；
3、围绕存算一体架构实现精度补偿方案，包括偏差修正、噪声注入训练、分层补偿等；

5、建立浮点参考模型、硬件行为模型和芯片结果之间的逐层精度比对能力，定位模型、编译器、算子或硬件引入的数值误差；
6、设计模型在存算一体芯片及GPU、NPU等异构平台上的部署方案，协同AI工具链团队，完成模型转换、算子适配、计算图调整、精度验证等工作，同步建设模型精度评测、自动回归和问题诊断体系，沉淀量化规则、精度补偿及典型模型部署方案。

jobs.title: Cloud Acceleration Engineer – DPU & AI Infra
jobs.description:
About the Team
The ByteDance DPU (Data Processing Unit) team is building the foundational computing infrastructure for ByteDance and Volcano Engine Public Cloud. Our mission is to advance the architecture, development, and research of next-
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
- B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields; or Ph.D. with strong research/publications.
- 2+ years of relevant industry experience (exception for Ph.D. with strong background).
- Proficiency in C/C++ development and debugging.
- Strong Linux systems development experience.
- Solid understanding of compute, network architecture, and operating systems.
- Background in at least one of: software-hardware co-design, distributed systems, high-performance networking, or AI/ML systems.

Preferred Qualifications
- Ph.D. in related fields with research training and publications.
- Experience with software-hardware co-design (networking, storage, or distributed compute).
- Hands-on experience with network virtualization (OVS, SR-IOV, eBPF).
- Familiarity with DPDK and high-performance user-space networking.
- Bonus points for hardware acceleration experience, FPGA/ASIC/GPU/CUDA
- Bonus points for experience with NCCL Collectives along with AI communication patterns and parallelization techniques
- Proven experience designing and building AI/ML infrastructure related but not limited to inference kv cache system, data preprocessing system.

岗位描述：
About the Team
The ByteDance DPU (Data Processing Unit) team is building the foundational computing infrastructure for ByteDance and Volcano Engine Public Cloud. Our mission is to advance the architecture, development, and research of next-generation software-hardware technologies across compute, networking, and storage for cloud and AI computing.  Our technology stack spans
- Cloud virtualization & hypervisors
- High-performance user-space network protocols (DPDK, RDMA, etc.)
- High-speed interconnect and virtual switching
- Distributed storage acceleration
- GPU virtualization and scheduling for AI/ML workloads
We work at the intersection of software systems, distributed infrastructure, and custom hardware acceleration, shaping the next wave of cloud-scale computing.

Responsibilities
- Design and develop DPU network software with a focus on high performance, low latency, and reliability.
- Collaborate with hardware teams to build software-hardware co-design solutions for networking and storage acceleration.
- Explore AI/ML infrastructure acceleration, leveraging DPUs, GPUs, and custom hardware to optimize distributed training and inference.
- Drive end-to-end performance optimization, from OS kernels and drivers to user-space runtime systems.
- Contribute to architecture design, technical proposals, and long-term research directions.

工作城市：西雅图

1、基于火山引擎产品能力，深入理解零售/消费行业客户的业务场景与痛点，为客户设计可落地的行业解决方案；
2、结合零售企业从信息化、数字化、数据智能到AI应用的演进路径，分析客户需求，输出产品方案、架构方案和实施路径，推动客户智能化升级；
3、沉淀零售/消费行业可复制方案，包括典型场景、标准架构、客户
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上解决方案架构师工作经验；
2、具有品牌零售、消费电子、软硬件等行业的相关业务知识；
3、有平台化、系统化产品设计经验，熟悉业内人工智能平台、机器学习平台；
4、了解云计算相关知识，热爱新技术，对技术发展趋势具备敏感度；
5、具有数据中台、大数据开发平台等数据类产品或销量预测、智能推荐等算法类产品的产品经理相关工作经验优先。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：火山引擎是字节跳动旗下云和AI服务平台，将字节跳动快速发展过程中积累的增长方法、技术能力和应用工具开放给外部企业，通过云和AI技术，推进企业智能化转型，激发增长潜能。

1、基于火山引擎产品能力，深入理解零售/消费行业客户的业务场景与痛点，为客户设计可落地的行业解决方案；
2、结合零售企业从信息化、数字化、数据智能到AI应用的演进路径，分析客户需求，输出产品方案、架构方案和实施路径，推动客户智能化升级；
3、沉淀零售/消费行业可复制方案，包括典型场景、标准架构、客户案例、最佳实践和GTM方法论，支撑销售、产品研发、交付等团队高效协同；

jobs.title: 高级AI产品经理 - 抖音运营
jobs.description:

1、负责世界书产品架构与交互设计，完成产品整体方案设计，围绕IP内容建设、知识管理和创作应用设计统一产品框架，持续优化AI双工编辑体验；
2、负责Agent能力与核心场景建设，完成Agent产品框架及策略设计，搭建意图路由、上下文、Memory、个性化开场白、Autos
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，5年及以上互联网产品经验，有成熟的C端产品能力，主导过复杂产品从0到1建设及规模化迭代，有产品团队管理经验；

1、负责世界书产品架构与交互设计，完成产品整体方案设计，围绕IP内容建设、知识管理和创作应用设计统一产品框架，持续优化AI双工编辑体验；

jobs.title: 供应链数字化专家 - AI算力基础设施
jobs.description: 团队介绍：字节跳动基础设施部门，负责字节跳动的全栈算力基础设施，从芯片服务器产研、到超大规模数据中心，到传统云平台和如今的AI Native Cloud，全方位为抖音、豆包、今日头条、飞书、火山引擎等各类产品提供领先、稳定的百万量级大规模算力基础设施服务。我们的领域涵盖数据中心建设、内核操作系统开发、服务器集群管理、高速网络通信、EB级数据存储体系、搜索型数据库探索、基于LLM的AI基础设施的研发调度与治理等，致力于打造业界领先的、面向LLM的AI云原生基础设施架构与产品矩阵
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、信息管理、工业工程、供应链管理等相关专业，5年以上供应链运营工作经验，其中5年以上专注供应链数字化/信息化建设，有企业转型项目主导经验；
2、深入理解端到端供应链业务，熟悉计划、采购、物流等至少两个核心领域；有ERP/APS/WMS/TMS/SRM等系统实施或设计经验；
3、具备扎实的数据分析能力，熟练使用SQL/Python；理解运筹优化、机器学习基本原理，有供应链算法场景落地经验者优先；
4、优秀的项目管理与跨部门协作能力，推动多项目并行，PMP认证者优先；
5、系统性思维强，能将复杂业务场景转化为清晰的技术方案；结果导向，学习能力强，对AI/数字孪生/控制塔等前沿技术有实践或深刻理解。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：字节跳动基础设施部门，负责字节跳动的全栈算力基础设施，从芯片服务器产研、到超大规模数据中心，到传统云平台和如今的AI Native Cloud，全方位为抖音、豆包、今日头条、飞书、火山引擎等各类产品提供领先、稳定的百万量级大规模算力基础设施服务。我们的领域涵盖数据中心建设、内核操作系统开发、服务器集群管理、高速网络通信、EB级数据存储体系、搜索型数据库探索、基于LLM的AI基础设施的研发调度与治理等，致力于打造业界领先的、面向LLM的AI云原生基础设施架构与产品矩阵。

1、负责供应链数字化规划与架构搭建：对标业界最佳实践，制定供应链数字化转型战略与年度规划，设计业务、应用、数据、技术总体架构，输出实施路线图；
2、负责供应链核心领域端到端系统建设：负责计划、生产、库存履约等核心领域的数字化方案设计与系统落地，主导业务系统的规划、设计，协同产品研发部门进行实施与集成；
3、构建供应链控制塔与数据驱动体系：构建供应链控制塔，实现全链路可视化、异常预警与智能决策，建立KPI指标体系与数据看板，推动数据治理与主数据管理；
4、推动AI与算法场景落地：推动需求预测、智能补货、库存优化、路径优化、ATP校验、供应商风险预警等算法场景落地，探索大模型/知识图谱在供应链中的创新应用；
5、负责数字化重点项目全生命周期管理与变革推动：主导数字化重点项目全生命周期管理，统筹内外部团队，推动业务流程变革与用户落地，对项目交付与业务成果负责。

工作城市：北京

- Familiarity with technologies such as BIOS/UEFI, BMC, firmware, PCIe, NVMe, NICs, or hardware telemetry.
- Proficiency in Python, Go, Bash, or another programming language for production-grade infrastructure automation, including experience designing, building, or maintaining tools and platforms used in large-scale production environments.
- Deep knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting, preferably Debian or Ubuntu, combined with strong understanding of server architecture and management technologies such as kernels, drivers, BIOS/UEFI, BMC, Redfish, firmware, PCIe, NVMe, NICs, DPUs, hardware telemetry, and failure diagnostics.
- Proven hands-on experience introducing and productionizing large-scale GPU infrastructure, including ownership of hardware NPI or fleet onboarding across qualification, system integration, deployment, production validation, operational handoff, and post-launch reliability.
- Strong understanding of distributed AI workload behavior and performance analysis, including collective communication, multi-node training, inference serving, GPU scheduling, checkpointing, workload-related bottlenecks, DCGM, NCCL testing, CUDA profiling, and network-fabric telemetry.
- Experience building and operating monitoring, telemetry, hardware management, or automated remediation platforms at substantial scale, with measurable improvements in fleet availability, deployment efficiency, incident reduction, operational efficiency, or reliability.
- Experience working directly with OEMs, ODMs, component suppliers, or GPU platform vendors throughout qualification, technical escalation, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action processes.
- Experience with one or more advanced infrastructure technologies or engineering areas, such as containerisation and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., Ansible), AI-powered automation, AI agents, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), open-source infrastructure projects, technical publications, patents, or relevant industry standards.

岗位描述：
About the Team
The Server Management DevOps team is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of servers across ByteDance’s self-built data centers in the United States and Europe.
Our scope covers new hardware introduction, data center delivery, production operations, hardware maintenance, configuration and firmware changes, capacity migration, asset decommissioning, data sanitization, and hardware reuse.
The team serves as a central coordination point between multiple functions, including:
- Hardware New Product Introduction (NPI)
- Server and data center operations
- Field maintenance and infrastructure management
- Hardware vendors and service providers
- Supply chain and asset management
- Infrastructure platform and automation engineering teams
Our goal is to ensure that server infrastructure operates reliably, efficiently, and compliantly at scale throughout its entire lifecycle.

Role Overview 
We are looking for a hands-on Production Systems Engineer with a strong foundation in Linux systems, server infrastructure, automation, and production operations. This role is open to engineers across a range of experience levels, from early-career engineers with strong technical fundamentals to experienced infrastructure engineers who can take ownership of complex systems and large-scale initiatives. 
The scope and level of ownership will grow with experience, ranging from hands-on infrastructure engineering and automation development to leading complex global infrastructure initiatives across organizational boundaries

Responsibilities 
- Server Infrastructure Operations: Assist with the deployment, validation, monitoring, maintenance, and lifecycle management of large-scale server fleets, including CPU and GPU servers.
- Automation Development: Develop scripts, tools, and automation solutions using Python, Bash, Go, or other programming languages to reduce manual operational work and improve infrastructure efficiency.
- Linux Systems: Work with Linux-based production environments and help troubleshoot operating system, hardware, storage, networking, and performance-related issues. 
- GPU and AI Infrastructure: Gain exposure to modern AI infrastructure and GPU server platforms, and contribute to operational tooling, validation, monitoring, or reliability improvements. Explore opportunities to apply AI and large language models to infrastructure troubleshooting, automation, knowledge management, and operational decision-making.
- Monitoring and Data Analysis: Analyze server health, hardware failures, operational metrics, and infrastructure data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
- Technical Documentation: Create and improve technical documentation, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and internal knowledge bases.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with infrastructure engineers, hardware teams, data center operations, platform developers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders on global infrastructure projects.

jobs.title: 培训课程专家 - 飞书商业化
jobs.description:
团队介绍：飞书商业化团队（Go to Market）负责将飞书先进产品和服务全面推向中国和国际市场，通过制定精准的业务战略，进行破圈的市场营销，深入理解不同行业的趋势和特点，传递飞书的理念和价值给不同行业的企业客户并达成业务合作，帮助客户加强使用深度和广度，最终让飞书成为各行各业先进企业的首选、持续助力企业组织升级。目前已在中国、新加坡、美国、日本等国家和地区建立了商业化团队，开启了为全球各行各业组织和个人提升创造力和效率的历程。

1、培训产品的体系建设与研发，主导全品类产
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上企业培训//企业服务产品研发经验，具备独立完成商业化培训产品设计及相关经验，具备风险预判、解决客户问题的能力；
2、具备敏锐的市场洞察能力，能够从数据、客户需求中提炼业务价值，输出可落地的培训产品解决方案或产品；
3、强跨部门沟通、协调能力，能够独立推动项目落地；
4、结果导向、有韧性，能够在多线并行下完成工作；
5、具备优秀的公开演讲与商务宣讲能力，控场能力佳，能够独立面向企业中高层输出专业方案；能快速赢得客户信任，且有丰富的一号位对话经验，能灵活适配各种沟通风格。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：飞书商业化团队（Go to Market）负责将飞书先进产品和服务全面推向中国和国际市场，通过制定精准的业务战略，进行破圈的市场营销，深入理解不同行业的趋势和特点，传递飞书的理念和价值给不同行业的企业客户并达成业务合作，帮助客户加强使用深度和广度，最终让飞书成为各行各业先进企业的首选、持续助力企业组织升级。目前已在中国、新加坡、美国、日本等国家和地区建立了商业化团队，开启了为全球各行各业组织和个人提升创造力和效率的历程。

1、培训产品的体系建设与研发，主导全品类产品矩阵的顶层设计与体系化搭建，立足产品迭代方向与边界，持续提升产品的市场竞争力与行业适配性；
2、商业化链路跑通与增长，打通从培训产品设计到价值变现的全链路商业闭环，沉淀可复制的增长方法论与标杆案例，驱动年度商业化业绩指标的高效达成；
3、能够独立完成产品方案的Pitch宣讲，输出贴合客户需求的定制化方案等，支撑商机转化；
4、项目交付与客户价值落地，独立完成客户培训、公开课、内部宣讲等场景的讲授任务，具备客户预期管理、项目风险预判与问题闭环能力，保障项目顺利通过客户验收；
5、模式创新与能力沉淀，基于飞书现有产品能力与AI技术优势，迭代升级传统培训交付方法论，探索「工具产品+方法论+服务」的新交付模式。

工作城市：武汉 / 上海 / 北京 / 深圳

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Search & Vector Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Team:
The Search team is dedicated to building a fully managed, one-stop platform for information retrieval and analytics. Deeply compatible with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, and Milvus, the platform serves four core scenarios—GenAI
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
- B.S in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field.
- Strong software engineering skills in C++, Golang, Java, or Python.
- Experience with search engines, databases, storage systems, or distributed systems.
- Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch or Milvus in production or system development.
- Strong understanding of distributed systems and performance optimization.

Preferred Qualifications
- Deep experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Lucene, Milvus/Knowhere, or similar systems.
- Strong knowledge of full-text search and (multi)-vector indexing, including HNSW, IVF, DiskANN, or related ANN algorithms.
- 5 years experience optimizing billion-scale or larger vector retrieval for latency, throughput, recall, and cost.
- 5 years experience with cloud-native storage, compute-storage separation, object storage, or lakehouse/lakebase architectures.

岗位描述：
About the Team:
The Search team is dedicated to building a fully managed, one-stop platform for information retrieval and analytics. Deeply compatible with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, and Milvus, the platform serves four core scenarios—GenAI applications, search, security, and observability—and provides comprehensive capabilities across full-text search, vector search, geospatial search, and hybrid search. We are also building next-generation Agentic Search products, including RAG, AI-powered search, and multimodal retrieval, continuously pushing the boundaries of intelligent search technology.
We are deeply involved in the open-source ecosystem and have contributed hundreds of PRs across the OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Lucene, and Milvus communities. Several members of our team hold key leadership roles in these communities, including Governing Board Member, Technical Steering Committee Member, PMC Member, and Maintainer, helping shape the evolution of the broader search and database ecosystem through sustained technical contributions.
On the business side, we not only provide reliable infrastructure for some of ByteDance’s largest-scale vector and full-text hybrid search workloads, but also deliver enterprise-grade cloud search services to external customers through Volcano Engine, helping businesses unlock growth through data. We embrace a pragmatic yet ambitious engineering culture: while continuously publishing innovative research at top-tier conferences such as VLDB and ICDE, we remain strongly focused on real-world impact and commercial adoption, building a comprehensive product portfolio that serves a wide range of search and AI use cases.
Our team brings together leading database researchers and exceptional engineers from around the world. We are looking for talented individuals with expertise in search or vector database engine development, distributed systems architecture, or AI model innovation to join us. Together, we will explore uncharted technical territory, define the data foundation for the AI era, and empower both ByteDance and enterprises across industries to achieve AI-driven transformation.

Responsibilities
- Develop and evolve our Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and Milvus products, building high-performance and scalable search and vector retrieval capabilities.
- Develop high-performance full-text and vector search, including hybrid search, filtered search, multi-vector search, and large-scale ANN retrieval.
- Optimize vector indexing and distributed retrieval across HNSW, IVF, DiskANN, RaBitQ, storage, caching, and I/O.
- Explore cloud-native Vector Lakebase architectures for scalable search over data lakes and object storage.

工作城市：西雅图

团队介绍：抖音搜索是抖音的核心产品能力之一，满足用户找内容、找商品、找服务、找经验、找人等多元需求，基于海量的内容和商品供给、领先的意图识别和产品能力，用户搜索规模保持高速增长，快速成为中国第一梯队的移动搜索平台。抖音搜索业务体系完善，涵盖内容、电商、生活服务、推荐、交互、数据分析等多个方向。AI大模型和抖音内容生态的结合，会给抖音搜索带来的新的增长动力！

1、负责电商搜索行业运营工作，紧跟行业垂直化发展趋势，深入理解不同行业商家经营特征与搜索运营诉求，结合商家类型沉淀有效
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，3年及以上电商或内容平台运营经验；
2、具备商家运营、行业运营或营销活动运营经验，熟悉搜索、推荐及营销相关玩法，对电商经营链路有较好理解；
3、具备较强的数据分析能力和业务敏感度，能够独立完成数据提取、效果归因及AB实验复盘，熟练使用SQL、Excel等工具；
4、具备较强的结构化思维和方法论沉淀能力，能够将零散运营动作总结为标准化流程、策略框架和运营文档；
5、具备良好的跨团队协同能力、项目推动能力和结果导向意识。

加分项
1、有抖音电商、搜索、直播相关业务经验；
2、有KA商家对接及深度运营经验；
3、有对赌机制设计、营销策略搭建或复杂项目运营经验。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：抖音搜索是抖音的核心产品能力之一，满足用户找内容、找商品、找服务、找经验、找人等多元需求，基于海量的内容和商品供给、领先的意图识别和产品能力，用户搜索规模保持高速增长，快速成为中国第一梯队的移动搜索平台。抖音搜索业务体系完善，涵盖内容、电商、生活服务、推荐、交互、数据分析等多个方向。AI大模型和抖音内容生态的结合，会给抖音搜索带来的新的增长动力！

1、负责电商搜索行业运营工作，紧跟行业垂直化发展趋势，深入理解不同行业商家经营特征与搜索运营诉求，结合商家类型沉淀有效的搜索运营策略和方法论；
2、面向行业持续推进搜索运营动作落地，推动商家在搜索场景下的经营渗透与长期经营意识建设，关注运营动作执行效果及收益表现，持续优化运营策略；
3、负责看后搜、品类营销、对赌机制等横向营销产品的运营落地，整合搜索侧营销资源与流量点位，提升搜索流量效率，带动PV、GMV等核心指标增长；
4、联动产品、策略、数据分析、行业运营等团队，推动搜索营销产品、运营机制和行业解决方案迭代，形成可规模化复制的行业运营体系；
5、通过数据分析、归因评估和实验复盘，识别业务机会与问题，沉淀标准化SOP、行业运营白皮书及最佳实践，提升行业运营效率。

工作城市：杭州

jobs.title: AI系统架构师（Env Sandbox方向）-基础技术
jobs.description:
1、作为团队核心成员，负责构建支撑下一代AI Agent进化的“环境”——Env Sandbox系统；
2、通过极致的工程优化，为大规模强化学习（RL）提供高性能、可扩展的仿真环境；
3、负责设计并实现支持多OS（Windows，Android，Linux）的AI Agent沙箱环境，攻克沙箱启动吞吐量和延迟瓶颈，优化长链条下的资源利用率；
4、实现Sandbox Snapshot（快照复位）、远程存储挂载、网络安全策略（ACL）隔离等企业级特性；
5、适配异构GPU与各类计
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上底层系统、虚拟化或容器研发经验；
2、精通Linux内核、KVM/QEMU或虚拟化技术，有Windows/Android仿真经验者优先考虑；
3、熟悉Containerd/RunC等容器运行时，具备深度的系统性能调优能力；
4、具备较强的网络基础，熟悉CNI、VPC或相关网络协议栈设计；
5、熟悉C++/Go/Python其中至少两门语言，工程水平扎实。

岗位描述：
1、作为团队核心成员，负责构建支撑下一代AI Agent进化的“环境”——Env Sandbox系统；
2、通过极致的工程优化，为大规模强化学习（RL）提供高性能、可扩展的仿真环境；
3、负责设计并实现支持多OS（Windows，Android，Linux）的AI Agent沙箱环境，攻克沙箱启动吞吐量和延迟瓶颈，优化长链条下的资源利用率；
4、实现Sandbox Snapshot（快照复位）、远程存储挂载、网络安全策略（ACL）隔离等企业级特性；
5、适配异构GPU与各类计算硬件，确保Agent在复杂环境下的感知与执行效率；
6、集成RL Post-Training基础设施，支持大规模并行采样与训练任务。

工作城市：北京

jobs.title: 大数据开发工程师（数据BP） - 数据平台
jobs.description: 团队介绍：数据平台是字节跳动数据中台部门，为公司多业务线（包括抖音、电商、直播和生活服务等）提供一站式大数据解决方案，涵盖数据的生产、清洗、传输、建模、分析等全流程链路，提供数据开发、实验评估、画像标签、增强分析等多元场景解决能力。同时，数据平台部门也致力于把字节跳动积累沉淀的数据中台解决方案做商业化输出，让更多行业能够应用我们的产品能力构建自己的数据中台。在火山引擎上，我们提供了营销增长套件，数据中台等相关产品解决方案，为泛互联网、金融、汽车、新零售等行业提供了行业解决方案

2、熟练使用Hadoop及Hive，熟悉SQL、Java、Python等编程语言；
3、善于沟通，对业务敏感，能快速理解业务背景，具备优秀的技术与业务结合能力；
4、具备AI提效意识，能在日常工作中主动使用AI工具提升交付效率，对AI在数据研发中的应用有自己的判断与实践。

jobs.title: DSP固件工程师 - PICO
jobs.description:
团队介绍：作为一家拥有自主创新和研发创造能力的科技品牌，PICO致力于成为领先的世界级XR平台，成就开发者与创作者，共同为全球消费者创造更美好的生活体验。我们开创性地将虚拟现实扩展到了多个领域，为运动、视频、娱乐等消费级场景带来了全新体验；并广泛应用在教育、医疗和企业培训等商用场景，给全球企业级用户提供了多元化的VR解决方案。

1、负责设计并实现传感器数据预处理、噪声抑制、运动伪影去除、基线漂移校正、信号特征提取等数字信号处理模块；与嵌入式工程师紧密协作，将信号处理移植、优
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，电子工程、信号与信息处理、通信工程、自动化、计算机等相关专业，具备扎实的数字信号处理理论功底，3年以上信号处理工作经验，有量产产品从0到1的完整交付经历；
2、精通PPG、Touch、IMU等底层信号的数字处理，深入理解传感器工作原理、噪声特性、校准方法及运动伪影抑制技术，精通数字信号处理理论，熟练掌握FIR/IIR滤波、傅里叶变换、时频分析、小波变换、自适应滤波、统计信号处理、参数估计等，能针对传感器信号特性独立设计并优化完整的信号处理链路；
3、精通固件设计，具备扎实的C/C++编程能力，有ARM Cortex-M/RISC-V等嵌入式平台移植、定点化优化和内存/功耗优化经验，熟练使用MATLAB/Python等工具进行原型开发、仿真验证与数据分析，具备从原型到产品化的完整落地能力；
4、具备与嵌入式工程师、硬件工程师跨职能协作的实际项目经验，能够理解硬件约束并在固件设计中做出合理工程权衡，能看懂原理图和电路设计；
5、具备良好的问题分析能力和工程思维，能够在计算资源、功耗和精度之间取得最优平衡，工作积极主动，具备较强的沟通能力和团队协作精神。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：作为一家拥有自主创新和研发创造能力的科技品牌，PICO致力于成为领先的世界级XR平台，成就开发者与创作者，共同为全球消费者创造更美好的生活体验。我们开创性地将虚拟现实扩展到了多个领域，为运动、视频、娱乐等消费级场景带来了全新体验；并广泛应用在教育、医疗和企业培训等商用场景，给全球企业级用户提供了多元化的VR解决方案。

1、负责设计并实现传感器数据预处理、噪声抑制、运动伪影去除、基线漂移校正、信号特征提取等数字信号处理模块；与嵌入式工程师紧密协作，将信号处理移植、优化并部署到资源受限的可穿戴设备端（MCU/DSP），兼顾精度、功耗与实时性；与EE工程师协作，参与传感器选型、硬件电路设计评审、模拟前端调试及信号质量评估，从信号源头保障数据质量；
2、负责PPG（光电容积脉搏波）及其他传感器（ECG、温度、气压等）的底层信号处理研发与工程化落地；
3、负责基于多传感器信号的上层数字信号处理（运动姿态识别、活动追踪、生理信号特征提取与模式识别等）的设计、落地、调优与量产验证，持续提升在真实复杂场景下的鲁棒性与精度；
4、建立传感器信号质量评估体系与测试规范，设计Benchmark和真实场景验证方案，确保在复杂环境下的稳定性和准确性；
5、跟踪行业前沿技术与学术进展，持续优化数字信号处理性能，推动产品体验迭代升级。

工作城市：北京

jobs.title: 运筹优化研究员-基础技术
jobs.description:

2、探索“AI for OR”，在运筹优化算法链路中落地LLM和Agent技术，包括但不限于基于自然语言的决策引擎入口、算法结果可解释性增强。
jobs.requirementText:
1、具有博士学位，具备优秀的研究背景，在Data/系统/AI领域的顶会（CCF-A）有一作论文；
2、具备扎实的运筹学理论基础，精通线性规划、整数规划、组合优化等领域知识，熟练掌握至少一种商业或开源求解器（如Gurobi、CPLEX、CP-SAT等）；熟悉常用的（元）启发式算法（如遗传算法、模拟退火等）；有实际落地经验；
3、具备优秀的工程实现能力和代码规范，熟练使用Python/C++/Java等至少一种编程语言，熟悉常用数据结构与算法；具备优秀的逻辑思维能力和业务抽象能力，能够将模糊的业务需求转化为清晰的技术方案；沟通表达顺畅，团队意识强，协作能力好。

加分项

2、大模型：熟悉LLM，强化学习和LangGraph等Agent框架，具备PE调优和Agent开发的经验，对传统运筹优化和生成式AI的结合有兴趣和见解。

4、负责Kubernetes核心Controller及相关Operator组件的研发维护、版本适配和稳定性治理，保障大规模对象下状态收敛、队列、重试及故障恢复行为可控；

jobs.title: Tech Lead Cloud Site Reliability Engineer - DCS Cloud
jobs.description: Our Infrastructure Engineering team supports the company's fast growth by building and operating hyper-scale datacenters, managing the life cycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions, and developing various infrastructure services and
jobs.requirementText:
Minimal Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in Linux operations, SRE, or DevOps;
- Proficient in at least one programming language such as Go, Python, or C++, with solid engineering capabilities in platform development, system tooling, and automation.
- Strong computer science fundamentals, with deep understanding of Linux OS principles, computer networks, storage systems, GPU systems, and databases, along with systematic troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
- Familiar with core reliability practices, including monitoring and alerting, capacity management, change management, canary/gray releases, incident response, and postmortem processes.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to proactively identify problems, drive cross-team execution, and demonstrate strong ownership and results-oriented mindset.

Preferred Qualifications
- Hands-on experience operating public cloud platforms, or deep familiarity with major cloud providers such as OCI, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc, including understanding of their underlying mechanisms.
- Experience with large-scale cloud host delivery, image/AMI systems, resource scheduling, network adaptation, and virtualization technologies such as KVM/QEMU.
- Familiar with containers and cloud-native ecosystems, including Docker, Kubernetes, and containerd, with a solid understanding of isolation mechanisms like cgroups and namespaces.
- Experience maintaining GPU clusters, including drivers, CUDA, MIG, topology awareness, troubleshooting, stress testing, and GPU delivery pipelines.
- Proven experience in reliability-focused initiatives such as failure drill systems, capacity governance, change governance, observability platforms, and resource cost optimization.
- Open-source contributions, technical blogs, patents, or technical sharing experience are highly preferred.
- Experience operating large-scale production environments is a strong plus.

岗位描述：
Our Infrastructure Engineering team supports the company's fast growth by building and operating hyper-scale datacenters, managing the life cycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions, and developing various infrastructure services and making sure they are scalable and are reliable.

We have three subgroups for this role: 
- Cloud Host Delivery, Delivery & Standardization 
- Cloud Host Operation, Operation Efficiency & Reliability
- Cloud Management & Security

Responsibilities - What You'll Do
- Design, build, scale, and operate ByteDance’s global infrastructure, including large-scale systems spanning public and private clouds.
- Develop tools, automation frameworks, visualizations, and monitoring systems to streamline operations and drive optimization of global infrastructure.
- Create, manage, and standardize cloud AMIs/images for use across multiple environments, ensuring strict alignment with the company's global compliance standards.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment, engaging in technical operations and on-call rotations to address incidents related to cloud, OS, network, performance, and reliability.
- Drive improvements across the entire infrastructure lifecycle, from ideation and design through development, deployment, user support, and continuous refinement.

jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications 
- 5+ years of corporate security experience (contractor or full-time), including 2+ years in a security management role with progressive responsibilities.
- Multi-site, multi-country security operations management, with a proven track record of high performance and cross-regional coordination.
- New office security setup experience, including risk assessments, access control design, CCTV deployment, and other technical security controls.
- Hands-on proficiency with physical security systems: access control, video management, life safety, and visitor management platforms.
- Strong documentation capabilities: able to develop and maintain site-specific checklists, post orders, and standard operating procedures.
- Incident and crisis response leadership: demonstrated ability to manage complex security incidents, emergencies, and business disruptions end-to-end.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; adaptable to fast-paced environments with flexible availability including travel on short notice, after-hours response, and weekend/holiday coverage as needed.

Preferred Qualifications 
- CPP, PSP, PCI, CSMP, CBCP, or equivalent credentials are preferred.
- Background in law enforcement, military, intelligence, or corporate security is highly advantageous.
- Experience in technology companies or multinational corporate environments.
- Regional market experience: hands-on security operations management in at least two of the following: Hong Kong, Japan, Korea.
- Guarding program management: experience leading or significantly contributing to guarding RFPs, with deep knowledge of security personnel hiring, training, development, and performance management.
- People management experience with direct supervisory or team leadership responsibility.
- Threat Management Program ownership: responsible for identifying, assessing, and managing dynamic threats to people and facilities.
- Major event security support: experience conducting venue risk assessments and providing live event security operations.
- Broad physical security program familiarity, including Travel Security, Global Security Operations Centres (GSOCs), Business Continuity, and Investigations.
- Financial acumen and commercial awareness, including budget planning and management; undergraduate or Master's degree in a related field is a plus.

岗位描述：
Team Introduction
The role will lead physical security operations, risk governance, crisis management and strategic security initiatives across North-east Asia, including Hong Kong, Japan and Korea. The position serves as the sub-regional lead responsible for driving operational excellence, strengthening regional resilience, and ensuring consistent implementation of corporate security standards across multiple offices.

The role partners closely with regional leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, external agencies, and global security teams to manage complex security operations, critical incidents, and vendor governance.

Responsibilities 
- Lead physical security strategy and operational governance across Hong Kong, Japan and Korea. 
- Act as the primary escalation point for significant security incidents, crisis management coordination, and regional emergency response. 
- Drive consistency and standardisation of security programs, policies and operating procedures across North-east Asia and Hong Kong sites.
- Provide strategic oversight of guarding vendors, security budgets, KPIs, and operational performance across multiple countries. 
- Partner with business leaders, Workplace, Legal, HR and global security teams on risk mitigation and regional security priorities. 
- Lead complex regional projects including new office security design, event security planning, and business continuity initiatives.
- Conduct regional risk assessments and provide strategic recommendations for geopolitical, operational, and workplace security risks.
- Manage and develop country security personnel and vendors to ensure scalable and high-performing regional operations.
- Support regional crisis management structures and participate in cross-functional incident command and emergency response leadership.
- Support workplace investigations as needed.
- Deputise for the APAC Regional Security Lead as required.
