jobs.title: Quality & Training Specialist - VSO - Sinhala Speaking
jobs.description: The Quality & Training Specialist (QTS) department ensures that safety policies are enforced accurately and consistently at scale. The Q&T Market Lead acts as the strategic bridge between high-level policy and boots-on-the-ground execution.
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
1. Quality Assurance Experience: Min 1 year of proven expertise in conducting analytical audits, tracking performance targets, and maintaining data integrity within a trust and safety, compliance, or high-volume operational environment.
2. Problem-Solving Skills and Ownership: Strong capability in conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA), identifying trend patterns, and suggesting process optimizations that reduce error rates while maintaining high-speed moderation. High level of self-motivation with the ability to operate independently, demonstrate end-to-end ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
3. Policy Interpretation & Judgment: Deep understanding of content policies and SOPs, with the critical thinking skills required to make expert judgments on complex or high-risk escalation cases.
4. Cross-Functional Communication: Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to lead calibration sessions, deliver training, and partner with BPO and internal teams to align on global quality goals.
5. Technical & Reporting Proficiency: Fluency in data visualization, reporting, and utilizing QA/calibration tools. Ability to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) to streamline workflows and provide actionable feedback on system functionality.
6. Fluency in Sinhala is required to review and evaluate Sinhala-language content and ensure accurate understanding of local linguistic and cultural context. Fluency in English is also required as the primary working language for internal communication, documentation, and collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
1. Experience working in fast-paced, high-volume operational environments
2. Strong attention to detail with ability to follow structured frameworks and guidelines

岗位描述：
The Quality & Training Specialist (QTS) department ensures that safety policies are enforced accurately and consistently at scale. The Q&T Market Lead acts as the strategic bridge between high-level policy and boots-on-the-ground execution. While Specialists focus on quality assurance, the Lead focuses on systemic scalability, proactive operational risk identification and mitigation, and team excellence.
This role requires commitment to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as operational needs demand.

What will I be doing?
- Quality Assurance & Auditing: Conduct regular analytical audits of human moderation, ensuring all processes comply with data protection and Trust & Safety standards while maintaining specific audit targets (e.g., Accuracy, RCA, and Appeal success rates).
- Data Analysis & RCA: Perform deep-dives into recurring quality issues through Root Cause Analysis (RCA), spot error patterns, and translate data into actionable feedback for Operational Guidelines & Standards and Operations Teams to drive continuous process optimization.
- Policy Interpretation & Curation: Act as an authority to provide expert judgment on complex, ambiguous, or high-risk cases under quality methodologies and processes (like KOM). Deeply interpret safety guidelines and validate "golden sets" (benchmark data) to guide enforcement accuracy.
- Calibration & Collaboration: Lead calibration sessions to ensure consistency across different moderation teams. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (BPO Partners, PPS, PS, and OGS teams) to simplify complex policy explanations and drive global quality goals.
- Operational Oversight & Escalation: Manage and resolve unprecedented "edge cases" with speed and accuracy. Drive policy cascading to ensure new policies & operational guidelines updates are 100% communicated and implemented across all relevant internal and external partners.
- Technical Reporting & AI Utilization: Leverage AI to improve performance and reduce manual, repetitive tasks. Utilize QA dashboards, RCA tools, and calibration platforms to prepare comprehensive weekly and monthly reports focusing on market accuracy, error trends, and policy gaps.
- Training & Policy Cascade: Lead or support training rollouts for new policy changes and operational guideline updates, especially for BPO staff, ensuring changes are clearly understood, operationalized, and consistently applied. This is estimated to take up around 20% of total monthly output deliverables.
- This role requires commitment to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as operational needs demand.

工作城市：古尔冈

jobs.requirementText:
1、1-3年企业行政工作经验优先；

1、具备统计、经济、商业分析或数据科学相关背景，熟悉Excel、数据可视化及SQL/Python/R等分析工具，拥有战略/咨询/分析类实践经验，并能基于数字广告指标输出可执行的业务建议。

jobs.requirementText:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer / Researcher, AI-Native database systems
jobs.description:
About the Team
Join ByteDance’s database R&D team, where you’ll build and own cutting-edge database products supporting Bytedance’s global infrastructure. Our diverse portfolio includes relational databases, distributed caches, key-value st
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualification
- Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related fields with strong systems or AI research experience.
- 2+ years in core database systems, large-scale distributed infrastructure, or machine learning systems.
- Strong coding and system-level design skills in C++ / Rust / Go.
- Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas: Storage engine architecture (LSM-trees, column stores, HTAP systems) / Vector retrieval systems, similarity search, and ANN indexing / AI infra or model-serving infrastructure (especially for embeddings / RAG / LLMs) / Semantic search, agent systems, or AI-native memory frameworks
- Ability to collaborate across research, engineering, and product teams to translate ideas into production systems.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with open-source systems such as Faiss, Milvus, DuckDB, ClickHouse, TiKV, RocksDB.
- Publications at accredited conferences (e.g., SIGMOD, VLDB, NeurIPS, MLSys, ICDE).
- Familiarity with GCP, AWS, or Azure’s database and AI integration strategies.
- Prior contributions to RAG, memory-augmented models, or self-tuning database components.

岗位描述：
About the Team
Join ByteDance’s database R&D team, where you’ll build and own cutting-edge database products supporting Bytedance’s global infrastructure. Our diverse portfolio includes relational databases, distributed caches, key-value stores, document databases, graph databases, wide-column stores, search engines, and multi-model databases. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to enhance these services in a cloud-native environment, embracing a culture of intellectual curiosity, self-direction, and problem-solving. 

About the Role
We are building the next-generation AI-native database systems—intelligent, multimodal, and designed for the era of large models. Our systems are not just data stores; they’re reasoning engines, retrieval platforms, and real-time memory for AI agents. As a Senior Software Engineer or Researcher, you will be at the forefront of rethinking how databases work when built from the ground up for AI workloads. You’ll help create infrastructure that powers intelligent systems across TikTok, CapCut, and future applications that haven’t been imagined yet.

Responsibilities
- Architect and implement AI-native databases that seamlessly integrate structured, unstructured, and vectorized data.
- Design storage engines optimized for embedding ingestion, multimodal retrieval, and real-time AI interaction.
- Build scalable and distributed vector search systems  with low-latency guarantees.
- Develop AI-augmented query processors that leverage large language models (LLMs) for semantic parsing, intent understanding, and cost estimation.
- Collaborate on developing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) infrastructure and LLM agent memory backends.
- Drive innovations in learned index structures, self-optimizing databases, and AI-integrated transaction systems.
- Publish and contribute to broader research and open-source communities.


工作城市：西雅图

1、评测体系建设：参与大模型评测的工程基础设施的开发工作，包括评测集的接入、生产、管理，评测对象的链路采样，人评/机评能力建设，评估结果的分析等评测核心能力的开发工作；
2、评测Agent搭建：探索自动评测、高质量评测集构建等前沿评测方法，在评测场景搭建AI Agent，为评测业务提供端到端的高效、自动化的交付能力。
jobs.requirementText:
1、计算机或相关专业本科及以上学历，具备扎实的编程能力、数据结构与算法基础；
2、具备全栈（前后端、Agent）开发能力，能独立设计开发高性能、高可用的分布式系统，掌握常用的存储与中间件技术，了解前端开发框架，对常用的前后端开发语言有技术鉴赏和判断力；
3、熟悉大模型的原理及应用，具备Agent框架开发经验，能够设计并实现复杂的Agent系统用于解决具体的业务问题；

5、有良好的业务及产品意识，能够将业务问题转化为定义明确的技术问题，并通过技术手段有效解决；
6、坦诚清晰、积极乐观，责任心强有负责人意识，工作认真细致严谨，具有优秀的团队沟通与协作能力，热爱技术，有较强的学习能力，有强烈的求知欲、好奇心和进取心，能及时关注和学习业界最新技术，对解决挑战性问题充满激情。

加分项：
1、对大模型技术及其应用有浓厚兴趣，有Agent及大模型评测体系建设经验、熟悉大模型训练、或熟悉LLM-as-a-Judge相关经验者优先；
2、有Agent在复杂业务场景的落地经验或多Agent系统设计经验的优先；
3、积极参与开源社区，有相关贡献者优先。

1、评测体系建设：参与大模型评测的工程基础设施的开发工作，包括评测集的接入、生产、管理，评测对象的链路采样，人评/机评能力建设，评估结果的分析等评测核心能力的开发工作；
2、评测Agent搭建：探索自动评测、高质量评测集构建等前沿评测方法，在评测场景搭建AI Agent，为评测业务提供端到端的高效、自动化的交付能力。

jobs.title: 游戏资深用户研究员 - 游戏业务管理办公室
jobs.description:
团队介绍：游戏业务管理办公室主要是为游戏业务的管理者和项目团队提供经营管理、研发管理、用户研究、商业分析、合规管理、外包管理等支持工作。

1、负责一至两个游戏产品或明确研究模块的用户研究工作，持续理解产品阶段、目标用户、体验和关键版本节点；
2、根据概念验证、玩法原型、版本测试、上线准备及运营迭代等不同阶段，识别研究问题并制定合适的研究方案；
3、独立完成需求澄清、研究设计、用户招募与执行管理、数据分析、报告撰写和结果跟进；
4、综合运用深度访谈、可用性测试、概念测试、问卷
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，5年以上用户研究工作经验，具备用户研究、游戏研究、市场研究相关背景，有游戏行业经验者优先；
2、能够独立完成较完整的研究项目，理解研究问题、方法选择、证据和结论边界之间的关系；
3、掌握常用定性与定量研究方法，能够根据业务问题选择合适的方法，而非机械套用模板；
4、具备良好的分析和报告能力，能够从复杂材料中提炼发现，建立结论与证据之间的清晰关系；
5、具备产品意识与良好的综合素养：
1）愿意深入理解玩法、系统、研发阶段和玩家动机，并将研究与产品决策连接起来；
2）具备较强的责任心和主动性，能够管理研究进度、主动识别风险，并对交付质量负责；
3）沟通清晰、协作意识良好，能够与不同职能的团队成员建立稳定的合作关系；
6、热爱游戏，对一个或多个游戏品类有持续、深入的体验和理解。

加分项
1、有游戏研发阶段研究的经验；
2、有策略、卡牌、竞技、女性向或其他系统型游戏的研究或深度体验；
3、有国际玩家研究、英文访谈或跨地区研究经验；
4、能够结合行为数据、运营数据或市场信息解释玩家体验问题。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：游戏业务管理办公室主要是为游戏业务的管理者和项目团队提供经营管理、研发管理、用户研究、商业分析、合规管理、外包管理等支持工作。

1、负责一至两个游戏产品或明确研究模块的用户研究工作，持续理解产品阶段、目标用户、体验和关键版本节点；
2、根据概念验证、玩法原型、版本测试、上线准备及运营迭代等不同阶段，识别研究问题并制定合适的研究方案；
3、独立完成需求澄清、研究设计、用户招募与执行管理、数据分析、报告撰写和结果跟进；
4、综合运用深度访谈、可用性测试、概念测试、问卷调研等方法，为产品团队提供可靠的玩家证据；
5、与策划、产品、运营、数据等团队紧密合作，将研究发现转化为清晰、可执行的产品建议，并跟进研究结论的应用；
6、持续沉淀所负责产品的玩家认知、体验问题和历史研究结论，建设可复用的研究资产。

工作城市：上海 / 深圳 / 杭州 / 广州

jobs.title: Cloud Site Reliability Engineer - DCS Cloud
jobs.description: Our Infrastructure Engineering team supports the company's fast growth by building and operating hyper-scale datacenters, managing the life cycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions, and developing various infrastructure services and
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related field.
- 2+ years of experience in Linux operations, SRE, or DevOps
- Proficient in at least one programming language such as Go, Python, or C++, with solid engineering capabilities in platform development, system tooling, and automation.
- Strong computer science fundamentals, with deep understanding of Linux OS principles, computer networks, storage systems, GPU systems, and databases, along with systematic troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
- Familiar with core reliability practices, including monitoring and alerting, capacity management, change management, canary/gray releases, incident response, and postmortem processes.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to proactively identify problems, drive cross-team execution, and demonstrate strong ownership and results-oriented mindset.

Preferred Qualifications
- Hands-on experience operating public cloud platforms, or deep familiarity with major cloud providers such as OCI, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc, including understanding of their underlying mechanisms.
- Experience with large-scale cloud host delivery, image/AMI systems, resource scheduling, network adaptation, and virtualization technologies such as KVM/QEMU.
- Familiar with containers and cloud-native ecosystems, including Docker, Kubernetes, and containerd, with a solid understanding of isolation mechanisms like cgroups and namespaces.
- Experience maintaining GPU clusters, including drivers, CUDA, MIG, topology awareness, troubleshooting, stress testing, and GPU delivery pipelines.
- Proven experience in reliability-focused initiatives such as failure drill systems, capacity governance, change governance, observability platforms, and resource cost optimization.
- Open-source contributions, technical blogs, patents, or technical sharing experience are highly preferred.
- Experience operating large-scale production environments is a strong plus.

岗位描述：
Our Infrastructure Engineering team supports the company's fast growth by building and operating hyper-scale datacenters, managing the life cycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions, and developing various infrastructure services and making sure they are scalable and are reliable.

We have three subgroups for this role: 
- Cloud Host Delivery, Delivery & Standardization 
- Cloud Host Operation, Operation Efficiency & Reliability
- Cloud Management & Security

Responsibilities - What You'll Do
- Design, build, scale, and operate ByteDance’s global infrastructure, including large-scale systems spanning public and private clouds.
- Develop tools, automation frameworks, visualizations, and monitoring systems to streamline operations and drive optimization of global infrastructure.
- Create, manage, and standardize cloud AMIs/images for use across multiple environments, ensuring strict alignment with the company's global compliance standards.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment, engaging in technical operations and on-call rotations to address incidents related to cloud, OS, network, performance, and reliability.
- Drive improvements across the entire infrastructure lifecycle, from ideation and design through development, deployment, user support, and continuous refinement.

jobs.requirementText:

岗位描述：
About the Team
Join ByteDance’s database development team, where you’ll build and own cutting-edge database products supporting ByteDance’s global infrastructure. Our diverse portfolio includes relational databases, distributed caches, key-value stores, document databases, graph databases, wide-column stores, search engines, and multi-model databases. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to enhance these services in a cloud-native environment, embracing a culture of intellectual curiosity, self-direction, and problem-solving.  We embrace a culture of self-direction, intellectual curiosity, openness, and problem-solving.  We are looking for candidates to work in an open, agile, and highly collaborative environment in the following areas:
- Database and system administration, including ensuring the reliability and observability of databases in a global large-scale network and efficiently handling user requests.

- Disaster recovery and high availability, including global cross-region database disaster recovery solutions, providing efficient and rapid high-availability switching capabilities and data consistency guarantees.

- Conduct performance and scalability tests and research innovative ideas for improvement.
- Design and implement comprehensive unit, functional and system-test for product quality.
- Participate in the release and deployment process.
- Solve unique, large-scale, highly complex cloud infrastructure problems.

jobs.requirementText:

jobs.title: 服饰商品策略运营-TikTok Shop
jobs.description:
1、供给策略与分货盘管理：负责搭建跨境服饰行业的分货盘管理体系，研究并优化供给策略，提升供给效率；负责红蓝海货盘、场域货盘、国家主推货盘等供给结构的设计，定义货盘特征与标准；负责联通场域运营团队，输出针对不同场景的运营策略，如大促盘货、特色主题盘货、新品盘货等；
2、供给优化与分发策略：结合服饰类目的特性，与搜索与推荐团队合作，优化商品分发，提高供给效率；研究场域与货盘的匹配逻辑，优化钱效比与资源效率，确保供给策略与平台业务目标协同发展；
3、数据分析与决策支持：具备货盘分析
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科以上学历，电商、市场、数据分析或相关专业优先；
2、具备电商行业相关经验，对消费者行为、服饰行业供给及货品策略有深入理解；有电商平台服饰运营经验者优先；
3、具备良好的逻辑思维和数据分析能力，能够通过数据挖掘规律，发现问题及业务机会，并输出可落地的解决方案；
4、具备较强的执行力及项目管理能力，能够协调多团队资源，实现业务目标；
5、具备良好的沟通协调能力，能够整合资源，与算法、数据、商品企划等跨部门团队协同合作，推动策略落地。

岗位描述：
1、供给策略与分货盘管理：负责搭建跨境服饰行业的分货盘管理体系，研究并优化供给策略，提升供给效率；负责红蓝海货盘、场域货盘、国家主推货盘等供给结构的设计，定义货盘特征与标准；负责联通场域运营团队，输出针对不同场景的运营策略，如大促盘货、特色主题盘货、新品盘货等；
2、供给优化与分发策略：结合服饰类目的特性，与搜索与推荐团队合作，优化商品分发，提高供给效率；研究场域与货盘的匹配逻辑，优化钱效比与资源效率，确保供给策略与平台业务目标协同发展；
3、数据分析与决策支持：具备货盘分析与诊断能力，负责输出相关盘货及分发策略；输出类目分析报告及招品指南，挖掘商品细分市场的供给机会，指引商家商品开发方向；研究商品生命周期，基于货盘与生命周期模型建立监控与分析体系，优化成长路径，提高资源与货盘匹配效率。

工作城市：上海

6、深入理解用户需求，与搜索、地点数据及其他业务团队协作，推动内容能力跨场景复用，结合用户反馈和业务指标持续迭代，对所负责模块的技术质量和业务效果负责。

jobs.title: Financial Service Partnership Director, AMS - Global Payment
jobs.description: The Global Payment team of ByteDance provides payment solutions - including payment acquisitions, disbursements, transaction monitoring, payment method management, foreign exchange conversion, accounting, reconciliations, financial services
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualification(s):
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze data and make data-driven decisions.
- Proven ability to manage multiple partnerships and projects simultaneously.
- Strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
- 5+ years of experience in partnership management, business development, or strategic roles within the financial service industry.
- Ideally, the candidate to have experience working in BNPL or insurance companies.
- Knowledge of financial service systems, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
- Strong negotiation and contract management skills.
- Occasional domestic and international travels

岗位描述：
The Global Payment team of ByteDance provides payment solutions - including payment acquisitions, disbursements, transaction monitoring, payment method management, foreign exchange conversion, accounting, reconciliations, financial services and so on to ensure that our users have a smooth and secure payment experience on ByteDance platforms including TikTok.

This role is responsible for developing and managing financial service partnerships to achieve best-in-class  solutions such as BNPL, merchant financing, insurance, etc. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the financial service industry, excellent relationship management skills, and a proven track record of driving results through strategic collaborations.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key partners, ensuring continuous alignment and collaboration.
- Identify and evaluate potential strategic partners to enhance financial service capabilities.
- Develop and execute partnership strategies that align with the company’s objectives and growth plans.
- Negotiate and finalize partnership agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes.
- Engage associations, regulators and key authorities with cross-team members when required.
- Monitor and analyze financial service performance metrics to ensure optimal outcomes.
- Work closely with internal teams (e.g., Solution, Product, Compliance, Finance) to integrate partner solutions and enhance processes.
- Identify opportunities for new markets to fulfill new business development requirements.
- Staying up-to-date with industry trends, market developments, and competitive landscape in the global payments space, especially in the financial service area.
- Conducting market research to identify emerging opportunities and potential threats to the business.
- Provide insights and recommendations to the leadership team based on market analysis and partner feedback.
- Establish clear objectives and key results (OKRs) for partnerships. Track and report on the progress of OKRs, making adjustments as necessary to achieve targets.

工作城市：圣何塞

1、本科及以上学历，信息安全、计算机、通信等相关专业，具备3年以上企业信息安全技术相关工作经验；

jobs.title: 平台AI产品运营（用工管理方向）-TikTok
jobs.description:
1、负责用工管理平台及相关产品能力建设，覆盖人力规划与分配、人员与技能管理、供应商管理、任务/队列、权限配置、执行追踪及成本效率分析等场景，深入理解不同业务线、区域及用工模式下的业务流程，独立完成需求分析、产品方案设计、PRD、评审、UAT、上线及迭代，推动人员、岗位、技能、供应商、任务/队列等信息标准化、线上化；
2、结合用工管理及业务运营场景，识别适合通过AI和自动化提升效率的环节，探索大模型在需求理解、信息提取、配置生成、知识检索、数据校验、异常识别、资源匹配及运营决策
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上产品运营工作经验；
2、有To B平台、内部运营平台、Workforce Management、供应链、任务管理、项目管理等相关产品或运营经验；
3、具备较强的业务理解和流程梳理能力，能够独立完成复杂业务场景的需求分析和产品方案设计；
4、具备数据分析能力，熟悉SQL、Excel、BI等数据工具中的一种或多种，能够独立完成基础数据分析；
5、了解大模型及AI应用的基本能力，有Prompt、RAG、Agent、Workflow、AI Skill等相关实践经验。

加分项
1、有Workforce Management、人力规划、排班、产能规划、人员技能管理、BPO/供应商管理、人力成本或供需匹配经验；
2、有AI Workflow、Agent、RAG、知识库等企业级AI应用落地经验；
3、有标签平台、配置平台、规则引擎、权限系统、任务平台等平台型产品经验；
4、有内容审核、数据标注、客服、共享服务、供应链等运营场景经验；
5、有较强的数据能力，能够使用SQL独立完成数据提取、问题定位及效果分析；
6、英语可作为工作语言。

岗位描述：
1、负责用工管理平台及相关产品能力建设，覆盖人力规划与分配、人员与技能管理、供应商管理、任务/队列、权限配置、执行追踪及成本效率分析等场景，深入理解不同业务线、区域及用工模式下的业务流程，独立完成需求分析、产品方案设计、PRD、评审、UAT、上线及迭代，推动人员、岗位、技能、供应商、任务/队列等信息标准化、线上化；
2、结合用工管理及业务运营场景，识别适合通过AI和自动化提升效率的环节，探索大模型在需求理解、信息提取、配置生成、知识检索、数据校验、异常识别、资源匹配及运营决策等场景中的应用，参与AI Workflow、Agent、Skill等能力建设，推动跨系统查询、配置及运营操作自动化，并持续评估AI应用的准确率、覆盖率及效率收益；
3、梳理复杂业务流程及上下游系统关系，将共性需求沉淀为可复用的平台能力，参与标签、业务规则、数据口径、权限及配置体系建设，持续优化产品架构和系统边界，提升跨业务、跨系统的数据一致性及平台对多业务线、多区域和不同用工模式的灵活支持能力；
4、建立用工管理相关指标体系，围绕HC/FTE、人力供需、资源利用、成本、效率及质量等维度开展数据分析，通过数据监控识别流程及业务异常，支持人力规划、产能分析、供需匹配及成本效率分析，并以数据驱动产品、流程及运营策略持续优化；
5、与业务运营、Planning、产品、研发、数据、算法及供应商管理等团队紧密协作，负责项目计划、需求优先级及关键节点管理，协调解决项目推进中的问题，推动重点项目落地，并结合业务反馈和产品使用情况持续完善产品及运营机制。

工作城市：北京 / 上海

2、了解互联网广告业务的组织、流程、经营情况，能完整识别从产品开发到销售回款的所有风险，对固有风险、控制现状、剩余风险大小有准确的判断，量化潜在损失、治理收益与管理价值，并对组织管理问题、责任进行评估界定，为管理层提供判断依据；

jobs.title: Senior AI Legal Counsel - AI Legal
jobs.description: The Global Legal Business Partner, AI team provides front-line legal support for ByteDance’s AI products and businesses, spanning foundation models, AI platforms and applications, enterprise services, robotics, and hardware. We partner with
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Juris Doctor from an ABA-accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
- Have a strong knowledge and interest in the legal challenges in frontier and emerging AI risk areas, including CBRN, cyber and loss of control as well as areas including IP, privacy, bias and AI transparency. 
- Proven experience counseling on AI and ML, IP and cyber security,. Experience in both private practice and in-house experience at a technology platform company would be advantageous.
- Demonstrated success shaping policy outcomes or market launches for novel technologies. 
- Possess the highest standard of ethics and a positive attitude in learning and willing to pick up new knowledge and skills; comfortable navigating through ambiguous legal issues
- A builder’s bias for action, you can turn ambiguity into frameworks, experiments, and shipped products and have a strong track record of achieving alignment with internal cross-functional teams and external partners.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Willingness to be flexible to attend meetings outside of office hours, due to the global nature of this team

岗位描述：
The Global Legal Business Partner, AI team provides front-line legal support for ByteDance’s AI products and businesses, spanning foundation models, AI platforms and applications, enterprise services, robotics, and hardware. We partner with teams throughout the product lifecycle to help turn emerging technologies into responsible products and services for users and businesses around the world.

AI technology is advancing rapidly while laws, regulatory expectations, and industry standards continue to take shape across markets. We work alongside Product, Trust and Safety, Policy, Communications, and other cross-functional teams to strengthen AI governance, provide guidance on safety, privacy, and intellectual property considerations, and support responsible product development in line with evolving requirements.

You will contribute as significant AI products and capabilities are being built, bringing legal judgment to decisions that shape their design, development, and deployment. This is an opportunity to influence how ByteDance advances AI responsibly at scale while working at the forefront of law and technology.

About the Team:
ByteDance's AI Product and Frontier Risk Counseling team provides domain expert legal support to the company's AI products and models, in particular supporting our Seed business. The team is growing fast and as we scale, we’re looking for a seasoned lawyer to serve as a global legal expert and strategist who can pair deep policy expertise with a builder’s mindset as they help to guide our teams to turn cutting-edge ideas into trusted, world-class products. The role will be an integral resource for ByteDance's AI product and business teams by helping to craft strategic, market-facing narratives for our AI businesses that unlock new opportunities while also helping to solve some of the most challenging AI issues globally, including implementing policies, standards and best practices relating to frontier AI risk domains.
This is a highly collaborative, on-site role that requires five days per week in the office located in San Jose, CA.

Responsibilities:
- You will champion AI, working as a global subject matter expert helping to identify and resolve legal issues relating to emerging and frontier AI risks. You will also help craft strategic, market-leading legal strategies for our AI businesses that unlock new opportunities. 
- Collaborate with the AI product, TnS, Legal, AI Safety, PR and GR teams to establish and implement solutions to emerging compliance issues for frontier AI models.
- Identify, assess, and communicate the rapidly evolving global AI regulatory requirements and trends; support implementations by the product team.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager - Cloud Computing
jobs.description: As a Finance Business Partner (FBP) for Cloud computing resources, you will be embedded within the Infrastructure Engineering and Strategic Sourcing teams. You will act as the financial architect behind our global compute strategy, balancin
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
- At least 5 years Finance/Accounting with at least 3 years in Cloud, Infrastructure, or Data Center environments.
- Advanced financial modeling skills (Excel/Google Sheets) and familiarity with FinOps frameworks and cloud-native tools.
- Capable of translating "Kubernetes clusters and GPU latency" into "EBITDA impact and ROI."
- Proven resilience in high-growth, fast-paced environments with a collaborative and inclusive working style.
- High levels of written and oral fluency in Mandarin are required for this role. This is essential as collaboration with China-based stakeholders is necessary to ensure local financial strategy aligns seamlessly with group objectives, manage core financial systems, and safeguard capital allocation through cross-border contract review.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional designation is highly preferred.
- Proficiency in SQL or Python for analyzing large-scale billing datasets (CUR/Usage reports).

As a condition of employment, all successful candidates must be able to establish authorization to work in the United States. For this position, the Company does not provide sponsorship for any immigration-related benefits.

岗位描述：
As a Finance Business Partner (FBP) for Cloud computing resources, you will be embedded within the Infrastructure Engineering and Strategic Sourcing teams. You will act as the financial architect behind our global compute strategy, balancing hyper-growth AI demands with rigorous cost discipline. You will drive the financial evaluation of massive cloud contracts, lead FinOps initiatives, and ensure that every dollar spent on silicon or cloud credits translates into maximum business value.

- Commercial Modeling: Build complex TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) models to evaluate multi-year cloud commitments (e.g., AWS EDP, Azure MACC, GCP Commits).
- Buy vs. Build Analysis: Lead financial feasibility studies comparing "On-prem/Colocation" vs. "Public Cloud" deployments, factoring in CapEx, OpEx, and depreciation cycles.
- Vendor Negotiation: Provide data-driven leverage for procurement during negotiations with hyperscalers and GPU OEMs (NVIDIA, AMD), focusing on unit price erosion and volume discounts.
- Cost Attribution: Drive the implementation of a robust tagging and metadata strategy to ensure 100% cost transparency across business units (e.g., LLM Training vs. Inference).
- Unit Economics: Define and track "Unit Cost" metrics (e.g., Cost per 1k Tokens, Cost per MAU) to measure the efficiency of the engineering stack.
- Efficiency Optimization: Partner with DevOps to optimize Commitment Coverage (RI/SP) and increase Spot Instance utilization to reduce effective hourly rates.
- Budgeting & Forecasting: Own the cloud budget for global regions, managing monthly variance analysis (BvA) and articulating the "narrative" behind spend fluctuations.
- Capacity Planning: Translate engineering roadmaps (e.g., cluster expansions) into long-range financial plans (LRP), ensuring alignment with corporate margin targets.
- Accounting Standards: Ensure cloud contracts comply with IFRS standards and proper capitalization of R&D costs.
- Global Tax Strategy: Collaborate with tax teams to optimize cross-border cloud service billing, considering Withholding Tax (WHT) and Transfer Pricing.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Agent Memory Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About the Team
Join ByteDance’s AI Agent Memory Infrastructure team, where we build the core memory systems that power next-generation intelligent agents. Our focus is on creating a unified platform for long-term, conversational, and task-o
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related fields.
- Strong experience in distributed systems, databases, information retrieval systems, or AI infrastructure, with proven system design and production engineering capabilities.
- Proficient in at least one programming language such as Go, Python, or C++, with strong coding standards and engineering best practices.
- Solid understanding of core technologies in LLM applications, including but not limited to embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context engineering, retrieval systems, and long-term state management.
- Familiarity with one or more key areas in memory systems: memory extraction and representation, vector/graph indexing, retrieval and ranking, memory updating, compression and forgetting, multimodal memory fusion.
- Ability to analyze and optimize trade-offs across system performance, latency, cost, and scalability from both system and algorithm perspectives; 

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in agent memory systems, user profiling, recommendation/search feature platforms, or knowledge base systems. 
- Contributions to or deep understanding of open-source memory frameworks such as mem0, memOS, memU, or similar solutions. 
- Strong track record in databases, information retrieval, machine learning, or AI systems, including publications, impactful open-source work, or notable technical achievements. 
- Experience in multimodal data processing, online inference systems, personalized agents, or long-term user state modeling. 
- Experience with complex production systems is highly preferred.

岗位描述：
About the Team
Join ByteDance’s AI Agent Memory Infrastructure team, where we build the core memory systems that power next-generation intelligent agents. Our focus is on creating a unified platform for long-term, conversational, and task-oriented memory, enabling more personalized and context-aware AI experiences.
We design and operate large-scale, low-latency, and highly reliable memory infrastructure, covering the full lifecycle from storage and retrieval to updating and optimization. Working at the intersection of LLMs, data systems, and context engineering, we tackle challenges in memory representation, retrieval, and multimodal fusion.

Partnering closely with model and product teams, we turn advanced research into scalable production systems that support a wide range of AI-driven applications.

Responsibilities
- Design, build, and evolve the next-generation memory infrastructure for AI agents, developing a unified platform that supports long-term memory, conversational memory, and task-oriented memory.
- Architect and optimize memory system pipelines for large-scale, low-latency, and high-availability environments, including data ingestion, storage, indexing, retrieval, updating, compression, and forgetting mechanisms to support real-time inference and personalized interactions.
- Explore key challenges at the intersection of large language models, context engineering, and data management, including memory representation, retrieval and ranking, conflict resolution, summarization and fusion, and memory lifecycle management.
- Design unified memory models and processing workflows for multimodal data (text, image, audio, behavioral signals), enhancing agents’ long-term consistency, personalization, and task completion in complex scenarios.
- Collaborate closely with model, application, and platform teams to productionize memory capabilities, and continuously optimize system performance across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and safety.
- Stay up-to-date with cutting-edge advancements and contribute to the long-term technical roadmap of AI agent memory systems, driving innovation and capability evolution.

工作城市：圣何塞

jobs.title: Senior Production System Engineer - New York City
jobs.description:
The Server Management DevOps team is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of servers across ByteDance’s self-built data centers in the United States and Europe.
Our scope covers new hardware introduction, data center delivery
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 5+ years of experience in production systems, infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, hardware systems engineering, or large-scale data center operations.
- Proven hands-on experience introducing and productionizing large-scale GPU infrastructure, including ownership of hardware NPI or fleet onboarding across qualification, system integration, deployment, production validation, operational handoff, and post-launch reliability. Experience must include a recent-generation platform such as NVIDIA GB200/GB300 NVL72, HGX or DGX B200/B300, or a technically comparable rack-scale AI system.
- Deep knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting, combined with a strong understanding of server architecture and management technologies such as kernels, drivers, BIOS/UEFI, BMC, Redfish, firmware, PCIe, NVMe, NICs, DPUs, hardware telemetry, and failure diagnostics.
- Hands-on experience deploying or supporting distributed AI training or inference workloads using containerized and orchestrated environments, with working knowledge of technologies such as CUDA, GPU drivers, NCCL, NVLink, NVSwitch, RDMA, InfiniBand, RoCE, or high-performance Ethernet. Familiarity with high-density data center requirements, including liquid cooling, power delivery, rack integration, structured cabling, network fabrics, and deployment safety.
- Proficiency in Python, Go, Bash, or another programming language for production-grade infrastructure automation, along with practical experience applying AI or large language models to engineering workflows such as incident analysis, troubleshooting, knowledge retrieval, code generation, or automated remediation.
- Experience building and operating monitoring, telemetry, hardware management, or automated remediation platforms at substantial scale, with measurable results in fleet availability, deployment efficiency, incident reduction, operational efficiency, or reliability.

Preferred Qualifications
- Direct experience deploying and operating GB200 or GB300 NVL72 systems, including compute and NVLink switch trays, Grace CPUs, Blackwell GPUs, ConnectX networking, BlueField DPUs, rack management, firmware dependencies, power delivery, and liquid-cooled data center integration.

- Strong understanding of distributed AI workload behavior and performance analysis, including collective communication, multi-node training, inference serving, GPU scheduling, checkpointing, workload-related bottlenecks, DCGM, NCCL testing, CUDA profiling, and network-fabric telemetry.

- Contributions to infrastructure engineering communities, technical publications, patents, open-source projects, or relevant industry standards.

岗位描述：
The Server Management DevOps team is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of servers across ByteDance’s self-built data centers in the United States and Europe.
Our scope covers new hardware introduction, data center delivery, production operations, hardware maintenance, configuration and firmware changes, capacity migration, asset decommissioning, data sanitization, and hardware reuse.

The team serves as a central engineering and coordination point across multiple functions, including:
- Hardware New Product Introduction (NPI)
- Server and data center operations
- Field maintenance and infrastructure management
- Hardware vendors and service providers
- Supply chain and asset management
- Infrastructure platform and automation engineering teams

As ByteDance continues to expand its AI infrastructure, the team is taking on an increasingly important role in introducing, productionizing, and operating high-density GPU platforms at scale.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Production Systems Engineer with deep expertise in large-scale GPU infrastructure, Linux systems, hardware lifecycle management, automation, and production operations.

In this role, you will lead the introduction and productionization of current- and next-generation AI infrastructure, including rack-scale and high-density GPU platforms such as NVIDIA GB200/GB300 NVL72, HGX or DGX B200/B300, Vera Rubin NVL72, and comparable accelerator systems.

You will own critical work across platform evaluation, system and firmware integration, data center readiness, deployment validation, fleet onboarding, monitoring, incident response, and long-term operational reliability. You will also work directly with AI training and inference environments to ensure that the underlying infrastructure meets real workload requirements.

This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical judgment, hands-on engineering ability, and the capacity to lead complex global infrastructure initiatives across organizational boundaries.

Key Responsibilities
- Advanced GPU Platform Introduction: Lead the evaluation, qualification, integration, and production rollout of next-generation GPU platforms, including GB200/GB300 NVL72, B200/B300 systems, Vera Rubin, and future rack-scale AI infrastructure.
- End-to-End Production Readiness: Define launch criteria and readiness plans spanning server hardware, firmware, BMC, operating systems, drivers, GPU software stacks, networking, storage, security, telemetry, and operational tooling.
- Rack-Scale Integration and Fleet Operations: Partner across hardware, data center, network, storage, power, cooling, and vendor teams to resolve system-level challenges and improve GPU fleet availability, utilization, serviceability, and lifecycle management.
- Systems, Performance, and Reliability Engineering: Diagnose complex Linux, hardware, firmware, PCIe, NVLink/NVSwitch, network, storage, and memory issues, while developing qualification, burn-in, benchmarking, health-check, and regression-testing frameworks. Improve the availability, utilization, serviceability, and lifecycle management of large GPU fleets across multiple data center regions.
- Automation, Observability, and AI-Assisted Operations: Build scalable automation and actionable telemetry for provisioning, configuration, monitoring, fault detection, remediation, repair, and lifecycle operations; apply AI technologies to incident triage, troubleshooting, knowledge retrieval, and automated remediation.
- Technical and Cross-Functional Leadership: Establish engineering standards, operational procedures, and long-term support models; mentor engineers and drive complex infrastructure programs across internal teams, supply-chain partners, and external vendors.
- On-Call and Global Operations: Participate in a global on-call rotation and provide senior-level leadership during critical production incidents. Occasional travel to data centers, integration facilities, or vendor sites may be required. Lead the investigation of complex and high-impact production incidents, coordinate mitigation across teams and vendors, perform root-cause analysis, and ensure that preventive actions are implemented and measured.

团队介绍：字节跳动基础设施计算团队，专注构建面向大模型与 AI Agent 时代的 AI-Native Infra。我们从算力、系统到平台，围绕“AI 如何高效运行、持续进化、规模化落地”这一核心问题，重构计算基础设施。我们管理着数十万台服务器组成的超大规模集群，构建统一的异构算力调度与云原生运行体系；通过软硬协同与自研框架，持续突破大模型训练与推理的性能瓶颈；并进一步向上，打造企业级 AI Agent Infra，让 Agent 具备身份、权限、记忆、观测与治理能力，真正成为可运行在生产环境中的新型“应用形态”。
从云服务器、容器、函数，到 AI 网关、可观测与弹性体系，我们构建的是一个为 AI 而生、由 AI 驱动进化的基础设施平台，支撑集团核心业务与企业级客户的智能化升级。
如果你希望参与定义 AI 时代的 Infra 范式，而不仅是优化一个模块或服务——欢迎加入我们，一起构建下一代 AI 云原生基础设施。

1、参与企业级Agent Runtime建设，负责Agent任务执行、状态管理、长任务运行、Checkpoint、重试恢复和生命周期管理等核心能力，使Agent能够在生产环境中稳定完成复杂任务；
2、参与Agent安全执行环境建设，围绕容器、虚拟机或轻量级Sandbox，完善环境创建、镜像与依赖管理、资源限制、网络控制、文件系统隔离和运行时安全等能力；
3、建设Agent任务编排与资源调度能力，支持高并发任务、弹性伸缩、优先级与配额管理、多租户隔离以及CPU/GPU等异构资源的高效使用，参与Tool、Skill、Plugin、MCP/A2A、Computer Use等连接能力建设，将企业数据、API和应用系统以安全、标准化的方式提供给Agent使用；
4、建设Agent可观测与评测基础设施，完善对模型调用、工具调用、任务轨迹、资源消耗和失败原因的追踪、诊断与度量，持续优化任务成功率、延迟、稳定性与成本，面向企业级交付要求，参与身份权限、凭证管理、审计、配额、灰度、容灾、版本兼容及公有云/专有环境适配等能力建设；
5、深入客户实际场景，与产品、算法、安全、SRE和解决方案团队协作，将客户共性需求抽象为稳定、易用、可复用的平台能力；
6、基于AI-Native SDLC实践，使用AI Coding、自动化测试和智能诊断等方式提升研发效率，并将工具、排障方法和最佳实践沉淀为团队可复用的工程资产。

CapCut is an all-in-one video editing app that empowers creators to express themselves and transform videos into creative masterpieces. CapCut Template is a feature that allows users to create videos quickly and easily by applying pre-designed editing formats. Users simply insert their own media to generate a customized final video. These templates serve different types of users:

- Casual social media users who want to participate in trends or create fun videos without needing editing skills.

- Share insights and best practices with creators, helping them adopt AI tools and improve content quality while maintaining originality and engagement.
- Collaborate with product, effect, and marketing teams to test, refine, and optimize AI features, participating in pre-launch testing and providing feedback to improve usability and creative impact.
- Support go-to-market activations, producing creative examples, guiding template usage, and connecting AI content innovation with broader community and internal teams.

jobs.title: Global FOC Shift Supervisor - Data Center Infrastructure
jobs.description: The global data center operation team supports the company's fast growth by operating hyperscale datacenters. The team manages the end to end lifecycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions and various infrastructure services ensuring
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications: 
- 3+ years of working experience in data center infrastructure O&M. Familiar with relevant emergency management procedures. 
- Effective communication and collaboration with global teams, vendors and partners. Strong ability to respond to unexpected faults and emergencies, with solid skills in cross-team arrangement, problem breakdown and resource coordination.
- Sound logical thinking and a strong sense of responsibility. Skilled in office and data tools, with standard documentation habits. Able to compile and update workflows and technical documents in a timely manner as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above preferred, in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management, Data Center Operations, Computer Engineering, or related technical disciplines. Equivalent hands-on O&M experience may also be considered.
- Good risk identification capability. Able to accurately assess major risks and complete standardized escalation and reporting. Possess closed-loop management awareness, as well as strong comprehensive analysis and problem-solving skills.
- Familiar with management workflows and O&M systems for data center infrastructure. Experience in developing large-scale infrastructure O&M systems is a plus. Strong data awareness and O&M quality control skills; proficient in KPI tracking, data analysis and fault troubleshooting.
- Candidates with experience in large enterprises, global cross-team collaboration and end-to-end fault coordination are preferred.

岗位描述：
The global data center operation team supports the company's fast growth by operating hyperscale datacenters. The team manages the end to end lifecycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions and various infrastructure services ensuring that they are scalable and are reliable.
This role offers the opportunity to support global hyperscale data center facility infrastructure operations across multiple regions, working closely with facility managers, business teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders. 

The position provides exposure to large-scale facility O&M, emergency response, risk management, operational governance, and platform capability building. Candidates will play a key role in improving global operational standards, service reliability, and O&M quality across a rapidly growing infrastructure environment.

We are looking for candidates who can:
- Oversee overall operation, maintenance and emergency response for global data center infrastructure. Provide remote emergency support, coordinate with on-site facility managers and local contacts, and liaise with business teams when service disruptions occur.
- Escalate and report major risks in a timely manner, follow up on rectification progress, and coordinate internal and external resources to ensure full closed-loop management of O&M risks.
- Drive the implementation, rollout and supervision of O&M management systems. Unify operational specifications across all data centers, and guide on-site teams on daily routine work.
- Regularly monitor and analyze regional O&M metrics, conduct quality supervision and process audits. Identify potential operational risks, and continuously optimize workflows and service quality.
- Support the capability building of data center infrastructure platforms, including data ingestion, data governance and alarm management.

jobs.title: System Architect - Server Hardware
jobs.description: Server platform team is responsible for architecting, designing and building best server and storage system to meet the requirements of high-performance, low cost and easy to operate. By joining this team, you will work with the best engine
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
- Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related majors.
- Experienced in hardware/software performance and power optimization is preferred.
- Deep understanding of computer system architecture.
- Demonstrated knowledge of the design principles and applications of CPU, memory, SSD and network parts.
- Understand the implementation of virtualization technology, database, distributed storage system and deep learning architecture. 
- Demonstrated experience in working collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications
- 3 years of experience in Circuit Board Design, System debugging, Power/Signal Integrity, and Thermal solutions.
- 3 years experience in server or storage system architecture design or software-hardware co-design.

岗位描述：
Server platform team is responsible for architecting, designing and building best server and storage system to meet the requirements of high-performance, low cost and easy to operate. By joining this team, you will work with the best engineers and talents in this industry and have a broad opportunity to get in touch with the latest AI application system and newly emerged technology in computing, storage and silicon validation. You will gain remarkable hardware architect, development and validation experiences in most advanced hardware infrastructure at massive scale.

We are looking for a self-motivated server and storage hardware architect and technology planning expert. As a system architect and technology planning expert, your responsibilities will include:
- Evaluate the newly emerged technology in the industry, set up and test with POC system, and integrate the technology into our infrastructure.
- Work with EE\ME\Thermal team on high-level designing of Server system. 
- Collaborate with our application teams to analyze the workload character of the application. Help the application teams to innovate, improve performance and lower cost of their infrastructure resources.
- Collaborate with Hardware, Network and IDC teams to work out the new high level design of our hardware system. Make sure the system is competitive in cost, performance and easy to operate.
- Work with industry consortiums and open standard committees to investigate the newly emerged standards or technologies,  and contribute our research results and points of view to the industry.
- Work with our technology partners and suppliers to setup POC or prototypes to evaluate and test the new technologies or architectural designs. 
- International travel requirement: up to four times per year, including but not limited to China, Europe, and South Asia. Candidates must have a valid passport and be able to obtain the necessary visas.

jobs.title: Interdisciplinary Researcher

jobs.requirementText:

- 5+ years of demonstrated depth in historical analysis, strategic research, geopolitical analysis, or policy research (gained in settings such as think tanks, intelligence analysis, academic research institutions, or in-house corporate research/strategy teams), with the proven ability to set research priorities and lead complex analyses independently

jobs.description:
About the Global Legal Compliance (GLC) Team

Our Global Legal Compliance (GLC) team provides key support for ByteDance’s innovative initiatives, advanced technology development, and integrated platforms serving our global markets. We partn
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualification(s):
- Bachelor’s degree or above in international trade, law, compliance, public policy, engineering, or a related field.
- Extensive experience in export controls, trade compliance, compliance operations, due diligence, or related regulatory compliance work.
- Strong knowledge of U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the EAR, restricted party screening, licensing fundamentals, and export compliance governance.
- Experience building, implementing, or enhancing compliance programs and operational controls in a multinational or cross-border business environment.
- Experience managing core compliance processes, including screening, end-user due diligence, recordkeeping, training, monitoring, escalations, and audit support.
- Ability to assess export control and counterparty risk across cross-border activities, including onboarding, end-use review, ownership diligence, and red flag analysis.
- Strong communication, judgment, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across legal, business, and technical teams in different time zones.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Experience supporting compliance matters involving advanced computing, AI, software, cloud/IaaS, infrastructure services, semiconductors, logistics, or supply chain operations.
- Experience scaling compliance processes in a fast-growing or evolving regulatory environment.
- Familiarity with export control risks involving technology transfers, cloud or API access, and infrastructure-enabled services.
- Experience with screening tools, workflow systems, case management, or process improvement initiatives.
- Familiarity with trade compliance developments across the U.S., UK, EU, Singapore, or other relevant jurisdictions.

岗位描述：
About the Global Legal Compliance (GLC) Team

Our Global Legal Compliance (GLC) team provides key support for ByteDance’s innovative initiatives, advanced technology development, and integrated platforms serving our global markets. We partner closely with legal, business, product, engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams to help enable strategic growth while managing complex regulatory risk.

We are looking for an experienced Global Export Compliance Manager to join our Global Legal Compliance team. This role will focus on the build-up, implementation, and continuous enhancement of ByteDance’s export control and trade compliance program, with particular focus on operational controls, end-user due diligence, restricted party screening, cloud and infrastructure-related risk review, training, governance, and ongoing program execution.

The ideal candidate is an experienced compliance professional with strong program-building instincts and a practical understanding of export control and trade compliance operations. This individual should be comfortable working across functions to help establish and improve scalable compliance processes, support day-to-day compliance operations, and strengthen the overall effectiveness of the company’s global trade compliance framework, particularly in areas where export control risk arises through supply chain, customer onboarding, cloud or API access, compute infrastructure, and other operational workflows.

Core Responsibilities
- Support the build-up, implementation, and continuous enhancement of ByteDance and TikTok's export control and trade compliance program, including policies, procedures, governance processes, controls, and internal guidance; drive program maturity assessments, maintain a risk-based policy framework addressing EAR and applicable non-US regimes, and translate regulatory developments into updated internal processes, training, and operational guidance.
- Design and manage core compliance operations including restricted party screening, end-user due diligence, recordkeeping, training, monitoring, and audit readiness; maintain screening and match-review workflows and sustain an escalation and case management process that produces defensible audit trails.
- Develop and maintain compliance processes for cross-border business activities, technology transfers, customer and vendor onboarding, cloud/IaaS access, and advanced computing infrastructure; build transaction review workflows that identify license requirements and exceptions under the EAR, assess counterparty risk factors including ownership, jurisdiction, and end-use concerns, and maintain documentation standards that would withstand regulatory scrutiny.
- Partner with legal, business, product, engineering, infrastructure, procurement, logistics, supply chain, human resources, and operations teams to embed export control requirements into relevant workflows; participate in product and feature reviews to surface export control implications early and serve as a practical, solutions-oriented resource for business stakeholders.
- Assess and manage export control risks across the supply chain, including component-level ECCN classification, Foreign Direct Product rules, and vendor compliance obligations; integrate screening and classification checkpoints into procurement and onboarding workflows and maintain visibility into supply chain dependencies that may trigger EAR or sanctions restrictions.

工作城市：新加坡

- Familiarity with Executive Protection programs, policies and support.

When you join Physical Security, you will take on more than day-to-day security matters. You will tackle complex challenges in real business environments. Our work is close to the front line, while also connecting strategy, technology, and operations. You will need to identify risks in everyday details, drive solutions through global collaboration, make sound judgments and respond effectively in critical situations, and turn lessons from real-world practice into stronger mechanisms and more mature ways of working.

Whether you are just starting your career and hoping to grow quickly through real-world experience, or you already have relevant expertise and want to make a greater impact in more complex environments, you will find room to thrive here: sharpening your judgment through practice, expanding your problem-solving abilities through collaboration, and turning your work into employees' sense of security and greater certainty in organizational operations.

团队介绍：TikTok是一个覆盖150个国家和地区的国际短视频平台，我们希望通过TikTok发现真实、有趣的瞬间，让生活更美好。TikTok 在全球各地设有办公室，全球总部位于洛杉矶和新加坡，办公地点还包括纽约、伦敦、都柏林、巴黎、柏林、迪拜、雅加达、首尔和东京等多个城市。

TikTok社交团队业务覆盖国际化短视频产品内所有社交场景,包括评论、点赞、通知,以及多种创新社交场景，对增加用户活跃度和用户粘性有着至关重要的作用。
在这里，有大牛带队与大家一同不断探索前沿,突破想象
jobs.requirementText:
1、拥抱AI时代的技术视野，对AI辅助编程、大模型等前沿技术有浓厚兴趣，具备较强的技术敏锐度与学习能力，乐于探索先进技术在业务中的实际应用；
2、对软件产品具有强烈的责任心与质量意识，具备出色的沟通协作能力，能够适应全球化跨职能团队的高效协同；
3、具备扎实的iOS开发经验，深入掌握Objective-C或Swift语言，拥有优秀的编码规范和扎实的计算机底层基础；
4、具备良好的架构设计能力，熟悉App开发的主流框架和设计模式，能够独立驾驭复杂且具备较高挑战的客户端业务场景；
5、熟悉App内存占用、耗电、网络、UI渲染等性能分析和优化的方法，具备丰富的线上疑难问题排查与解决经验。

岗位描述：
团队介绍：TikTok是一个覆盖150个国家和地区的国际短视频平台，我们希望通过TikTok发现真实、有趣的瞬间，让生活更美好。TikTok 在全球各地设有办公室，全球总部位于洛杉矶和新加坡，办公地点还包括纽约、伦敦、都柏林、巴黎、柏林、迪拜、雅加达、首尔和东京等多个城市。

TikTok社交团队业务覆盖国际化短视频产品内所有社交场景,包括评论、点赞、通知,以及多种创新社交场景，对增加用户活跃度和用户粘性有着至关重要的作用。
在这里，有大牛带队与大家一同不断探索前沿,突破想象空间。
在这里，你的每一行代码都将服务亿万用户。
在这里，团队人专业且纯粹,合作氛围平等且轻松。

1、负责TikTok产品的iOS端核心研发，为全球用户打造丰富且高质量的社交体验与互动功能；
2、融入前沿AI研发体系，在日常开发中深度应用大模型与先进的AI辅助编码工具，探索并沉淀智能化研发的最佳实践，持续推动工程效能的提升；
3、与产品设计团队紧密配合，深度参与需求评审、功能定义与体验优化，从客户端视角提供专业的技术方案与架构支撑，确保业务高质量落地；
4、负责高质量的架构设计与核心代码编写，承担内存、网络、UI渲染及复杂交互场景下的重点与难点技术攻坚；
5、持续关注iOS前沿技术与AI领域的发展趋势，开展前瞻性探索与应用，推动团队技术边界的拓展与创新。

工作城市：上海

jobs.title: 学术合作经理

1、学术网络建立与维护：在华北地区，拓展并维护与顶尖大学、研究机构的关键意见领袖、专家及学者的合作网络，重点关注人工智能及相关领域；

3、拥有3年以上在高校合作、企业战略、管理咨询、风险投资领域的相关工作经验优先。

1、学术网络建立与维护：在华北地区，拓展并维护与顶尖大学、研究机构的关键意见领袖、专家及学者的合作网络，重点关注人工智能及相关领域；
2、技术进展分析：针对新兴技术、高校研究突破、人才分布格局和行业趋势，进行深入的研究并产出分析总结报告；

jobs.title: 广告行业运营（运动服饰方向）-中国广告销售平台
jobs.description:
1、行业策略：熟悉互联网广告及电商媒体平台，通过行业数据分析、产品洞察、典型广告主研究等，洞察行业需求和增量机会点，制定行业短期及长期增长策略，为平台媒体收入增长负责；
2、产品解决方案：熟悉品牌、达人、效果等商业化产品逻辑，从广告样式、流量售卖策略、转化路径等多方面，优化或创新广告策略，提升客户投放效果及满意度，定期输出行业方法论；
3、专项推进：依据业务发展需求，制定行业专项，有效协同产品、数据、中台、销售、客户等各部门，完成专项策略、专项共建以及执行；
4、产品协同：协
jobs.requirementText:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上相关行业运营经验，服饰行业优先；
2、互联网广告、电商平台、品牌方市场/媒介部门、广告公司经验优先，有电商运营、达人营销、广告优化项目管理经验优先；
3、具有较好的数据分析能力，掌握数据分析工具，对数据有敏感性且逻辑思维能力良好，可以独立完成客户投放分析，总结分析报告，沉淀方法论；
4、具备成功的项目管理经验，沟通能力强，良好的应变能力及跨部门协作能力；
5、有较强的团队合作意识，拥抱变化，较强的抗压能力。

岗位描述：
1、行业策略：熟悉互联网广告及电商媒体平台，通过行业数据分析、产品洞察、典型广告主研究等，洞察行业需求和增量机会点，制定行业短期及长期增长策略，为平台媒体收入增长负责；
2、产品解决方案：熟悉品牌、达人、效果等商业化产品逻辑，从广告样式、流量售卖策略、转化路径等多方面，优化或创新广告策略，提升客户投放效果及满意度，定期输出行业方法论；
3、专项推进：依据业务发展需求，制定行业专项，有效协同产品、数据、中台、销售、客户等各部门，完成专项策略、专项共建以及执行；
4、产品协同：协助进行产品需求调研，了解客户投放痛点、需求，有效推动商业产品迭代升级，不断完善媒体投放产品。

工作城市：上海

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Developer AI
jobs.description:
About the Role
ByteDance’s Dev Infra team is looking for talented Machine Learning Engineers to join our Dev AI initiative. Our mission is to build intelligent systems that transform how engineers design, develop, test, debug, and maintain
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant industry or research experience in machine learning, large language models, code intelligence, AI-powered developer tools, or related areas.
- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, Go, Java, C++, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
- Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, machine learning, operating systems, databases, and fundamental system design principles.
- Experience owning complex machine learning projects end-to-end, from problem formulation and data construction to model development, evaluation, deployment, and production iteration.
- Strong system design and engineering skills, with experience building scalable, reliable, and efficient machine learning systems or AI-powered applications.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive complex technical projects across teams.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience building or leading AI systems for software engineering, including code generation, coding agents, unit test generation, debugging, or code review.
- Deep experience with large language models and one or more model improvement or post-training techniques, such as supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference optimization, prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval, or model evaluation.
- Experience designing and improving agentic systems, including tool-using LLMs, coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, agent skills, planning, memory, or multi-step execution workflows.
- Experience building large-scale training data, evaluation datasets, benchmarks, or experimentation pipelines for machine learning or code intelligence systems.
- Strong understanding of software engineering and code intelligence techniques such as program analysis, compilers, static analysis, code search, repository indexing, testing, and debugging.
- Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or demonstrated technical leadership in machine learning, large language models, code intelligence, developer tools, or AI for software engineering.

岗位描述：
About the Role
ByteDance’s Dev Infra team is looking for talented Machine Learning Engineers to join our Dev AI initiative. Our mission is to build intelligent systems that transform how engineers design, develop, test, debug, and maintain software at scale.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of machine learning, large language models, code intelligence, and developer infrastructure. You will develop and improve AI systems for code generation, automated testing, debugging, code understanding, and agentic software engineering, with the goal of significantly improving developer productivity across ByteDance.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and improve machine learning and large language model systems for software engineering tasks, including code generation, unit test generation, and debugging.
- Build AI-powered developer agents and intelligent workflows that can reason over large codebases, interact with development environments and tools, execute multi-step engineering tasks, and assist engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Improve model and agent performance through prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, tool-use design, and agent harness engineering.
- Build high-quality training and evaluation data pipelines for software engineering tasks, including data collection, filtering, synthesis, labeling, and hard-example mining.
- Explore and apply advances in large language models, code intelligence, program analysis, reinforcement learning, and autonomous software engineering to real-world developer productivity problems at scale.

3、具备跨团队协作与技术攻坚能力，敢于挑战现有技术范式，对新技术保持敏锐的判断力。

团队介绍：风控算法团队深耕于抖音（短视频、直播、电商、本地生活等）、今日头条等多个字节系业务，涵盖内容、交易、流量、账号等多个场景的底线风险治理、黑灰产对抗及复杂反作弊等关键任务。风控场景具有对抗性极强、逻辑推理链路长及海量多模态数据等挑战。目前，团队正积极推进大语言模型（LLM/MLLM）与 Agentic AI 技术的深入研究与工业化落地。通过探索前沿的模型训练范式、自主规划的 Agent 架构以及严谨的 Harness Engineering 体系，我们致力于打造下一代智能风控基础设施，为十亿级用户的社区生态保驾护航。

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Data Center Engineering
jobs.description:
About the Team
As the core nerve center of data centers, the power distribution system serves as the power source supporting full-site operation, while ELV control acts as the neural hub ensuring intelligent operation.

The Electrical Team
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Electrical Engineering and Automation or related disciplines; with at least 5 years of experience in electrical technical design for data centers. 
2. Have led and participated in electrical system design of data center projects as a project leader or discipline lead.
3. Proficient in the design, type selection and key performance optimization of equipment including generator, power distribution cabinets, transformers, UPS, batteries, PDUs, etc.
4. Familiar with industry specifications for electrical disciplines applicable to data centers, as well as cross-discipline coordination procedures throughout the whole project design cycle.
5. Strong knowledge of relevant standards for the design and testing of power distribution products, with the ability to develop test plans, oversee test execution, analyze test results, and a solid understanding of the manufacturing processes of power distribution equipment.
6. Have a clear grasp of construction costs, mainstream core technologies and operation models of electrical disciplines; able to provide design support for engineering, bidding and procurement teams, and understand operation & maintenance requirements of electrical systems.
7. Possess self-motivation and learning ability, with outstanding communication, organization, coordination and project delivery capabilities.

Preferred Qualification
- Experience working with third-party IDC operators is highly preferred.

岗位描述：
About the Team
As the core nerve center of data centers, the power distribution system serves as the power source supporting full-site operation, while ELV control acts as the neural hub ensuring intelligent operation.

The Electrical Team takes full responsibility for the technical architecture, management, and continuous innovation of both power supply and ELV control systems throughout the entire lifecycle of data centers. With our professional technical capabilities, we develop highly reliable, secure, efficient, stable, green and low-carbon power supply, distribution and intelligent control infrastructure for data centers worldwide, enabling rapid business rollout and sustained, stable operation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Take charge of the electrical design, as well as the review and evaluation of technical solutions for new-build and renovated data centers. In accordance with business requirements, guide design institutes to complete architectural layout, scheme and construction drawing design by integrating the architecture and technical characteristics of various systems including medium & low voltage power systems, UPS systems, diesel generator systems, etc.
2. Conduct electrical design and technical management for external parties (cooperating design institutes, etc.) and internal departments (other collaborating teams, etc.); review construction drawings and special technical proposals submitted by suppliers and exercise full quality control.
3. Compile discipline-specific documents including design briefs, drawing review checklists & key review points, construction technical specifications and other relevant materials.
4. Manage quality control of electrical equipment for data center infrastructure, including summarizing defects identified during factory acceptance tests of equipment and following up on rectification implementation.
5. Provide on-site electrical design technical support throughout project construction, review design alterations, and coordinate acceptance of all electrical-related works and equipment across all project phases.
6. Deliver discipline-specific technical support during the operational phase of projects, organize technical reviews with the operation team, and update design technical specifications accordingly.
7. Support troubleshooting of in-service equipment, covering root cause analysis, formulation of improvement plans, and follow-up to ensure full implementation of corrective measures.

工作城市：新加坡

jobs.title: Synthesis & STA Engineer - Singapore
jobs.description: The Silicon Platform Team acts as the core R&D middleware group for chip development within the company. The team covers the full spectrum of the chip design flow, including Logic Synthesis, Design for Testability (DFT), Backend Design, Phy
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field.
2. 3+ years of experience in IC design with a focus on sdc, synthesis, timing signoff, low-power implementation, and power optimization.
3. Proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog, RTL-to-GDSII flow, and EDA tools (Fusion Compiler, Genus/Innovus+, PrimeTime/Tempus, Formality, Conformal LP).

Preferred Qualifications
1. Strong understanding of timing analysis, multi-clock domain handling.
2. Familiarity with DFT methodologies (scan, bscan, mbist) and understanding of DFT related timing analysis is preferred.

岗位描述：
The Silicon Platform Team acts as the core R&D middleware group for chip development within the company. The team covers the full spectrum of the chip design flow, including Logic Synthesis, Design for Testability (DFT), Backend Design, Physical and STA (Static Timing Analysis) Signoff, as well as Power Integrity, IR drop, and Electromagnetic Compatibility (Power/IR/EM). The team also oversees tape-out, mass production, packaging, testing, and board-level verification. They collaborate closely with front-end chip teams across business units to drive R&D progress and mass production deployment for chip.

Responsibilities
- Perform logic synthesis and design optimization for architectures and RTLs.
- Timing constrains (SDC) preparation and tuning, and conduct hierarchical/full-chip STA signoff and timing closure. 
- Implement low-power design techniques and constraints (UPF, clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage scaling).
- Formal verification & equivalence checking using formal verification tools (Conformal, Formality).
- Work with front-end engineers for architectural exploration and planning.
- Work with backend engineers on floorplanning, place & route (P&R), congestion analysis, and timing bottlenecks.

工作城市：新加坡

- Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field.
- Minimally 5 years of progressive experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations, in a role managing regional or cross-functional teams in B2B SaaS, Cloud Computing, or AI/ML infrastructure. Deep hands-on experience in B2B SaaS, Cloud Computing, or AI/ML infrastructure businesses; prior exposure to enterprise software sales cycles and channel/partner ecosystems is essential.
- Deep hands-on experience in L2C process design and optimization, including lead management, pipeline governance, and forecasting methodology. Proven track record of building data-driven operational systems from 0 to 1, including customer segmentation frameworks, predictive analytics, and multi-role dashboards.
- Proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and familiarity with lead-generation/sales intelligence tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalents). Strong command of BI systems and dashboard development (Tableau, PowerBI, or proprietary tools); proficiency in SQL, Python, or R for data manipulation and analysis.
- High oral and written fluency in Mandarin is required as this role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders from China.
- Experience in sales incentive design and channel partner program management, with ability to model financial impact and ensure compliance. 
- Willingness and ability to travel up to 20-30% across APAC and EMEA markets as required.

Preferred Qualifications
-  Master's degree or MBA preferred.
- Prior experience in Chinese tech companies with global expansion and familiarity with their internal data systems and operating rhythms.

岗位描述：
Join the Fast-Growing BytePlus Team
BytePlus is one of the newer Business Units formed to serve global enterprise customers with our leading technology solutions. As part of the BytePlus Team, you help enterprise customers build what's next for their business. Leveraging ByteDance's cutting-edge intelligent technologies, we are devoted to developing innovative products and solutions to shape the future. We empower our clients to focus on what truly matters. Centering on inspiring innovativeness and excellence, we create life-changing solutions that impact lives around the world. You can help us to achieve our mission.

Roles & Responsibilities
1. Strategic Business Partnership & Revenue Accountability
  - Serve as the core business partner to Sales Leadership across APAC, EMEA and Emerging Markets,  owning Forecasting Accuracy and Revenue Certainty as primary operating KPIs.
  - Drive annual/quarterly revenue planning, ensuring strategic plans are operationally executable and aligned with regional market maturity.
2. Lead to Cash (L2C) Process Optimization
  - Own the end-to-end L2C operational architecture, from lead routing and opportunity qualification to contract closure and revenue recognition.
  - Design and implement standardized sales motions, account management playbooks, and pipeline hygiene rules tailored to cloud/AI infrastructure sales cycles.
  - Build automated workflow tools and CRM enhancements (via direct configuration or partnership with Engineering/BI) to reduce manual friction and accelerate deal velocity.
3. Data-Driven Insights & Risk Management
  - Build and oversee full-lifecycle forecasting methodology and data operations infrastructure, including predictive models, multi-role dashboards, and automated risk alerts.
  - Conduct deep-dive analysis on pipeline health, conversion funnel leakage, account coverage gaps, and churn propensity, delivering actionable insights to regional leadership and HQ.
  - Establish standardized reporting frameworks in partnership with BI, ensuring consistent metrics definitions and single-source-of-truth visibility across APAC and EMEA.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement
  - Act as the primary interface between Sales and back-office functions (Marketing, Partnerships, Product, Finance, Legal), aligning resources to land business rules and resolve execution blockers.
  - Support Marketing and Partnership team initiatives, including joint go-to-market programs, partner onboarding, and co-marketing campaigns.
  - Drive best practice codification and change management across regional teams, ensuring operational consistency while accommodating local market nuances.
5. Ad-Hoc Strategic Projects
  - Lead or support special projects including new market entry, organization turn-over, team integration, and competitive response programs as business needs arise.

工作城市：新加坡

2、新客开拓（细分赛道）：聚焦细分子行业赛道（如动力电池、智能座舱、汽车芯片等），针对各赛道的业务特征制定并落地精准拓客打法，从0到1打开新赛道市场；
3、老客深耕（链主带T1）：通过链主客户

1、3-5年汽车/制造行业营销、咨询相关工作经验，本科及以上学历；有To B软件（SaaS/ERP/PLM）或汽车/制造行业营销、咨询经验者优先；
2、行业理解：对汽车行业的业务逻辑、研发流程、供应链协同（链主—T1—T2）有深刻认知；了解该行业数字化转型的痛点；

jobs.description: Data Center Development department is responsible for supporting the company's fast growth by sourcing and building hyper-scale data centers as well as vastly distributed global edge networks. Our AMS&EU Network Acquisition team focuses on
jobs.requirementText:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor degree in a business, technical field, or equivalent work experience.
- 3+ years experience in infrastructure industry for the acquisition, sourcing, engineering, finance or other relevant technical and business functions.
- Work experience with the Edge Co-locations, Data Center, and/or ISP / Carrier / Contents Delivery Network / IX providers in North American and Latin American markets.

Preferred Qualifications:

岗位描述：
Data Center Development department is responsible for supporting the company's fast growth by sourcing and building hyper-scale data centers as well as vastly distributed global edge networks. Our AMS&EU Network Acquisition team focuses on the acquisition of co-locations and various network connectivities from the strategy and commercial angle to support edge and backbone network infrastructure that enable users to interact with our platform with optimal performance in Americas and EMEA region. As we interact with various partners in this industry, we also develop and maintain relationships and strategic partnerships with suppliers. Also, as we develop our acquisition strategy, we conduct market research, manage the potential and existing supplier pool, cost analysis and supplier performance evaluation to build our roadmap for the acquisition effort to support our growth. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about global infrastructure acquisition with exciting growth opportunities.

We are looking for a self-motivated server and storage hardware architect and technology planning expert. As a system architect and technology planning expert, your responsibilities will include:
- Securing various infrastructure resources such as co-location and connectivity services (dark fiber, transport network, IP, etc.) from commercial angle to fulfill and support our traffic demand
- Lead commercial and technical negotiations with candidate suppliers.
- Negotiate and implement complex supplier agreements and contracts working with cross-functional teams to meet the deliverables on milestone dates.
- Develop and manage acquisition strategies and tactics for the short, mid and long term.
- Cross functional collaboration with various stakeholders, including but not limited to Strategy, Planning, Engineering, Legal, Finance, etc.
- Conduct market research, build market intelligence, select and onboard qualified suppliers and manage the supplier lifecycle.
- Maintain a sustainable relationship and develop strategic partnerships with suppliers to deliver business goals and objectives.
